- **Resonance assistants only write to files you have allowed.** A new goal, or a switch to another file, makes the card ask "The assistant wants to write to ... Allow?" with the exact path. Once allowed, the assistant keeps working without asking again for each revision.
- **What the assistant drafts before you allow it is kept as a draft.** Preview it, then Allow publishes exactly that version, with no new model call.
- **Codex and API-key brains can also hand in their work during the chat**, through the same check as Claude: Jarvis 007 reads, verifies and publishes the submission itself, and never overwrites a file you edited.
- **A Revoke permission button on the goal card** stops the goal right away; press Resume to grant it again. To go back to 0.95.1, stop Jarvis 007 and run `tools/resonance_restore_pre_a4.py`.

## [0.95.1] - 2026-10-11
### Fixed
- **Ollama (Local) no longer "returns nothing" after thinking too long.** Models like qwen3 turn thinking on by themselves, and a job such as counting the rows of a file could spend the whole turn thinking without writing a word. Jarvis 007 now switches thinking off for local models, with or without tools, so they answer directly.
- **The Effort button no longer drags the local model along.** Leave Effort at Medium or Very high for Claude and the local model still answers directly, so switching between the two no longer means toggling it every time.
- **When a model only thinks and never answers, Jarvis 007 says exactly that**, with what to do (lower the thinking level or split the task), instead of a "returned nothing" that looks like a lost connection.

Thanks to the user who reported this with a patch tested on a Mac.

## [0.94.0] - 2026-10-11
### Improved
- **Bots see customer photos whatever model runs them.** A bot whose model can see images still looks at the photo itself. When the model cannot (Antigravity, Grok Build, a text-only model) or returns nothing for a photo, another brain you already connected looks at it and describes it, copying prices, order codes and phone numbers exactly. The order: your main brain, then the ChatGPT plan, then Claude Code.
- **Bots remember what the earlier photo showed.** When a customer follows up about "the thing in that photo", the bot still knows, because the description stays in the conversation.

### Fixed
- **Zalo photos are no longer dropped by mistake.** Zalo's photo server labels some photos as generic binary files instead of images, and Jarvis 007 skipped them before the bot could see them. Jarvis 007 now checks the file's own content to recognise an image.
- **The bot card shows the real error when a model rejects a photo**, instead of a generic "refused the image". When no brain can look, the card says why each one could not.

## [0.92.2] - 2026-10-11
### Fixed
- **Ollama (Local) can use tools.** With a model running in Ollama on your own machine, the model could not read files or call any connection and said it had no tool permission, because Jarvis 007 forgot to load tools for this kind of model. Local models now get the same tools as the API models, and the Connections page no longer says they cannot call tools.
- **The Local Model page on Apple-chip Macs says the GPU is used.** It used to say "Runs on CPU and RAM" while Ollama ran fully on the chip's GPU. Jarvis 007 now recognises Apple chips even when Python runs under Rosetta, counts the shared RAM as GPU memory, and no longer drops the GPU when you enter the RAM size by hand.

### Improved
- **API and local models can read PDF and Word (.docx) files.** These files used to come out as binary noise. A scanned PDF (images only) is reported plainly as having no text to read.

Thanks to the user who sent the bug report along with a patch tested on a Mac.

## [0.92.1] - 2026-10-11
### Fixed
- **Signing in no longer fails on capital letters or invisible spaces.** Usernames ignore case now, so "Phong" and "phong" both work. A stray space before or after the password, which phone keyboards often add, no longer reads as a wrong password.
- **When the password is right but the browser does not keep the session, Jarvis 007 says so**, with the usual causes, instead of silently returning to an empty sign-in form.
- **On a server that sets the account from its environment, the wrong-password message points out that the username is `JAVIS_ADMIN_USER`** (default admin). Resetting the password through Hostinger also resets the username, which is easy to miss.
### Improved
- **The first-run screen is readable on the light theme.** Brain names, card borders and the Claude sign-in command used to be nearly invisible on a light background. On a public server, the admin account section now says it is required right away instead of a red line at the bottom.

## [0.91.0] - 2026-10-10
### Added
- **DeepSeek is a new brain.** Paste a DeepSeek API key on the Models page to pick `deepseek-flash` or `deepseek-v4-pro` as the main brain, for agents or for background work, with the same tools as the other API engines.
- **Thinking depth works with DeepSeek.** Set to Off, DeepSeek answers directly, cheaper and faster; turned on, it thinks first. If an older conversation does not fit thinking mode, Jarvis 007 answers in normal mode with a one-line notice.

## [0.89.2] - 2026-10-10
### Improved
- **When a bot says it cannot see a photo, the bot card says why.** The reason used to stay in the server log, so a bot running on a VPS said it could not see the photo and the owner had no way to know what to fix. The warning line on the bot card now gives one of four reasons: the photo message carried no link, downloading the photo from Zalo failed (with the exact error), the bot's brain does not take images (Antigravity, Grok Build: switch the bot to a model that can see images), or the model refused the image.

## [0.89.1] - 2026-10-10
### Fixed
- **A customer-care bot no longer silently drops groups past the 50th.** A bot used to remember only its first 50 groups, so newly approved customer groups reported success but never made it into the list and the bot stayed silent there. The group list is no longer cut. (Contributed by @nhuy288-8.)

## [0.89.0] - 2026-10-10
### Added
- **Resonance assistants learn from feedback, with checks.** React to an assistant's notice to suggest shorter or less disruptive updates; you preview the change and decide whether to apply it.
- **When stuck, the assistant tries one other method, only if the goal's budget covers both the trial and one more pass on the deliverable,** compared with the old method on the same criteria; a losing or unclear result keeps the old method.
- **Every lesson has a source, a scope and a revoke button.** After you revoke or dismiss a suggestion, Jarvis 007 waits 14 days before suggesting the same change again. Feedback never marks a goal done by itself and never grants more permissions or budget.

## [0.88.6] - 2026-10-10
### Fixed
- **The Zalo bot card states the real reason when the Zalo connection drops.** The card used to show only a technical config line like `process closed stdout ([mcp] Config loaded: ...)`, with the real reason cut off. It now says it in plain words. If Zalo closed the session because the account was just opened somewhere else (Zalo Web in a browser, or another Jarvis 007 machine signed in to the same account), the card says to close the other one and that Jarvis 007 reconnects in about 2 minutes. If the Zalo sign-in expired, it says to sign in again with the QR code on the Connections page. Any other error shows the end of the message, where the real reason is.

## [0.88.5] - 2026-10-10
### Improved
- **Conversations with many goal cards open faster.** Cards of the same goal share one load instead of one each, and are redrawn once.
- **Opening a goal card no longer makes other pages wait.** Jarvis 007 reads goal state on a separate thread and only reads what the card shows, so goals with a long history still open quickly.
- **You can see how long Jarvis 007 spends on each request.** Every response carries a `Server-Timing` header, to tell slowness in Jarvis 007 from slowness in the network or proxy (Cloudflare).

## [0.88.4] - 2026-10-09
### Fixed
- **The Partners page no longer shows up empty now and then even though the brain has assistants.** Opening the app straight on this page, Jarvis 007 does not know the brain yet, so it loads the default brain's list (empty), then loads again once the real brain is known. If the first load came back later, it overwrote the right list and the page said there were no partners yet. Results from an outdated load are now dropped. If the server reports an error while loading the list, the page shows the error with a Retry button instead of pretending the list is empty.

## [0.88.3] - 2026-10-09
### Fixed
- **A bot in a Zalo group sees the photo when a customer sends a plain photo and then calls the bot.** A photo without a caption used to be dropped on arrival, so the most common way to ask, a photo followed by "@bot take a look", made the bot say it had not seen any photo. A photo with a few words of caption worked, which made it look random. The bot now remembers a plain photo for 3 minutes and sees it when that person calls the bot.
  - In Auto-evaluate mode, an untagged message like "look at the photo above" that the bot decides to answer also comes with the photo.
  - A brief failure downloading the photo from Zalo (a network blip, a photo not ready yet) is retried once instead of reporting the photo as unseen right away.

## [0.88.2] - 2026-10-09
### Fixed
- **Old ChatGPT chats recover by themselves after moving to another machine or VPS.** The Codex session files stay on the old machine, so an old chat kept failing with "no rollout found" while a new chat worked fine. Jarvis 007 already rebuilds the context from chat history in this case, but did not recognise this error, especially when Codex only printed it and exited. Jarvis 007 now recognises it and rebuilds once. Sign-in, usage limit and network errors are still reported as before. (Reported by @dev23072005, issue #595.)

## [0.88.1] - 2026-10-09
### Fixed
- **Assistants with accented Vietnamese names open their Settings tab on the Partners page.** An assistant whose name had Vietnamese accents always showed "Could not load this assistant", and could not be deleted or exported either, because its file name kept the accents while the read step only accepted plain letters. Existing assistants now work normally, and new ones get a file name without accents. The Studio starter set also no longer fails to find its reviewer assistant in the verify step.

## [0.88.0] - 2026-10-09
### Improved
- **Resonance assistants call the model only for a reason.** A new task, new feedback from you, or a retry still within its limit. While waiting on you they sleep; periodic reviews are code-only checks that back off to once a week.
- **No pointless retries.** Two attempts in a row without progress pause retries until you give feedback; errors are retried at most 3 times; automatic retries always leave one call for your feedback.
- **Files you edit by hand are not overwritten or redone.** Jarvis 007 tells you once and re-checks on its own; a paused goal still watches its protective conditions, and turning an assistant off says clearly that watching stopped.
- **The goal card shows why the assistant woke up** and its recent wake-ups, with or without a model call.

## [0.87.0] - 2026-10-08
### Added
- **Resonance per assistant.** Each assistant has its own switch on the Team page. Only an assistant with it on sets and pursues goals; regular chat no longer creates goals. The assistant's right panel lists the goals it is pursuing.
### Changed
- **The per-brain Resonance switch is no longer used.** Goals set before this version wait under "Waiting for assignment" in Settings and do not run until you assign them to an assistant.
- **Deleting and recreating an assistant with the same name makes a new assistant.** It must be turned on again; old goals and conversations stay with the old one. Turning it on in a conversation opened before that prompts you to open a new conversation.

## [0.86.2] - 2026-10-08
### Fixed
- **Settings are no longer wiped when you open the WhatsApp tab or allow someone to message a bot.** Since 0.71.0, three places meant to save one small piece but overwrote the whole settings file: opening the WhatsApp tab on the Admin channels page for the first time, allowing a Zalo chat, and allowing a Slack, WhatsApp, Discord or Lark user. Each time, the HTTPS domain, API keys, the Telegram connection and every other setting were lost. A Docker install with its own domain could also lose HTTPS after the next reverse proxy restart. All three now update only their own part. Thanks to the DaoVix team for reviewing the code and sending a detailed bug report.
- **The settings file is written more safely.**
  - Writes are atomic: a machine shutting down mid-save no longer leaves a broken file.
  - A backup of the last good save is kept in `settings.json.bak`. If the file is broken, Jarvis 007 reads the backup instead of quietly falling back to defaults and writing them over it, and keeps the broken copy for manual recovery.
  - Several saves at once no longer overwrite each other's changes.

## [0.86.1] - 2026-10-08
### Improved
- **With ChatGPT as the brain, the chat shows the step Jarvis 007 is working on right away instead of going quiet until it finishes.** When Codex ran a long command (installing packages, scanning files, running a script), the chat used to show only "Jarvis 007 is thinking..." counting up until the command finished, which looked like a hang. The step now appears the moment it starts, like "Running command: npm install", and is marked done when it finishes, just as with Claude.

## [0.86.0] - 2026-10-08
### Added
- **Resonance: Jarvis 007 follows a task through until it is done.** When you hand over work that continues after the chat turn, Jarvis 007 sets a goal with a clear finish line, works on it in the background within its budget, reports done only with evidence, and keeps the goal across restarts. The feature ships off and is turned on per brain.
- **A "What I'm working toward" card in the chat.** Tap Right or Not quite for how Jarvis 007 understood you, Accepted for the result, or pause it. Feedback you add in chat attaches to the same goal and Jarvis 007 revises the version you actually saw; a draft Jarvis 007 writes during the chat turn is kept as the first version instead of being rewritten.
- **Try a new method before switching.** Jarvis 007 compares its current way of working with one alternative on the same set of cases and switches only when the new one clearly wins; without enough evidence it keeps the current method.
### Fixed
- **A chat turn that lands while Claude Code is refreshing its sign-in now says it can simply be resent.** Newer Claude Code reports this with a different message that Jarvis 007 used to show raw in English; normal answers that happen to contain "already used" are no longer replaced by that error note.

## [0.85.11] - 2026-10-08
### Fixed
- **The chat no longer sits on "Jarvis 007 is thinking..." when the connection dies silently.** A sleeping laptop, a Wi-Fi switch or a flaky network can kill the link between the page and Jarvis 007 without the browser noticing. Jarvis 007 still finished the work, but the answer never reached the page, so "thinking" kept counting and you had to resend the command. The page now checks in with Jarvis 007 after a stretch of silence. If nothing answers, it reconnects by itself and pulls in the answer that is already done. The Stop button also always reaches Jarvis 007, even when the connection is dead.

## [0.85.10] - 2026-10-08
### Fixed
- **A ChatGPT Live call in Vietnamese gets its answers in Vietnamese, no more sudden switch to English.** To look something up, ChatGPT Live rewrites the request and hands it to the main brain, sometimes in English. The main brain answered in the language of that rewrite, and Live then read the English answer aloud, which sounded like the voice changing mid-call. The main brain now answers in the language you actually spoke. Speak English and it still answers in English, and a language pinned in Settings still comes first. The same fix covers background jobs handed off from the regular talk mode.

## [0.85.9] - 2026-10-08
### Fixed
- **Update now on Docker keeps spinning until the new version is up, then reloads the page, with no false error.** The page used to wait only about 36 seconds and then say "The new version has not come up after a while - it may have failed", while Watchtower was still pulling the new version; a little later the page reloaded onto it anyway. The page now waits up to 10 minutes. Past 45 seconds it says plainly that the new version is still being pulled, which can take a few minutes on a slow machine. Real errors (Watchtower reports a failure, no new image yet) still show right away. The "Reload / Later" bar no longer pops up in the middle of an update either.

## [0.85.8] - 2026-10-08
### Added
- **Plugins know who is talking in a tool call.** The `pre_tool_call` and `post_tool_call` hooks get a new `turn` key (channel, sender, group or private, whether it is the owner), so a plugin wrapping an app with per-staff permissions can run tools with the rights of the person messaging the bot. The identity comes from the real message, never from what the model writes, and a bot is never treated as the owner. (Contributed by @nnbaonam96.)

## [0.85.7] - 2026-10-08
### Fixed
- **Brain sync with GitHub no longer fails on its very first push from a machine whose system language is not English.** When the GitHub repo was still empty, Jarvis 007 read git's messages in the OS language and missed that case. It now talks to git in a neutral locale, so bootstrapping works regardless of the machine's language. (Contributed by @dev23072005.)

## [0.85.5] - 2026-10-07
### Improved
- **No more caps on the bot speaking up on its own in groups.** In auto mode the bot used to auto-reply at most 8 times per group and 3 times per person per hour, with a pause between turns. Speaking or staying quiet is now decided by the reply judge and the model, following the Agent's role and the documents; tune it with Right/Wrong in the reply judge.
- The bot still waits a beat and yields when you are typing by hand from that same account. A busy group will use more model usage; to cut it, switch that group back to answering only when called by name.

## [0.85.4] - 2026-10-07
### Improved
- **Bots no longer cap answers at 20 per person per hour.** Anyone who messages the bot directly or calls it by name gets an answer; the "you are typing too fast" reply is gone.
- The limit on the bot speaking up on its own in a group nobody called it in (auto mode) stays, so it does not flood groups. With no cap, one person messaging non-stop keeps spending model usage; if something looks off, take over that chat.

## [0.85.3] - 2026-10-07
### Fixed
- **Bots at Full power now run exactly like the admin channel.** This level used to take the bot's narrow route: with Grok Build and Antigravity the bot could use no tool at all, and with Claude Code it could not see the Gmail, Drive and calendar connections of the Claude account. A Full power bot now has the same brain, tools, MCP and skills as when you chat directly, keeping only the Agent's role.
- So Full power now also grants running commands on the server and reading every file. The warning before turning it on says so: only use it for a bot that only you or people you fully trust can message.
- Replies through Telegram, Zalo, Slack... from Grok Build or Antigravity are now saved properly to history and memory instead of being recorded as an error.

## [0.85.1] - 2026-10-07
### Improved
- **The Docker edition installs Antigravity CLI and Grok Build by itself.** These two cards on the Models page used to say "CLI not installed" with a command to type, and a Hostinger install has nowhere to type it. Jarvis 007 now installs them at startup, once, and keeps them across updates.
- While installing, the card says "Jarvis 007 is installing" instead of showing a command. If the install fails (no Internet on the server), the card says so and how to retry. Turn it off with `JAVIS_AUTO_INSTALL_CLIS=0`.

## [0.85.0] - 2026-10-07
### Added
- **Chat with Jarvis 007 from Lark/Feishu and Discord.** Both new channels connect outwards, so they run on a laptop too, no domain needed. A stranger who messages the bot gets a pairing code; click Allow and you are done.
### Improved
- **The "Channels" page is now "Admin channels"**, so it is not mixed up with the customer bots on the Chatbot page, and each channel has its own tab with a dot showing which ones are running.
- **The confusing "Enable bot" checkbox is gone.** Each tab now starts with an On/Off switch that works immediately, the button at the bottom says what it does ("Save and turn on" or "Save changes"), and a missing field is named.

## [0.84.10] - 2026-10-07
### Fixed
- **Dedicated bots now read the Google Docs and Google Sheets links attached to their Agent.** Bots used to search only brain files, so an Agent told to "answer only from the documents" with its price list on Google Sheets said "no information" about every product.
- Spreadsheets are read tab by tab, every row with its column names. Edits on Google reach the bot within a few minutes. Works at every permission level, no need to raise the bot to Can write.
- The file must be shared with "Anyone with the link". An unshared file shows a yellow warning on the bot card naming the link. A link a customer pastes into a message is never opened.

## [0.84.8] - 2026-10-07
### Improved
- The Chatbots guide now states the actual limit: the bot answers each person at most 20 times an hour, counted per person in groups, and the number cannot be changed on the Chatbots page yet.

## [0.84.7] - 2026-10-06
### Added
- **Approve people asking to join a Zalo group from Jarvis 007.** When someone asks to join a group that requires approval, Jarvis 007 tells you through the bell and Telegram. Ask "who is waiting to join group X" to see the list, then say "approve everyone" or "approve Lan, reject Minh" and Jarvis 007 does it and reports back per person.
- A dedicated bot never approves on its own. The Zalo account must be the group's owner or a deputy, with the Zalo connection at Full access.

## [0.84.6] - 2026-10-06
### Fixed
- **A group bot no longer tells someone asking for the first time that they are "typing too fast".** The hourly reply limit used to be shared by the whole group, so once a busy group had called the bot 20 times, anyone who tagged it next was turned away with their name tagged. The limit now counts per person, as the setting says.

## [0.84.3] - 2026-10-06
### Added
- **Dedicated bots can send images to customers.** Tell the Agent when to send which image (e.g. "when asked about shirts, send `![Shirt](attachments/shirt.jpg)`") and the bot sends the real image right after its reply. Works on personal Zalo, Telegram, Slack and WhatsApp, at every permission level.
- Only real images inside the bot's own brain are sent, at most 4 per reply and 10 MB each. Documents such as PDFs are not sent, and the bot never attaches anything other than images the Agent named on purpose.

## [0.84.2] - 2026-10-06
### Added
- **See who joined a Zalo group and when.** Ask "who joined group X this week" and Jarvis 007 answers with names and join times, including people your own account added. The log survives restarts.
- **Bots receive a "new member joined" event.** In a group the bot is allowed in, its Agent follows the instructions you wrote (welcome, a question) and what it sends tags the newcomer. Jarvis 007 has no greeting of its own: if the Agent was told nothing about newcomers, the bot stays silent.
- Zalo only reports joins while connected, and the member list has no join date, so people who joined before this feature or while the machine was off have no join time.

## [0.83.2] - 2026-10-06
### Security
- **Bots can no longer be steered by invisible characters.** A stranger could slip instructions into a message using characters that do not show on screen (hidden characters, text-direction overrides), so the bot read them while the owner saw nothing in the inbox. Every message from Telegram, Zalo and customer bots is now cleaned of them before it reaches the brain and before it is saved.
### Improved
- **A broken connection no longer makes Jarvis 007 sit and wait.** When a source has just failed to start, further calls to it within a minute get an error right away instead of each one waiting up to a minute to fail. A successful Check on the Connections page puts the source back in use at once.

## [0.83.1] - 2026-10-05
### Fixed
- **On Windows, file paths in replies are clickable again.** When Jarvis 007 says "Saved to C:\...\post-1.txt" without backticks, the chat now turns it into a link that opens the file, as it already did on Linux and macOS.
- **On Windows, changing the time zone in Settings now takes effect.** Any zone other than Vietnam used to fall back to Vietnam time without a word, because Windows has no time zone table. The update installs it.

## [0.83.0] - 2026-10-05
### Improved
- **Zalo runs Jarvis 007's own build.** The personal Zalo connection now uses `javis-zalo`, which Jarvis 007 maintains and fixes itself, instead of a third-party tool. Accounts already signed in by QR switch over on their own, no new scan needed.
- **Group message history works.** The brain can read older messages in groups as well as private chats, see who replied to whom and who was tagged, and find every message from one person or within a date range.
- When the QR code expires or Zalo rejects it, the sign-in window says why, instead of reporting success and then not working.
### Security
- The Zalo QR sign-in page no longer sends the machine's IP address to an outside service, and opening a browser or file no longer goes through a shell, so an odd file name cannot inject a command.

## [0.82.0] - 2026-10-05
### Improved
- **Third-party MCP connections always run the latest official release.** Google Search Console, Google Workspace, Google Tasks, Google Keep, NotebookLM and Google Ads move to each new release as the publisher ships it, instead of staying on whatever version a machine downloaded first.
- **Connections made earlier move to the new command too.** Each connection used to keep the command it was created with, so app fixes never reached machines that were already connected (old Zalo connections ran an unpinned version, old Google Sheets ones missed a fix). A command you edited by hand is kept.
- **Google Ads no longer needs Git.** Jarvis 007 runs Google's official PyPI release instead of unreleased code from GitHub, and the Google Cloud Project ID box is gone because nothing reads it.
### Security
- **Google Workspace can no longer run Apps Script at the Draft level.** The new Workspace release added a tool that runs Apps Script functions, and Jarvis 007 had filed it as read-only. It now needs Full access, and the tools that import files into Docs, Sheets and Slides count as writes.
- Gateway connections (one tool that runs many commands, like the new Hostinger release) are checked per command inside: reads run at Read-only, unknown commands count as dangerous.

## [0.81.1] - 2026-10-05
### Fixed
- **A mismatched encryption key no longer wipes your connections.** API keys, the ChatGPT login and the Telegram token are encrypted with the machine's own key. When that key did not match (volume recreated, key file lost), a single settings save, or the first startup after an update, used to overwrite them with empty values for good. Jarvis 007 now keeps the old encrypted values, so putting the right key back restores every connection.
- With the right key nothing changes: clearing or changing a key works as before, and a key you type again is always saved.

## [0.81.0] - 2026-10-05
### Added
- **Bots look at customer photos with their own brain.** The photo goes straight into the chat turn for Claude, GPT, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, Ollama, the ChatGPT plan or the Claude Code plan to see, no longer depending on ChatGPT describing it. Photos are stored in the bot's brain and cleaned up like every other download.
- **Telegram reads photos in groups.** A photo with the bot tagged in the caption, a reply to a photo that tags the bot, or a photo sent just before tagging the bot (within 3 minutes, same person) all work. A logo sent as a File counts as a photo too.
- A brain that cannot see images (Antigravity, Grok Build, text-only models) makes the bot say plainly that it cannot see the photo, never guessing. If a model rejects the image, Jarvis 007 resends the text so the customer still gets an answer.
### Fixed
- The Telegram bot used to say it could read photos while it actually received only a file path line, which also leaked a server path to the model. That line is now removed before it reaches the bot.

## [0.80.1] - 2026-10-05
### Fixed
- **Picking drive C in the brain folder picker no longer hangs on "Loading...".** Jarvis 007 counted note files inside every subfolder, and `C:\Windows` alone holds hundreds of thousands of files, so the scan never finished. Each folder now gets a short counting budget, so drive C opens within a few seconds.

## [0.80.0] - 2026-10-05
### Added
- **A new bot permission level: Reads documents.** It sits between Read only and Can write: the bot searches, lists and opens documents in its own brain, so when a customer uses different words than the document ("money back" vs "refund") it still finds the answer instead of saying it has no information.
- **Still no writing and no data sources.** The bot gets three read-only tools, opens only the documents the pre-search already uses (no `memory/`, no customer uploads, no internal agent instructions), and only in its own brain. That is why this level needs no risk consent tick.
- **The reply judge sees the table of contents too.** At this level a group message that misses the keyword search is no longer silenced straight away; the judge decides whether it fits a document's topic.
- The **Try** button runs this level as is. A bot on the ChatGPT plan may not be able to call tools yet; then the bot card shows a yellow strip and that turn answers as Read only.

## [0.78.0] - 2026-10-05
### Added
- **A Try button on each bot card.** Type a message as a customer would (private or in a group, tagging the bot or not) and see right away whether the bot would reply or stay silent, why, what it would say and which documents it used.
- **Nothing goes out.** A try sends nothing to Zalo or Telegram, writes nothing to the Inbox, does not skew the reply judge's self-learning, and runs read-only so the bot never places an order or sends a real message.
- If a Telegram bot still has privacy mode on, the result says so: in a real group that message would not reach the bot.

## [0.77.2] - 2026-10-05
### Fixed
- **The Telegram warning on a bot card no longer breaks apart.** Each bold phrase used to become its own narrow column, one word per line. It now reads as a normal paragraph.
- **The Telegram privacy mode steps are complete.** After disabling it in @BotFather you must remove the bot from the group and add it again; that step was missing, so following the old steps still left the bot silent in groups.

## [0.77.1] - 2026-10-05
### Fixed
- **Changing the admin password on Hostinger now works.** `JAVIS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` used to apply only when no admin existed, so changing it in the Environment box and redeploying still said "Wrong username or password". Now, when the env value differs from last time, Jarvis 007 resets the account to it; 2FA stays on and old sessions are signed out.
- An unchanged env touches nothing, so a password you change in the dashboard is not overwritten on every restart. This is also the way to recover a forgotten password on a VPS, no SSH needed.
### Improved
- **An eye button on the sign-in password field** so you can check what you typed.

## [0.77.0] - 2026-10-05
### Added
- **The group bot's reply judge reviews and tunes itself.** Once enough feedback has gathered, Jarvis 007 gives the bot's numbers to your main brain (the strongest model you picked) to find repeated patterns, and it changes at most 3 things: lessons, examples, each group's threshold, eagerness. You get one message whenever it changes something.
- **Wrong turns undo themselves.** After each review the bot is measured again: if it is marked wrong more often, that review is undone. Issues that need a code change are written to `Javis/gop-y-bo-phan-xu.md`.
- **To adjust it, just tell Jarvis 007.** "Why is my bot so quiet?", "let the bot answer for me when customers tag me about class times", "undo the last review": Jarvis 007 reads the real numbers and makes the change. Customer-facing bots never see these tools.
### Fixed
- Messages that start by **@tagging someone else** (say, a customer tagging the owner about the bot's topic) used to be ignored no matter how often you marked them wrong. A thumbs-down now works, and the self-review can turn on considering such messages.

## [0.76.0] - 2026-10-05
### Improved
- **The Skills page is easier to use.** Each skill has its own on/off switch on the right, so there are no longer two look-alike checkboxes where a wrong click turned a skill off. Click a skill to open its details: description, "When to use", usage, and Edit, Export, Delete.
- **Pick several skills to take elsewhere.** A checkbox at the start of every card is always there; pick some and an "Export N skills" button appears. The .zip imports into another Jarvis 007, or unzip it into a .claude folder and Claude Code uses it right away. The other way round, importing a bundle with several skill folders now brings them all in, not just the first.
- **Filter and sort:** show On, Off or System skills, sort by Most used or Name. Duplicate groups such as "ai" and "AI" are merged, and saving a skill fixes its group name.
- **Fixes:** turning a skill on or off on page 3 no longer jumps back to page 1. The description box counts characters and warns as soon as it passes 150 (the part Jarvis 007 cannot read is shown in red), and a failed save now says why instead of closing the form as if it had saved.

## [0.75.1] - 2026-10-05
### Improved
- **The theme now defaults to Auto.** A device that never picked a theme turns light at 06:00 and dark at 18:00 by itself, instead of staying dark all day. If you already picked Dark or Light by hand, that choice stays.

## [0.74.2] - 2026-10-04
### Fixed
- **ChatGPT no longer dies on the first turn with "Could not find home directory".** On some Windows computers Codex could not find the user folder, so it missed the ChatGPT sign-in even though the Models page showed it as connected. Jarvis 007 now tells Codex where that folder is, so chat, the model list and ChatGPT Live work there.
- **If it still happens, the error says what to do**: sign out of Windows and back in, or restart, instead of one cryptic English line.

## [0.74.1] - 2026-10-04
### Fixed
- **The Zalo bot can see the images customers send.** Tag the bot on a photo (like "@YourBot here it is") and it no longer replies "I can only read the caption": Jarvis 007 saves the photo into the bot's brain and has ChatGPT on your signed-in plan look at it and describe it, so the bot answers from what the photo actually shows. It also works when you press "Reply for me" in the Inbox.
- **Without ChatGPT signed in, the bot still replies as before**, from the caption, and says plainly it could not see the photo, never guessing what is in it.

## [0.74.0] - 2026-10-04
### Added
- **The theme can follow the clock.** In **Settings → General → Theme** pick Dark, Light or Auto. On Auto the page turns light at the morning time and dark at the evening time by itself, 06:00 and 18:00 by default, and you can change both.
- **Each device chooses for itself.** Your phone can stay on Auto while your computer stays dark. The moon button in the top bar still switches by hand; pick Auto again in Settings to go back.

## [0.73.0] - 2026-10-04
### Added
- **Jarvis 007 can see the images people post in a Zalo group.** Ask something like "look at the receipt Lan just posted in the Sales group" and Jarvis 007 fetches it, shows it right in chat and says what is in it, copying text and numbers verbatim. Images come straight from Zalo, so the 2-hour limit is gone.
- **Every brain can see images.** Claude Code and Codex open the image themselves. OpenRouter, Gemini and the other API engines have ChatGPT on your signed-in plan look at it and describe it, no API key needed, for any image in the brain, not only Zalo ones.
### Improved
- **The extra Zalo tools moved to the "Zalo extras" pack on Jarvis 007 Store.** Sending images, tagging people, notes, reminders, polls and reading group images no longer ship inside the app, so people who do not use Zalo do not carry them. Jarvis 007 offers the pack right after you scan the Zalo QR.
- **Already using Zalo?** Open the Connections page and press **Install companion pack** once to get every tool back. The Zalo connection, the Inbox and the Zalo chatbot keep working without it.

## [0.72.1] - 2026-10-04
### Fixed
- **When Claude Code is too slow to start, Jarvis 007 now says where it got stuck instead of guessing "probably a data source".** The error now tells you whether Claude Code reached Jarvis 007's tool hub at all, whether the hub answered fast or slow, and quotes the line Claude Code itself printed, such as an expired sign-in. The verdict comes first, so it stays readable on the bot card.
- **The error no longer says "the allowed limit" from the second turn on.** It always names the real number of seconds.
- Full details of every timeout are also written to the server log on a `[claude init timeout]` line.

## [0.71.2] - 2026-10-04
### Fixed
- **A ChatGPT Live call no longer goes silent while Jarvis 007 works on something long.** Every follow-up question used to wait behind the running job, so "are you done yet?" got no answer, and when the job finished Jarvis 007 read out a pile of stale replies. Now a progress question is answered at once from the real state: what is running, for how long, and which step it is on.
- **A new request no longer waits for the old one.** Asking for something else while Jarvis 007 is still working runs it alongside, and each result is read out as it arrives.
- **Jarvis 007 speaks up during long jobs.** Past one minute, about every minute and a half, Jarvis 007 says a short line that it is still working, whenever you are not talking. These lines are not saved to the chat history.

## [0.71.1] - 2026-10-03
### Fixed
- **The Models page lists the newest ChatGPT models, such as GPT-6.1-Sol.** On a machine with both Codex Desktop and the Codex CLI, Jarvis 007 always asked the copy bundled with Codex Desktop, even when it was months old, so the model list stopped at an older generation. Jarvis 007 now picks the newest Codex on the machine.

## [0.71.0] - 2026-10-03
### Added
- **Chat with Jarvis 007 on Slack and WhatsApp.** Turn them on from the Channels page, like Telegram and Zalo. Slack even runs on a laptop with no domain; WhatsApp uses Meta's official API and needs Jarvis 007 on an HTTPS domain.
- **Customer bots on Slack and WhatsApp.** Add an account on the Chatbot page and an agent answers whoever writes in, with every chat in the shared inbox and takeover, as with Telegram and Zalo.
- **Strangers never reach your brain.** An empty allow-list lets nobody in: whoever writes gets a pairing code and you click Allow once. Background work handed over from Slack or WhatsApp reports back there.
- **A step-by-step guide** in docs/en/29-slack-whatsapp.md, with a Slack app manifest you paste and go.

## [0.70.2] - 2026-10-03
### Security
- **The sign-in screen now fully covers the dashboard.** It used to sit over the dashboard behind a blur, so you could still make out the layout underneath, most clearly in the light theme. The backdrop is now solid: until you sign in, all you see is the sign-in box. Your data was already blocked by the server; this hides the rest.

## [0.70.1] - 2026-10-03
### Improved
- **The README explains why your data stays yours.** "Why Jarvis 007" now covers the lock-in of keeping all your work on one AI vendor, and lists where each thing you build up (chat history, memory, skills, agents, workflows) lives on your machine, so a new model is a switch, not a fresh start.
- **A row of flags at the top of the README.** Twelve flags, each linking to its translation. Emoji flags show as letters on Windows; these are real images.

## [0.70.0] - 2026-10-03
### Improved
- **Five animated diagrams in the README:** one-command install, a swappable brain that keeps every tool, one chat message turning into the right action, a growing Second Brain, and work running overnight. They are light, sharp on phones, and hold still when the device asks for reduced motion.
- **The README in 7 more languages:** Hindi, Portuguese, Korean, Russian, German, French and Indonesian, 12 in all. Language bars are generated from one list, so they never miss a language or point at a missing page.

## [0.69.0] - 2026-10-03
### Improved
- **The README now also comes in Chinese, Spanish and Japanese**, and so does the quick start. Each says plainly that it is a machine translation, that Jarvis 007 replies in any language, and that the interface is in English and Vietnamese.
- **Stale translations get flagged.** After an edit to the English README, GitHub points out which translations need updating, without blocking a release.
- **The website folder is gone.** The landing page will live elsewhere, which keeps the repo lean.

## [0.68.1] - 2026-10-03
### Improved
- **The GitHub page shows a real brain.** The screenshot at the top of the README and the link preview image now show the graph of a brain with more than 1,600 notes, instead of an empty one.

## [0.68.0] - 2026-10-03
### Improved
- **The Updates page speaks English.** Devices reading in English see the release notes in English from 0.66.0 on; older releases still show in Vietnamese.
- **Open to international contributors.** The repo now has an English contributing guide, an architecture overview and a glossary of the Vietnamese names used in the code, plus forms for bug reports, feature requests and translation offers.
- **A security policy and a code of conduct.** Security problems are reported privately, never in a public issue.

## [0.67.0] - 2026-10-02
### Improved
- **Jarvis 007 now speaks English all the way through.** Error messages, the Models page, the connection store (descriptions, guides, permission warnings), the Plugins page and newly created brains all appear in English when your browser is set to English. Vietnamese users see exactly what they saw before.
- **One language per device.** A phone set to Vietnamese and a laptop set to English each see their own language, including the text that comes back from the server.
- **The website has an English version**, with the Vietnamese one a click away under "Tiếng Việt" in the menu.

## [0.66.0] - 2026-10-02
### Improved
- **The GitHub page is now in English**, with real screenshots, a table of the 12 brains and a language bar. The Vietnamese version is complete too, one click away at the top of the page.
- **The interface follows your browser's language** on a device that has not picked one yet. A device already using Vietnamese keeps it.
- **Anything not translated yet shows in English** instead of Vietnamese, so people reading in another language can still follow it.
- **The Linux/macOS install and update scripts print their messages in English.**

## [0.65.33] - 2026-10-02
### Fixed
- **When you ask the AI to edit an image, the chat shows the new image right away.** Before, if the AI edited an image and overwrote the same path, the chat kept showing the old image until you reloaded the page, because the browser reused the already loaded image. Now each reply carries its own image version, so a just-edited image is always loaded fresh; old messages stay as they were, and reloading the page does not reload the images.

## [0.65.32] - 2026-10-02
### Added
- **The file editor has a word and character counter** at the end of the toolbar, updating as you type. For `.md` notes it counts only the visible text, not formatting marks (`#`, `**`, links). Hover the number to see the character count without spaces.

## [0.65.31] - 2026-10-02
### Improved
- **The Quick-reply brain and Model boxes only show when the call runs on the Basic route.** With ChatGPT Live, ChatGPT listens and answers by itself, so showing that box (for example set to Antigravity) made it look as if Antigravity was answering. If the Automatic route has to fall back to the Basic route, the box still shows, because it is really in use then.

## [0.65.30] - 2026-10-02
### Added
- **Share links have names.** A new link takes its name from the file title (the `.html` page title, the `.md` note title), instead of a whole batch all named "index.html". On the Share page tap **Rename** to set a different name; links already sent stay the same. The search box finds links by name.

### Fixed
- **iPhone, opening Jarvis 007 from the home screen: the file editor toolbar is no longer hidden under the status bar.** The editor leaves the right amount of top margin for the clock and battery, and the Close button is always tappable.
- **Dragging a photo you just took into the chat box on iPhone now sends.** Before, the photo showed on the chip but sending failed, because iPhone only lets you read a dropped photo at the moment of the drop. Jarvis 007 now copies the photo as soon as you drop it; a photo that cannot be read is reported clearly on the chip.

## [0.65.29] - 2026-10-02
### Fixed
- **With a file open in the editor, your spoken lines are still answered by the quick-reply brain you chose.** Before, whenever a file was open, every spoken line in a call quietly switched to the main brain: slower (about 18 seconds instead of 2 to 5) and not using Antigravity even though you had chosen it.
- Asking "why did you answer in English?" is no longer taken as the command "answer in English".

## [0.65.28] - 2026-10-02
### Fixed
- **During a call, talking over Jarvis 007 no longer stops its answer.** Before, on the Basic route, saying one more sentence while Jarvis 007 was answering showed "This turn was stopped" and cut the answer, and talking a lot meant constant cuts. Now the answer is always written in full; the extra sentence you say is kept and Jarvis 007 answers it right after it finishes reading. Interrupting or saying "stop" only makes Jarvis 007 stop reading. The call ends only when you hang up.

## [0.65.27] - 2026-10-02
### Fixed
- **The Update now button on Docker/VPS no longer gets stuck on "Already updating, wait a moment".** Pressing it right after a new version came out, the Docker image might not be built yet (usually 2 to 5 minutes), so the machine pulled the old version again and locked the button for 15 minutes. Jarvis 007 now checks the image first and says "still being built, try again in a few minutes". If Watchtower finishes without replacing the version, the page says why and the button works again right away.

## [0.65.26] - 2026-10-02
### Fixed
- **Fixed the Antigravity voice brain reporting "invalid model selection".** After changing the brain in 0.65.25, the model name of the old brain (for example a ChatGPT model) was wrongly sent to Antigravity. Now each brain remembers its own model, and a stray old model name is ignored in favor of the default model. It was not because you were signed out.
- When the error is about the model name, the message in the chat points to the Model box instead of the Models page.

### Added
- **You can choose the model for the quick-reply brain**: the **Model** box right under the brain box in Settings, Voice, Advanced, lists the models that brain has (Antigravity, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Grok Build).

## [0.65.25] - 2026-10-02
### Fixed
- **During a ChatGPT Live call, Jarvis 007 no longer changes its voice by itself.** Before, when reconnecting after a pause failed, Jarvis 007 quietly switched to the Basic route and read in a different voice (female to male). Now Jarvis 007 stays on ChatGPT Live: it retries once, and if it still fails it shows one line and waits; speak again and it tries again.
- Reconnecting on iPhone can no longer hang at the step of turning on audio.

### Added
- **The quick-reply brain picker is back** in Settings, Voice, Advanced: Automatic, Main brain, or a specific brain. It is only used on the Basic route; with ChatGPT Live, ChatGPT listens and answers by itself.

## [0.65.24] - 2026-10-02
### Improved
- **Jarvis 007 reconnects faster after a pause.** As soon as it hears the first few words, Jarvis 007 starts reconnecting while you are still talking, and closes the sentence after 0.7 seconds of silence instead of 1.2. Measured on a test machine: from when you stop talking to when you hear Jarvis 007 dropped from about 5 seconds to about 2 seconds.

## [0.65.23] - 2026-10-01
### Fixed
- **ChatGPT Live reads answers one after another.** When a second result arrived while Jarvis 007 was still reading the first, the two used to be read mixed together like two voices on top of each other. Now Jarvis 007 finishes the sentence it is saying before reading the next.

## [0.65.22] - 2026-10-01
### Improved
- **Go quiet and it pauses; speak and Jarvis 007 reconnects by itself.** In a ChatGPT Live call, 30 seconds of silence (was 20) pauses the call to save usage; just keep talking and Jarvis 007 reconnects and answers that sentence right away. You no longer need to say "Jarvis 007", so no more calling over and over without reconnecting because the mic heard "David".
- **Keeps the screen on during a call**, so the phone does not lock the screen and cut the mic mid-call.
- Removed the "Focus during conversation" switch on the Voice page.

## [0.65.21] - 2026-10-01
### Fixed
- **ChatGPT Live no longer repeats answers.** Saying one more "ok, tell me when it's done" while waiting for Jarvis 007 to work used to make the main brain run a second time, producing two result bubbles with different wording. Now a confirmation runs nothing again; a sentence with a new request is done after the job already running.
- The summary Jarvis 007 reads aloud no longer appears as a second bubble, because the full version is already right above it.

## [0.65.20] - 2026-10-01
### Fixed
- **The "Update now" button works again on freshly installed VPS machines, especially Hostinger.** The bundled updater (Watchtower) used an old version that is no longer developed and talked to Docker with a version too old, so new Docker refused it and it restarted nonstop. It now uses a maintained version that negotiates the version with Docker by itself.
- Machines installed before this version need **one Redeploy** with the new compose file (Hostinger: Docker Manager, paste the compose URL again and Deploy). After that the update button runs by itself, with nothing to redo.

## [0.65.19] - 2026-10-01
### Improved
- **The Voice settings page is down to 3 boxes, and changes save by themselves.** The "In use" line says which route the call is running on and why, the **Jarvis 007 voice** box changes with the call route (with a preview button), and the **Focus** switch. Call route, reading speed and ElevenLabs are under Advanced.
- The machine handles the rest: listening language follows the interface language, interrupting by voice is always on, and the quick-reply brain is picked automatically from the plan you are signed in to (Antigravity, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Grok Build). Old settings keep working.
- Removed the "Read replies aloud" switch (it duplicated the mic button), the experimental conversation rhythm, the often-misheard words box and the OpenAI API key box on the Voice page (the key lives on the Models page).

## [0.65.18] - 2026-10-01
### Improved
- **Tap the mic to call Jarvis 007.** The mic button becomes a red Hang up button, and a call bar shows on the chat: listening, Jarvis 007 speaking or working, with a timer, a Mute mic button and Hang up. Esc also hangs up.
- Jarvis 007 picks the call route itself: ChatGPT Live once the ChatGPT plan is connected, then Live through an API key, otherwise the Basic route. If ChatGPT Live cannot open, the call switches to Basic instead of ending.
- The Space key no longer opens the mic, so nobody turns on listening by an accidental touch.

## [0.65.17] - 2026-10-01
### Added
- **ChatGPT Live: talk to Jarvis 007 through your ChatGPT plan, no API key needed.** Go to Settings → Voice, choose Live then ChatGPT Live. Speak continuously, Jarvis 007 replies in under a second, and you can interrupt any time.
- For a request that needs real data, Jarvis 007 hands it to the main brain you chose and reads a summary; the full version (with tables) shows as a bubble in the chat.
- There are 9 voices, default juniper, with a preview button. Calls count against the ChatGPT plan's limit.

## [0.65.16] - 2026-10-01
### Improved
- **The ChatGPT Live design.** Tap the mic to call Jarvis 007 like a phone call: continuous conversation, interrupt any time, runs on the ChatGPT plan with no API key, and heavy work still goes to the brain you chose. The voice settings page will be down to 3 boxes.
- Nothing changes in the interface in this version. 13 older voice design documents were merged into a single document.

## [0.65.15] - 2026-10-01
### Improved
- **Much better listening to Vietnamese sentences mixed with English.** With a Groq key, Jarvis 007 turns on "re-listening" by itself: a multilingual model listens to the audio again before the text is fixed into the bubble. Measured on 20 commands, the browser got 41% of words wrong, and through the re-listen it is 14%.
- The re-listen now runs on every turn: the very first sentence after opening the page, natural mode, and the "Hey Jarvis 007" that the browser hears as "Hey David".
- The Settings page has a **Re-listen** box (Auto / Groq / Off) with a line saying which listener is running and why.

## [0.65.14] - 2026-10-01
### Improved
- **The "Is owner" button in the Reply judge is easier to understand.** Renamed to "Make bot owner", with an explanation on hover. A person already set shows an "Owner" label, and the top of the menu lists the bot owners with a "Remove owner" button.
- **Right/Wrong now has an explanation.** One line says what it means, and hovering each button shows its meaning for that line (for example "The bot should have stayed quiet").

## [0.65.13] - 2026-10-01
### Fixed
- **A bot in a Zalo group also replies when you tag it in a photo caption.** Before, photo messages were skipped entirely, so "@Jarvis 007 Vũ ..." written in a photo caption never reached the bot. Now the caption is treated as the message text, and the bot knows the message came with a photo. A photo with no caption is still skipped.

## [0.65.12] - 2026-09-30
### Improved
- **Group chats keep only the 100 latest messages in the Inbox**, so the store does not grow forever and Jarvis 007 does not hold strangers' words longer than needed. Private chats with customers are still kept in full.
- The first time after updating, old groups are trimmed to 100 messages. Jarvis 007 backs up the store file once before trimming and deletes the backup after 14 days.
- **A bot in a group looks at the 30 latest messages to answer in context**, not just the one question being asked.

## [0.65.11] - 2026-09-30
### Improved
- **The Inbox loads gradually, easier on the machine.** The conversation list loads the first 40 rows and loads more as you scroll. The message pane loads only the 40 newest messages, and scrolling up loads older ones without jumping from where you are reading.
- Every 5 seconds Jarvis 007 asks only for messages NEWER than the last one and appends them at the end of the pane, instead of reloading and redrawing all 200 messages. Reading old messages while a new one arrives no longer drags you back to the top.

## [0.65.10] - 2026-09-30
### Improved
- **The bot Inbox is tidier, with a bigger message pane.** Removed the four stat cards and the subtitle line at the top of the page. The title, two tabs, search box and filter boxes sit compactly at the top, while the list and message pane take all the remaining screen, each scrolling on its own.
- The unread count still shows on the tab, and "a real person is handling it" can be seen with the Status filter.

## [0.65.9] - 2026-09-30
### Improved
- **The Chatbot page has two tabs: Inbox and Bots.** Add a channel right in the Bots tab or in the New bot form, with no more jumping between "Bot channels" and "Create chatbot".
- Channels without a bot sit right under the bot list. Channels that already have a bot show as chips on the bot card; tap to edit or delete.
- The New bot form also shows channels held by another bot (greyed out, with the bot's name). The robot icon was replaced with a more familiar one.

## [0.65.8] - 2026-09-30
### Improved
- **A bot tags people in a Zalo group faster.** Jarvis 007 installs a copy of the Zalo tool in its own folder and runs it directly, instead of going through `npx` every time. On a test machine, startup dropped from about 3.1 seconds to 0.7 seconds.
- The first tag after updating still goes the old (slower) way while Jarvis 007 installs quietly in the background; from the next one it is fast. If the install fails, it still works as before.

## [0.65.7] - 2026-09-30
### Added
- **A bot in a Zalo group tags the person it is answering by itself.** When a customer asks, the bot opens with "@Name ...", and so does the "Reply for me" button. There is no setting.
- Each reply in a group is about 2 to 4 seconds slower. If tagging fails, the message still goes out as before, only the tag is lost.

## [0.65.6] - 2026-09-30
### Added
- **Jarvis 007 tags the right person in a Zalo group.** Just say the name (like "@minhquy") and Jarvis 007 finds the real Zalo ID itself. With a duplicate name or no match it asks back instead of guessing, because a wrong tag cannot be taken back.
- **Create group notes, reminders and polls on Zalo** right from chat, for every brain. Reminders show in Zalo so the whole group sees them.
### Fixed
- Sending a Zalo photo no longer says "sent" when Zalo rejects it.

## [0.65.5] - 2026-09-30
### Added
- **Inbox: the "Reply for me" button.** The bot answers the customer's last message right away with its own Agent, even if the reply judge chose silence earlier. The chat stays on Automatic, and the bot learns one more case so it speaks up by itself next time.
- **The "Suggest a reply" button:** the bot drafts into the input box for you to edit and send, leaving no trace if you walk away. A button that cannot be used yet still shows and says why when tapped. The status line is honest when the bot is off.

## [0.65.4] - 2026-09-30
### Improved
- **Inbox: the Automatic / I reply switch** at the top of each bot chat, replacing the small Take over button. Right above the input box a line says who is on duty. On phones the switch moves to its own row, easy to tap.
- **A "Bot silent: reason" line under the customer's last message**, with a Why button that opens the Reply judge panel directly. No need to open the menu to learn why the bot did not answer.

## [0.65.3] - 2026-09-30
### Improved
- **The bot Inbox has compact one-row dropdown filters:** by bot, status (unread, needs reply, I took over) and type (group or private chat). The conversation count sits right inside each option, and the filters are remembered next time.
- **Each row has a bot name tag** (one color per bot) when you run 2 or more bots. The "Needs reply" tag is attached only to private chats nobody has answered, and to groups where the bot just considered speaking and stayed quiet, not to every group that has a message.

## [0.65.2] - 2026-09-30
### Added
- **An "Automate everything" card in the Who the bot answers section.** One choice makes the bot answer every chat on the channel and decide for itself whether to speak or stay quiet in groups, replacing two settings. Bots already set up that way show this card automatically.
### Improved
- **The Auto-judge mode description now says the right thing** (the bot weighs the context, no longer talking about the old keyword gate), and the "Every chat" card is tidier.

## [0.65.1] - 2026-09-30
### Improved
- **The reply judge runs itself, with every setting box removed.** Choose Auto-judge and you are done. The machine picks the eagerness for each group, learns from the group's reactions, and drafts the role from the bot's Agent. You only tune it with the Right/Wrong buttons in the Reply judge menu.
- **The hand-written speak-up rules from the previous version** were merged into the bot's Lessons. To make the bot recognize one more name, call the bot and teach it in the group.
- **Conversations in a group carry the group's name** in the Agent's history, no longer the first message of the first sender. Old sessions are renamed when the group messages again.
- **Note:** a bot on Auto-judge uses the reply judge as soon as you update, and records the group's chat text (up to 400 characters per message, kept 14 days) to learn from. The Forget all button wipes it clean.

## [0.65.0] - 2026-09-30
### Added
- **A reply judge for bots in groups.** The bot decides by context whether to speak or stay quiet: it reads the last few messages, understands follow-ups, and each bot follows the role of its own Agent. Every decision is logged, even when the bot stays quiet (the "…" menu on the bot card, Reply judge section). Turn it on in the bot form by choosing Auto-judge; there is a Dry run mode to compare with the old rules first.
- **The bot learns from reactions in the group** (off by default, turned on per bot): if it gets asked again, next time it speaks up; if told "don't butt in", it speaks less. It only changes speaking versus staying quiet, only the owner's words become rules, and there is a Forget all button.
### Fixed
- **Calling the bot by plain name counts as calling it**, no @ needed ("nhi mai oi"). Before, the bot stayed silent without leaving any trace.
### Improved
- **The bot's conversations with customers moved to the Agent's history** (Partners page, with a Bot label), no longer in the Chat history.

## [0.64.86] - 2026-09-30
### Fixed
- **The Partners page no longer shows codes like `ws.tab_agent`, `sess.new_chat` in place of button names** when you reopen Jarvis 007 after an update. Labels now turn into text as soon as the text set finishes loading.
- **The top bar too:** the note and link counts no longer get stuck at `app.graph_stats`.

## [0.64.85] - 2026-09-30
### Added
- **Choose who the bot answers.** Three choices: every chat on the channel; anyone who messages privately while groups are chosen (as before); or only the people and groups you pick from the list taken from the Inbox.
### Improved
- **The bot form is tidier and nicer:** one scroll with four clear sections, button-style pickers, a more compact permission warning.
- **The bot card is tidier**, secondary buttons moved into the "…" menu, and the leftover "no recipient set" label is gone.

## [0.64.84] - 2026-09-30
### Fixed
- **The Zalo bot can now answer in groups.** Before, the answer showed in the Inbox but never reached the group, because Jarvis 007 sent the wrong parameter name to Zalo so every message went out like a private chat. Private chats stay as before.
- **New Zalo groups show the right group name** in the Inbox, no longer the name of the first sender.
- **Reading Zalo messages no longer starves when the buffer is full.** Before, every read started over from the beginning, so for an account in many busy groups new messages might never reach the bot.
- **Zalo send errors now show in the bot log** (Conversations tab), where before they flashed by for a few seconds and vanished.

## [0.64.83] - 2026-09-29
### Improved
- **The bot form is tidier: removed the "Chat ID of the person on duty for handoff" box** (that was a Telegram number, unusable for a Zalo bot). Bots that already had a person on duty keep running as before.
- **The "More settings" section says what is inside (language, groups) and opens by itself when the bot has a channel that can reach groups**, so you see Auto-judge mode right away.
### Fixed
- **The bot's Full power warning is more accurate.** Before it said "the only barrier left is the Agent file", but each connection's permission level on the Connections page still limits the bot at every level.

## [0.64.82] - 2026-09-29
### Added
- **Bots can answer in Zalo groups.** In an allowed group, tagging the bot's name or replying to the bot's message makes it answer. Before, every group message was skipped so even a tag got silence.
- **An "Auto-judge" mode in bot settings.** No tag needed: the bot checks whether a message is a question its documents can answer before speaking up. When members chat with each other, the bot stays quiet.
- The bot waits a moment to yield to you when you are typing yourself, has a limit on self-replies per hour, and every question the bot skips has a reason in the log so you can add documents.

## [0.64.81] - 2026-09-29
### Added
- **Typing `/` in the chat now offers 12 system commands**, working the same on every brain. `/status` shows which model is in use, `/model` changes the model, `/usage` shows tokens used, `/tasks` shows background jobs, `/memory` shows memory, `/export` downloads the conversation, plus `/help`, `/brain`, `/retry`.
- **`/compact` compresses a long conversation right away**, without waiting for the automatic threshold. **`/plan what-to-do`** makes Jarvis 007 only draw up a plan and do nothing outside yet.
- **`/goal the-goal`: Jarvis 007 keeps working round after round until done** (up to 8 rounds). Type a new message or press Stop to stop.
- **Telegram also has `/usage`, `/tasks`, `/memory` and `/plan`.**

## [0.64.80] - 2026-09-29
### Added
- **The bot answers by itself on personal Zalo.** Connect Zalo on the Connections page, then tap Create duty bot (or New bot and choose the personal Zalo channel). The bot decides whether to answer; private matters or messages that need no reply, it stays quiet. No need to switch on each person.
- To avoid messaging by mistake under your name: the bot only answers text private chats, skips groups, photos and old messages, and yields by itself when you are typing in that chat by hand.
### Improved
- **Renamed "Bot accounts" to "Bot channels"** in the tab, the New bot form and the guide lines to make it easier to understand. The New bot form now also shows personal Zalo to choose; before, it showed no channels at all.

## [0.64.79] - 2026-09-29
### Improved
- **The long code viewer in chat can now be edited in place.** Tap the code and type; when done, tap Copy or Download to get the edited version. Edits do not change the original message, closing the viewer restores the original, and a reminder line sits right below.
- **Removed the "Wrap" button.** Code always wraps to fit the frame, so that button no longer did anything.

## [0.64.78] - 2026-09-29
### Fixed
- **New Claude models (like Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5) now show up in Jarvis 007 by themselves.** Before, Claude Code on the machine did not update itself when it was only run in the background by Jarvis 007, so the model list stood still for months.
- Jarvis 007 now updates Claude Code by itself once a day. The Claude Code card on the **Models** page shows which version it is on, when it was last checked, and a **Update Claude Code** button to run it right away and report which models were just added.
- **Docker/VPS builds** get the latest Claude Code with each Jarvis 007 update. Before, the Docker image accidentally kept an old Claude Code forever.

## [0.64.77] - 2026-09-28
### Fixed
- **Telegram and Zalo no longer print the raw machine command** like `/bin/sh -lc "sed -n ..."` in the status line when using ChatGPT. That line now briefly says what was done, for example "⚙ Running command · pos_statistics · 2m39s".
- On the Chat page, ChatGPT's command step shows the right "Running command: ..." label like the other brains.

## [0.64.76] - 2026-09-28
### Fixed
- **Chatting with ChatGPT no longer shows several "Codex: Reconnecting... 2/5" bubbles in a row.** That is Codex reconnecting by itself, not an error yet, and now it shows as one faded status line while waiting.
- **A machine whose WebSocket connection to ChatGPT keeps dropping (common on VPS) now switches to the HTTPS route** from the next turn, saving five retries per turn. After 3 days Jarvis 007 tries the old route again.

## [0.64.75] - 2026-09-28
### Fixed
- **Asking Jarvis 007 to draw an image while using ChatGPT (Codex), the image shows right in the chat.** Before, Codex drew with its own tool and kept the image outside the brain, so the link would not open, with a "not found in the brain" line, and you had to go save the image yourself.
- Images now go into the brain's `attachments` folder by themselves, and Telegram also receives the attached image. An image that was drawn but not mentioned in the answer is also shown at the end.

## [0.64.74] - 2026-09-28
### Fixed
- **When Groq Whisper invents a sentence, the sentence the browser heard is kept:** when the audio is missing sounds, Groq often makes up a video outro ("Thanks for watching", "get more info in the comments") and overwrites the correct sentence. Now a Groq sentence that differs sharply from the browser's is dropped.
- To have the sentence in the draft bubble go straight into the chat box (faster, no waiting for Groq): choose **Listen with: Browser** in Settings, Voice section.

## [0.64.73] - 2026-09-27
### Fixed
- **With Groq Whisper chosen, the sentence sent is the text Groq heard**, as before 0.64.32. Since 0.64.32, Groq's text was only used for cross-checking and the sent sentence was still the browser's text, so English mixed into Vietnamese was transcribed as "clash", "cloud Play" even with Groq chosen. The browser's text still shows temporarily while you are speaking.

## [0.64.72] - 2026-09-27
### Fixed
- **Talking on phones and Android tablets no longer repeats sentences:** the Android browser often sends the same sentence again and again while fixing the last words, and before each version was appended to the message. Now only the final version is kept.
- **Bubbles show correct terms more often:** "cave" becomes "KV", "Quoc co ford plat form cua clap Play" becomes "Workers for Platforms of Cloudflare".
- For a sentence the machine is unsure about and corrects itself, Jarvis 007 answers straight to the point and no longer opens with "I understand X as Y".

## [0.64.71] - 2026-09-27
### Fixed
- **Chatting with ChatGPT (Codex) now calls tools in the brain that is actually open.** Before, Jarvis 007 did send the brain to Codex but in the wrong way, so Codex ignored it, and Jarvis 007 had to guess the brain from the conversation most recently active on the whole machine. The result: while you were in this brain, a command (for example creating a TTS Dropship order) ran in another brain, just because another channel (Telegram, Zalo, a background job) had just received a message. Now the brain travels with each command, including brains with accented Vietnamese names.
- Telegram channel using ChatGPT: switching brains back and forth no longer makes the next turn run in the old brain by mistake.

## [0.64.70] - 2026-09-27
### Improved
- **Installing or updating a pack with code no longer asks you to retype the pack code.** The red warning block "This pack runs real Python in the Jarvis 007 server" still shows in full with the name of each code file, the Cancel button is still preselected, and a pack with code still finishes installing in the off state. Only the hand-typing step is gone.

## [0.64.69] - 2026-09-27
### Fixed
- **The update button shows as soon as there is a new version:** before, for a few minutes after each release, the top box could say "you are on the latest version" even though the list below already had a new one, and there was no button. Now the two places always match.

## [0.64.68] - 2026-09-27
### Improved
- **English words are read the way Vietnamese people say them**, the whole sentence in the voice you chose: "GitHub Actions" is read as "ghit hap ac sun", "Micro" as "mi co ro", "Emma" as "em ma". Removed the two-voice splicing of the previous version, so whichever voice you choose is the voice you hear.
- **Chat bubbles show the sentence you meant to say:** "huyet ap Action", "khit half action" are now corrected to "GitHub Actions". Corrections that change the meaning (amounts, "no" to "yes"...) are still blocked as before.
- Removed the small "Heard by: ..." line under the bubble, leaving only the recognized sentence.

## [0.64.67] - 2026-09-27
### Improved
- **English words are read as English:** in a Vietnamese sentence mixed with English, words like GitHub Actions, deploy, dashboard are now read in an English voice, while the Vietnamese part stays in a Vietnamese voice. Applies to the Edge voices Hoài My, Nam Minh and the multilingual voices.
- Choosing **Hoài My** sounds most natural: standard Vietnamese, with English words read by Emma. If you choose Emma or another multilingual voice, the Vietnamese part of a mixed sentence is still given to a Vietnamese voice, because they misread short Vietnamese fragments.
- **Better listening to Vietnamese mixed with English:** Groq Whisper switched to the full version and is primed with commonly spoken English words, so "GitHub Actions" no longer becomes "huyet ap Action". Latency is almost unchanged.

## [0.64.66] - 2026-09-27
### Fixed
- Background jobs report back to the chat by themselves (draft).

## [0.64.65] - 2026-09-27
### Improved
- **Connected providers sit at the top** of the model picker, unconnected providers below.
- Tapping the name of the open provider again collapses the list, so you do not have to scroll past 300+ OpenRouter models to reach another provider.
- The model search box searches across all connected providers, and typing a provider name also brings up that provider's whole list. If a list is too long, it says how many models remain so you can keep typing to search.

## [0.64.64] - 2026-09-27
### Fixed
- **Choosing a model on a phone no longer gets stuck:** the picker no longer opens the keyboard by itself, and is no longer hidden behind the chat page when the keyboard is open. Tapping the model chip while typing lowers the keyboard automatically.
- The model picker opens right away, showing a loading line instead of blank. The list is preloaded and refreshed quietly, so later times need no waiting.

## [0.64.63] - 2026-09-27
### Fixed
- **The input box sits right against the keyboard** on phones like the Claude or Telegram apps, with no empty strip between the input box and the keyboard. When not typing, the input box on the Chat and Coding pages also has less gap at the bottom.
- The folder picker menu on the Coding page has a solid background and opens below the chip, no longer overlapping text on the top bar.

## [0.64.62] - 2026-09-27
### Fixed
- The reload notice after an update fits a phone screen, without squeezing the text into a narrow column. The editor opens full screen; the button bar no longer overflows on phones.
### Improved
- The Assistants and Workflows panels are tidier: action buttons on top, a small icon next to the name, and the description under the title removed.
- Added icons for the Upload assistant and Upload workflow buttons. The create button in the folder tree has a new option to create a subfolder.
- Searching by name in the folder tree returns folders too, including empty folders. Tap a result to open its exact place in the tree; the Location button always shows even with a long name. The editor also has a File location button to open the tree at the file being viewed.

## [0.64.61] - 2026-09-27
### Improved
- Settings is tidier, with tabs and content aligned to the left edge and less space under the title.
- The input box in Chat and Assistants shows the same text: What do you want me to do?

## [0.64.60] - 2026-09-27
### Improved
- **Settings has five tabs:** General, Voice, Mascot, Usage and Updates. The System menu is trimmed to Settings, Share links and Account.
- Unsaved voice changes are kept when switching tabs. The old entry points to Usage, Mascot and Updates take you to the right new tab.

## [0.64.59] - 2026-09-27
### Fixed
- The Graph watch connection closes more cleanly when leaving the page or reloading, avoiding one disconnect that made tests and resource cleanup fail at random.

## [0.64.57] - 2026-09-27
### Fixed
- Reloading Jarvis 007 still opens the conversation you were just viewing, even when the brain is loaded later from the server.
- Labels in the Chat screen show as text instead of translation keys when the language dictionary loads slowly.

## [0.64.56] - 2026-09-27
### Improved
- **Pinch to zoom an image on a phone.** Drag the image with one finger to see the hidden part, pinch to zoom out; the image stays inside the viewer instead of zooming the whole page.

## [0.64.55] - 2026-09-27
### Fixed
- **Machines on a custom code branch can update too.** Jarvis 007 fetches the new release and merges it into the running branch, keeping your own commits. If two edits collide, Jarvis 007 cancels the merge, names the conflicting file and keeps a copy of the local edits for recovery.
- **A wrong Apify token is reported right when connecting.** Jarvis 007 checks the token with Apify before saving; if the service does not respond, the form says so clearly so you can retry, instead of showing a green connection that breaks on the first scan.
- **Closing the Graph can no longer hang when the file watcher is slow to stop.** The WebSocket thread waits for cleanup within a limited time; the CI test also fails when no event is received instead of waiting forever.

## [0.64.54] - 2026-09-26
### Fixed
- Image generation through ChatGPT returns the result as soon as it receives the completion signal, without waiting needlessly for the connection to close. A failed image generation turn is also reported right away to avoid the chat waiting forever.

## [0.64.53] - 2026-09-26
### Fixed
- The first time you open Jarvis 007 it goes to the Graph. Afterwards it returns to the Chat or Assistants pane you used last, in the conversation you were viewing; other pages do not change where you return to.
- Fixed the case where Claude had reported the answer done but the chat kept waiting for the final summary forever. Jarvis 007 keeps the answer and ends the turn once it confirms no tool or side task is still running.

## [0.64.52] - 2026-09-26
### Fixed
- The first time you open Jarvis 007 it goes to the Chat pane. After that, Jarvis 007 keeps the page you were working on and the conversation you were viewing in the Assistants or Chat pane, on both phone and computer.
- When you switch to another app and come back, the chat does not reload its content if the connection is still active.

## [0.64.51] - 2026-09-25
### Fixed
- **Uploading photos and documents into the chat works normally again.** Since 0.64.43, every attachment reported "network error" even though the network was fine. The bug was in Jarvis 007 itself (the network watchdog called the browser the wrong way so the browser refused), not your home network. It is now fixed and tested in a real browser.
