- If the browser later hits an odd error while sending a file, the chip will name that exact error instead of blaming the network.

## [0.64.50] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- **The star logo fills its frame**: the app icon, favicon and logo are now as large as other app icons on the taskbar, no longer one notch smaller as before.

## [0.64.49] - 2026-09-24
### Fixed
- **Results of background jobs handed off from chat return to the chat that asked, by themselves.** Before, if Jarvis 007 forgot to set the recipient, the result landed in Telegram or vanished when Telegram was not connected. Now the server recognizes the chat that asked and attaches it.
### Improved
- **Loop and reminder results also show as compact cards** like background jobs: with an icon, a "Loop just ran" or "Reminder" label, the name, and a button that opens the Recurring work page. Telegram and the inbox still receive the full content as before.

## [0.64.48] - 2026-09-24
### Fixed
- **Talking by voice no longer spawns background jobs at random.** Jarvis 007 only hands off a background job when you really ask for work or ask for numbers; mentioning the word "job", telling a story about work or discussing a plan gets a straight answer, and if unsure it asks one question.
- **No duplicate or piled-up jobs.** Repeating or asking for progress on a job already running makes Jarvis 007 say "I'm already on this one" instead of handing off another copy; each voice session runs at most 3 background jobs at once.
- **Ordinary questions are no longer mistaken for a stop command.** Before, a line like "OK, how are the ads doing?" or "turn off the background music" was swallowed and Jarvis 007 answered "there are no background jobs".
### Improved
- **Background job results show as compact cards** with a status icon (done, blocked, error, overtime, stopped), the job name and a button to open the Work page; paragraphs and lists are kept instead of being stuck into one block of text. The "Working in the background" line when handing off by voice is clearer and survives reopening the conversation. Text in the background job strip is also bigger for reading on a phone.

## [0.64.47] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- **First-time setup only needs a username and password**, no more hunting for the SETUP CODE in the server log. Account protection is now left to 2FA: turn it on right after signing in.
- Note when standing up a public server: while no account exists, whoever opens the link first can create the admin. Install with `install.sh` (which already asks for the name and password) or create the account right after setup to avoid this.
- **The official Jarvis 007 mascot is the orange star.** The logo, favicon and app icon changed to the orange star with smiling eyes; the default mascot for new people is also the orange star. Anyone who picked their own shape and color keeps their choice.

## [0.64.46] - 2026-09-24
### Fixed
- **iPhone: tapping to download a file no longer locks up the whole app.** Photos in chat open right in the image viewer with a Close button; other files (PDF, Word, zip...) open in a Safari layer on top, and tapping Done after viewing or saving returns to Jarvis 007. Applies to every download place: chat, the image viewer, the Files page, code block download.
- Long command lines in answers are kept inside the frame on iPhone Safari: commands inside a text line wrap, and command blocks scroll sideways within their own block.

## [0.64.45] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- **On phones the mascot is at most 100px** (150px looked far too big on a test phone). Computers can still drag up to 150px; it is the same setting, so setting more than 100px still shows 100px on a phone.

## [0.64.44] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- **The "Running tools" box is now collapsed by default**, no longer expanding twenty lines across the chat. The summary line still says how many steps are running and what the latest step is; tap it to open the full list.
- **Each step says clearly what it is doing**, for example "Running command: git status", "Reading file: wiki/khach-hang.md", "Opening web page: ...", instead of a repeated "Calling: Bash" or "Calling: Read". Applies to every brain.

## [0.64.43] - 2026-09-24
### Fixed
- **Sending a photo or file in the chat no longer spins forever.** If the network stalls for more than 30 seconds, Jarvis 007 cuts it and resends by itself (up to 2 times), instead of making you wait the full 3 minutes as before.
- **The file chip now shows the percent sent**, for example "sending 45% · 3/7 MB", then "server is saving". You can tell at a glance whether it is stuck on your home network or on the server.
- **A failed upload has a retry button right on the chip**; tap it to resend that exact file without picking it again. A big file on a slow network still goes through as long as it keeps inching forward.

## [0.64.42] - 2026-09-24
### Fixed
- **The mascot's two eyes no longer stick together** when closed, dozing, smiling or heart-eyed, especially when it tucks against the screen edge and when the eye size is set large. Eyes that are too wide shrink just enough so they still clearly read as two eyes.
- **On phones, dragging Size past 100px now really makes the mascot bigger.** Before it was capped at about 90-100px however far you dragged; now it goes up to 150px.

## [0.64.41] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- Restored the orange color for bold text and the purple color for short code in answers. The Be Vietnam Pro font and the airy reading layout are kept.

## [0.64.40] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- **The mascot's star shape is as large as the other shapes.** Before, the star was about 30% smaller than the round shape so the eyes looked oversized; it is now rebalanced to fit, also for assistant avatars using the star shape.
- **The mascot has new straining `><` eyes**, as if pushing out an answer, with a light shake of the whole body. It comes in while thinking (after the memory-search pose and the drowsy pose), and sometimes shows when you tap it.

## [0.64.39] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- **The mascot's Size and Eye size are now sliders**: drag and the pet changes right away, and it saves when you let go.
- **The color palette and Eye color have a new Custom option**: tap the rainbow dot to pick a color, or type a color code directly (for example #FA4F05). Eye color is trimmed to Black, White and Custom; anyone using an old eye color keeps it.
- **The assistant avatar settings use the mascot's same set of controls**: shape, color palette, custom color, eye color, eye size. The Randomize button picks an available color and white or black eyes.
- **The mascot has more emotions**: when the mic is on and catches your voice, its eyes open wide, the rim spins faster and it nods lightly with each word. While the reply text is coming in it bends over writing; when the answer is done it beams and jumps. Tapping it makes it laugh, wink, widen its eyes or show heart eyes; rapid tapping makes it dizzy; sitting idle a long time makes it doze.
- Fixed picking the Orange, Ruby and six other new colors for an assistant being rejected as invalid.

## [0.64.38] - 2026-09-24
### Fixed
- **Jarvis 007 understands speech in context again.** When the machine mishears similar-sounding words ("David" for Jarvis 007, "mo do" for Models, "web kech" for Webcake), Jarvis 007 understands what you meant to say. Version 0.64.32 accidentally turned this off.
- The chat bubble shows the sentence Jarvis 007 understood, with the text the machine heard in a small line below for comparison.
- The safety rails are still in place: no changing numbers, negations or recipients, and no turning "vâng" (yes) into the name "Vân". If a sentence is uncertain, the original text is kept so the main brain can understand it itself.

## [0.64.37] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- Added a Natural conversation rhythm to try under Advanced: it waits for an unfinished sentence, holds the turn when you need to think, and adapts to your speaking pace. A fixed wait is still the default.
- Keeps the draft so you can send, continue or discard it; protects a saved message when reconnecting. An eligible closing line is recorded with a Request reply button.

## [0.64.36] - 2026-09-24
### Fixed
- **Composio at Read-only level now reads real data** from connected apps (view the calendar, read mail, list files) and can list connected accounts. Before, Jarvis 007 was left with only Composio's search tool so it could not read any app.
- Jarvis 007 inspects each command inside Composio: read commands run right away, commands that edit, send or delete still need **Full access**, and when blocked Jarvis 007 says exactly which command was blocked.
- Jarvis 007 can see the list of apps you connected in Composio, and no longer answers "only Google Calendar".

## [0.64.34] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- Chat settings are tidier: commonly used choices stay in the main part, and technical configuration is folded into Advanced.
- Only configuration that fits the chosen mode is shown; saved settings are kept and configuration errors are reported clearly.

## [0.64.33] - 2026-09-24
### Fixed
- Composio clearly reports when the connection key is rejected and points to exactly where to get the key meant for Jarvis 007.

## [0.64.32] - 2026-09-24
### Fixed
- Keeps the finalized text when a spoken sentence ends; no longer quietly replaces the message with a correction from the secondary STT or the AI.
- The reading voice keeps your choice; it reports an error instead of switching to another voice without telling you.
### Improved
- Emma Multilingual is the default reading voice for new installs and devices that have not chosen a voice. A saved choice is kept when updating.

## [0.64.31] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- **Adding your own MCP is much easier.** Paste the whole configuration the provider gave you (a link, a JSON block, a `claude mcp add` or `npx` command) and the form fills itself. For Composio, the form creates the `x-consumer-api-key` line ready, so you only paste the key.
- **API keys are entered line by line** (header name and value, with a show/hide button), with hints for common header names and a reminder when Authorization is missing the word Bearer.
- **After saving, Jarvis 007 checks the connection right away** and reports how many tools there are. If it is wrong, fix it right in the form and tap again, without creating a duplicate.
### Fixed
- **Self-added MCPs can now be edited again**: the connection menu has an **Edit configuration** item to change the link, key, command, and remove extra headers. Before, the Reconnect button only said "no key field to replace".

## [0.64.30] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- Hover a link in an answer to see its destination address before opening it, including links to files and notes inside Jarvis 007.

## [0.64.28] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- Added a focus mode: tap the mic to speak right away, say "Jarvis 007" to continue after a wait; the waiting-to-be-called state is clearly shown.
- Blocks text heard while waiting before the request is sent and the history is written. Live temporarily closes the listening connection while waiting so background noise does not trigger tasks.
- Replaced the noise filter switch with a clearly worded focus choice; stopped using the text filter to guess and cut speech. Human or TV voices cutting in during a conversation still depend on the browser's recognition ability.

## [0.64.27] - 2026-09-24
### Fixed
- Keeps the last audio chunk when recording stops; Groq replaces the browser transcript only when the recording covers the whole utterance, and the rule of choosing by sentence length is gone.
- Recognition results are delivered in the right order; turning off the mic, switching chats or switching modes cancels old results and queued messages, avoiding speech being sent to the wrong chat.
- Blocks the sentence-fixing layer from losing a request or changing a negation or figure into something else; keeps the original sentence when the fix lacks enough basis. Fixing or removing noise only affects the message of the right turn.
- Fixed a race when turning Live on or off, releasing the mic when permission is granted late, waiting for Gemini to confirm setup before sending audio, and keeping a transcript that arrives after the reply.
### Improved
- The chosen recognition language is passed to Live; Vietnamese is preferred by default, with auto-detect and other languages still supported.
- Shows a recognizing state while waiting for STT; protects the draft and avoids picking up text that was canceled during speaker playback.
- Added event-based regression checks and an audit report with a real-mic test matrix. Acoustic accuracy and latency on real devices were not confirmed in this round.
### Security
- Removed the transcript log in the fix/noise step and hid queries containing spoken text from the app's default TTS access log.

## [0.64.26] - 2026-09-24
### Changed
- **"Use Jarvis 007 right inside ChatGPT" leaves the main build and becomes a pack in the Jarvis 007 Store.** Jarvis 007 wants every chat in one place, so the feature that moves chat to chatgpt.com is no longer on by default for everyone.
- **Anyone who still needs it installs the "Jarvis 007 in ChatGPT" pack** from the Jarvis 007 Store. After installing, tap **Open page** on the plugin card to get the address to paste into ChatGPT and choose the permission level. Old connections from 0.64.21 must be reconnected once.
### Added
- **Plugins have their own page.** A plugin that declares a page gets an **Open page** button on its card. Plugins can also receive webhooks from outside services, with safety rails held by Jarvis 007 (sign-in required by default, cookies stripped on the public route, and brain plugins do not have this permission).

## [0.64.25] - 2026-09-24
### Improved
- Menus, forms and interface text use Be Vietnam Pro; the JARVIS 007 brand text still uses Montserrat, and code keeps a monospace font.
- Answers have shorter lines, clearer headings, and bold text is no longer colored orange across the board. The Jarvis 007 guidance says to state the conclusion first, give evidence after, and not repeat the tool log in the final answer.

## [0.64.24] - 2026-09-24
### Fixed
- Voice conversation no longer loses the part of the sentence already heard when the browser reopens the recognition session by itself.
- A truncated Groq transcript no longer overwrites the full sentence from the browser; calling just "Jarvis 007" is given extra time to hear the request that follows.
### Improved
- Vietnamese is the fallback language for multilingual recognition, and Jarvis 007 asks you to repeat in Vietnamese if ambiguous audio turns into a sentence mixed with a foreign language.

## [0.64.23] - 2026-09-24
### Fixed
- **Codex chat turns no longer double count cache tokens.** Cache tokens are already inside the `input_tokens` Codex reports; the label under the answer and the usage figures now take the correct total of input tokens instead of adding the cache again.
### Improved
- Text in the chat and input box switched to Be Vietnam Pro for clearer Vietnamese reading.

## [0.64.21] - 2026-09-23
### Added
- **Use Jarvis 007 right inside ChatGPT.** Chat on chatgpt.com with your plan, and ChatGPT calls Jarvis 007's tools by itself: view numbers, read the brain, create reminders, send Zalo. The thinking part does not use Codex quota.
- Turn it on at the **ChatGPT** card on the Models page, copy the address and paste it into ChatGPT. Step-by-step instructions with links are right on the card.
- **You keep control:** choose Full access, Limited autonomous, or Read-only; a change takes effect immediately. The **Disconnect all** button cuts everything in one tap.
- Needs a paid ChatGPT plan, a computer for the first install, and Jarvis 007 with an https domain.

## [0.64.20] - 2026-09-23
### Changed
- **Removed the ChatGPT Web model.** It drove a browser to chatgpt.com, but on a rented server that page blocks by IP address, so it could not run. Two other projects doing the same thing were compared: both have to run the browser on a computer at home.
- **Anyone who had ChatGPT Web chosen is switched on the next chat turn to the ChatGPT model through Codex**, with a one-line notice. Nothing more to do.
- **The Tools page drops the "Browser-driving library" item**, and Jarvis 007 cleans up about 140 MB it had installed. The Browser item stays for the Playwright connection.
- A later version will do the reverse: you chat on ChatGPT, and ChatGPT calls Jarvis 007's tools by itself.

## [0.64.19] - 2026-09-23
### Fixed
- **The assistant Settings tab said "Could not load this assistant" even though the assistant was still there.** While an assistant was answering, the server was busy so the load timed out. Those parts now run separately, a first miss retries by itself, and while waiting it shows "Loading..." instead of an empty frame.
### Changed
- **An assistant's documents are gathered in one place.** The "Files & links" button at the top is renamed **Documents** and opens the same panel as the button in Settings. The top of the panel has two boxes: **The assistant's** (every conversation sees them) and **This conversation only**, with counts and a sentence saying what they are attached to.

## [0.64.18] - 2026-09-23
### Fixed
- **The ChatGPT Web browser no longer announces itself as an automated machine.** Jarvis 007 was still downloading a stripped-down Chromium and running it hidden, so chatgpt.com spotted it at once: the User-Agent said `HeadlessChrome` and there were no plugins. It now downloads the full version and runs it with a window on a virtual screen, so it reports `Chrome` like a normal machine.
### Changed
- **The browser download button is about 70MB heavier** because of the switch to the full version. The stripped-down version is lighter but never passed the check, so light but useless.
- **When still stuck at Cloudflare, Jarvis 007 says plainly it is stuck and points to another route** instead of telling you to tap "Check again" forever. On a rented server that gate judges the IP address, so tapping more changes nothing.
## [0.64.17] - 2026-09-23
### Fixed
- **ChatGPT Team accounts could not sign in by pasting cookies.** These accounts' cookies are so long that the browser splits them into two lines, `.0` and `.1`, but Jarvis 007 only accepted a single name. It now accepts both lines.
- **Pasting half a cookie no longer slips through silently.** Before, if you copied only half, Jarvis 007 accepted it and then said "not signed in", and nobody could guess what was missing. It now says exactly which piece is missing.
- Joining the two halves into one string and pasting that also works: Jarvis 007 splits it again to fit the browser limit.

## [0.64.16] - 2026-09-23
### Fixed
- **Switching assistants while another assistant was replying froze the screen.** A few background jobs (checking the Antigravity sign-in, re-scanning the MCP tool list) held the server's main thread, so everything else had to queue. These now run separately, and clicking another assistant switches at once.
- **Chat turns on Antigravity CLI sometimes hung until they were cut off** because Jarvis 007 read the `agy` error log too late. It now reads it in parallel.

## [0.64.15] - 2026-09-23
### Changed
- **Removed the green "JUST CALLED" strip next to the model picker.** Each tool call Jarvis 007 makes now shows right in the chat, so the strip only repeated what you had just seen and took up space.

## [0.64.14] - 2026-09-23
### Fixed
- **After pasting a ChatGPT cookie, you got "cookie expired" even though chat worked fine on your machine.** Jarvis 007 waited only 3 seconds before deciding, but chatgpt.com is a heavy page that often has not finished drawing in that time. It now waits up to 45 seconds and waits for EXACTLY the right thing.
- **And when it still does not work, Jarvis 007 says what it sees** instead of blaming the cookie: where the page stopped, what the title is, whether it is stuck at the Cloudflare check. Three very different situations used to share one message.

## [0.64.13] - 2026-09-23
### Fixed
- **Code page on phones: the history button did not show the conversation list.** The button called the desktop collapse mode by mistake, so tapping it did nothing on a phone. It now opens a drawer like the Chat page, and tapping outside closes it.
- **Code page on phones: no place to add a folder or change mode.** That chip strip sat inside the model row, and the model row is hidden on phones. It now has its own row right under the title bar.
### Changed
- **The ChatGPT card is more compact.** Removed the "Close browser" button and the long block of instructions. The full guide moved to its own documentation page, and the card keeps just one link.

## [0.64.12] - 2026-09-22
### Changed
- **Removed the ChatGPT sign-in screen based on screenshots.** It only appeared when the machine had a full browser installed, and failed to respond to clicks exactly when it was needed most. There is now only one path: paste a cookie.
- **The cookie box is always shown**, even when the machine has not downloaded a browser, with a line saying what is still missing. Before, it was hidden together with the sign-in button, so users saw no way forward.
- One fewer way to open a browser on the server, so a password can no longer pass through the Jarvis 007 server at all.

## [0.64.11] - 2026-09-22
### Added
- **Sign in to ChatGPT Web by pasting a cookie.** Open chatgpt.com on your machine, copy one cookie value, and paste it into the box on the ChatGPT card. You no longer type a password in a sign-in frame, so the password does not pass through the Jarvis 007 server either.
- All three paste styles are accepted: just the token value, a whole `name=value; ...` string, or a JSON file exported from a cookie extension. Jarvis 007 automatically drops cookies that cannot be carried to another machine.
- The old sign-in screen is still there for anyone who prefers clicking by hand.

## [0.64.10] - 2026-09-22
### Fixed
- **Still no ChatGPT Sign in button even after downloading the browser.** Jarvis 007 looked for the executable at a hard-coded path, but the Chromium folder layout differs by download and by machine type (ARM machines put it elsewhere). Jarvis 007 now scans for the executable instead of guessing the path.
- **The "no browser yet" message now says where it looked and what it found.** Before, nobody knew what to do after seeing it, including the person who wrote it.

## [0.64.9] - 2026-09-22
### Fixed
- **The Plugins page said "Ready" while the ChatGPT card still complained about a missing browser.** Jarvis 007 downloads Chromium into two folders, and it only knew how to look for the executable in one of them. If it landed in the other, the download finished but still reported nothing, so the **Sign in to ChatGPT** button never appeared.
- Both pages now ask the same single place, so one no longer says done while the other says missing.
- **The ChatGPT card notices the browser as soon as it is downloaded**, with no need to restart Jarvis 007 to see it.

## [0.64.8] - 2026-09-22
### Added
- **The Plugins page has a new "Browser driving library" section.** This is what the **ChatGPT Web** model needs. One click and Jarvis 007 downloads it itself, with no terminal commands. After the download, remember to restart Jarvis 007 so the model shows in the model picker.
- Installed **on demand**, so the default install does not grow by a single byte: this package is about 143 MB and most machines never use it. Removing it is also one button, and it removes only the copy Jarvis 007 downloaded, touching nothing else on the machine.
- Both sections on the Plugins page download into the data drive, so they **survive every update** with no re-download.
- **Sign in to ChatGPT inside Jarvis 007, no server with a screen needed.** Click Sign in on the ChatGPT card and the ChatGPT page appears right in the dashboard: click and type as in a normal browser, and the frame closes by itself when done. This makes the **ChatGPT Web** model work on a VPS too.
### Fixed
- **The ChatGPT Web engine no longer breaks when two jobs overlap.** Before, opening a page and sending a message at the same time could kill the chat turn midway. All browser actions now go through a single queue.

## [0.64.7] - 2026-09-22
### Added
- **You can see how much text each chat turn carries and where it sits.** The diagnostics page now has a breakdown table: the shared brain part, the conversation channel part, the skill part, the memory part, with how many characters each is and what percentage it takes. Before, you could only guess.
- The figure is measured on your own machine, not estimated, so if a brain is unusually heavy you see right away where the weight is.
### Improved
- **The core prompt can no longer grow.** Its character ceiling is frozen and guarded in two places, so raising it means editing two spots with a reason. Three times before, this ceiling was raised just to get a job done, and each time every chat turn of every model got heavier.
- Adding a new rule now means moving an old item out to a skill or a document: change where it lives, lose no capability.

## [0.64.6] - 2026-09-22
### Fixed
- **Setting up a new machine no longer shows dozens of red environment variables.** The sample file `env.example` used to have nearly a hundred comment lines. Deploy platforms scan this file and turn every line containing `=` into a variable, so each comment line became a variable named `#` and the Environment table lit up red, blocking the deploy button. The sample file now has only four `NAME=value` lines and no comment lines at all.
- The explanation of each variable is **not lost**: it lives on the **.env configuration** page in the docs, more complete than the old comment block. If you already hit this, delete all lines containing `#` in the Environment box once and it is clean.
### Improved
- **The ChatGPT Web model shows up by itself when the machine can use it, with nothing to declare.** The previous version made you set an environment variable by hand to see the model, but that variable cannot create a browser, so a machine with missing parts still showed the model and then failed when selected. Jarvis 007 now detects this itself: with everything present the model is already in the picker, and if something is missing the ChatGPT card on the Models page says what is missing and where to click.

## [0.64.5] - 2026-09-22
### Improved
- **Running several edit sessions at once no longer stomps on each other's version numbers.** New convention: every session reserves its version number from the start with a draft PR, so other sessions can see the number is already taken. You will less often see a finished change redone just because of a number clash.
- Each chat turn is a little lighter: the convention reserved for programming moved out of the core prompt, because users never need it.

## [0.64.3] - 2026-09-22
### Fixed
- **The Partners page opens many times faster.** The assistant list was dragging along each person's whole system prompt: measured on a brain with 14 assistants, **366 KB** for something that only shows a name and a role. It is now **2.9 KB**. This was what left the left column blank for a few seconds each time you opened the page from the mascot menu.
- The full prompt is still fetched, but only for the assistant you have open in the editor. If that fetch fails, Jarvis 007 shows an error with a retry button instead of opening an empty box (opening it empty and then clicking Save would lose the real prompt).
- The assistant picker in Chatbot, the card grid in Studio and the per-step picker in workflows also got lighter.

## [0.64.2] - 2026-09-22
### Improved
- **The folder picker menu in Coding is more compact.** Folder names and paths use small text that is enough to skim, so the menu no longer takes up half the screen.
- **Long menus no longer spill out.** With many folders, the menu scrolls inside its frame and flips up or down depending on free space, instead of spilling over the left navigation bar.
- On phones the menu text keeps its old size for easy tapping.

## [0.64.1] - 2026-09-22
### Fixed
- **Switching brains while on the Partners page no longer blanks the screen.** Each time you switched brains, Jarvis 007 reloaded the main screen's knowledge globe even though you were looking at another page, and that locked the screen for a few seconds. It now waits until you return to the main screen to load it.
- **The chat frame in the middle of the Partners page no longer shows the old brain's conversation.** After switching brains, the chat frame opens the conversation of the selected assistant in the new brain.
- **Picking another assistant is much faster.** The settings panel on the right no longer asks the server again for the skill list and model config after every click.
- Choosing an external folder as the brain now refreshes the whole page too: before, only the globe changed, while the assistant list and the folder tree still belonged to the previous brain.

## [0.64.0] - 2026-09-22
### Added
- **Added the `chatgpt-web` model on the ChatGPT card.** Pick it in the model picker and Jarvis 007 runs on the ChatGPT session in your browser, without using up Codex turns. It can still call tools, read and write files in the brain, set schedules and run skills like any other brain.
- It must be enabled once with the environment variable `JAVIS_ENABLE_WEB_CHAT=true`, then restarted. Until enabled, this model does not show, and everything else runs exactly as before.
- The **Models** page, on the ChatGPT card, has new buttons to open the sign-in window, re-check and close the browser. Jarvis 007 does not hold your password: you sign in yourself once in that window.
- Note when using it: each turn is a real chat on chatgpt.com, so your account's **Memory** and **Custom instructions** affect the answers. To have Jarvis 007 answer purely from its own prompt, turn those two off in ChatGPT settings. Each tool-call round also takes tens of seconds, so multi-step work is still better left to Codex.

## [0.63.10] - 2026-09-22
### Fixed
- **The Antigravity brain now shows progress too.** The "Ran N steps" block added in the previous version never appeared when running Antigravity, even when it called real tools. The reason: `agy` reports its work in a format that Jarvis 007 missed, so every tool call fell into nothing.
- Along with that, Jarvis 007 now knows whether an Antigravity turn has already run an outside command. Before, on a temporary network error it could re-run the whole turn and redo things that were already done.

## [0.63.9] - 2026-09-22
### Added
- **One job in Coding can now attach MANY folders.** Click the folder chip and tick as many as you like; the menu does not close midway, so you can pick several in a row. Good for work that touches both source code and docs, or an app with a shared library.
- The folder **at the top of the list is the main folder**: Jarvis 007 stands there and all git actions run there. Jarvis 007 can still read and edit the other folders by their full paths. Untick the main one and the next one takes over.
### Fixed
- **The pale green text in the folder menu and the permission level menu is now readable.** It was using the border color as the text color, so it was almost invisible.
- Removed the long explanation line at the bottom of the add folder box.

## [0.63.8] - 2026-09-22
### Added
- **Waiting is no longer blind.** When Jarvis 007 has to call many tools to answer, the chat frame now lists each step above the answer instead of a single blinking line that then disappears. After the answer, the list folds into one line `Ran 6 steps`, and clicking it expands it to review.
- The step list survives F5, so after reloading the page you can still check what Jarvis 007 did. A direct answer with no tool calls grows no extra line at all.

## [0.63.7] - 2026-09-22
### Improved
- **Weak machines freeze much less when opening the main screen.** The brain globe used to redraw continuously even when nothing moved, burning CPU all day while you just sat looking. It now stays still when idle and comes back to life as soon as you speak, when Jarvis 007 is thinking, or when you hover over it.
- Measured on a brain with 844 notes: with nobody touching anything, the main screen dropped from **34% to 19.7%** of one CPU core. The more notes the brain has, the more it saves.
- The breathing effect and the highlight effect when pointing at a dot are unchanged, and are turned off only while you are not interacting.

## [0.63.6] - 2026-09-22
### Fixed
- **Permission level text no longer sinks into the background.** The three chips Plan, Automatic, Full access used to take the border color as the text color, so the text looked faded like it was disabled. The **Full access** chip in particular used a color code that does not exist at all, so the most dangerous level looked identical to the normal ones. Each level now has its own text and background color, visible at a glance.
### Improved
- **The add folder box opens at places worth starting from**: the open brain, the folder that holds the brains, the home folder. Before, it opened straight into the home folder, which on a server is often empty so you could not get anywhere. A house-shaped button returns to this list after browsing deep.
- Folders that are git repos get their own mark right in the list, and hovering a row shows the full path.

## [0.63.5] - 2026-09-22
### Fixed
- **Clicking a file in Coding now opens it.** Before, clicking a file in the folder tree, or clicking the open file chip in the attachment bar, did nothing and showed no error. It now opens the same editor as in Chat.
- **The permission level is visible even before a folder is attached.** The Plan / Automatic / Full access chips used to appear only after attaching a folder, while the permission level already took effect from the very first chat message. That meant you were running at a level you could not see or change.
- **The Code group icon is back to a code file shape** instead of the wrench, because a wrench says repair and settings, not source code.

## [0.63.4] - 2026-09-22
### Improved
- **Adding a folder in Coding is now point and click, not typing a path.** Clicking "Add folder" opens a folder browsing box: click to go in, click `.. (up)` to go out, and folders that are git repos get their own mark. If you already have the path at hand, pasting it into the top box and pressing Enter is as fast as before.
- If you choose wrong, the box **stays open and shows the error in place**, instead of closing and making you reopen and browse again from the start.
- **The Coding item icon changed to the `</>` symbol** so it is recognizable at a glance, replacing the single code file icon that was easy to confuse with the Files item.

## [0.63.3] - 2026-09-22
### Fixed
- **Chat through Antigravity less often answers an old question by mistake.** The conversation history package sent with each turn was far too long, so when it had to go through a file, the model often read only the first half and answered a question asked long ago. The package is now shorter and still keeps the most recent part of the conversation.
- **The 21st skill onward is no longer forgotten by Jarvis 007.** In a brain with many skills, Jarvis 007 used to see only the first 20 in alphabetical order, and names later in the alphabet counted as nonexistent. Jarvis 007 now sees more, and prioritizes the skills you use often.
- **A plugin can block a wrong action before it happens.** Jarvis 007's extension layer used to only watch and log; it can now stop a wrong call and say why. If a plugin is badly written, Jarvis 007 still runs normally instead of standing still.

## [0.63.2] - 2026-09-22
### Improved
- **The left column of Coding is now exactly the conversation column of Chat**: with Conversations and Files tabs, search box, pin, grouping, split by day, rename, delete. There is no separate cut-down list anymore.
- **Added Plan mode.** The three modes read Plan, Automatic, Full access, each with one line saying what it allows. Plan does not just lock file editing, it also tells Jarvis 007 to read the code and return a plan for you to approve.
- Jarvis 007 is now told in every turn which folder and which branch it is standing in, so wrong guesses about paths are much rarer.

## [0.63.1] - 2026-09-22
### Improved
- **Coding: you can message right away.** The previous version blocked you with a "No repo yet" screen, and you had to declare a repo before typing the first message. Opening the page now gives you a ready job, and you can attach a folder at any time; if none is attached, Jarvis 007 works in the brain like any other conversation.
- **Add a FOLDER, it does not have to be a git repo.** A script folder, a docs folder, a brand new project all work. With git, Jarvis 007 recognizes it and opens branches, worktrees and restore points; without git, those three are hidden instead of showing an error.
- **The left column now lists the JOBS in progress** instead of a folder list, with a small folder name under each job. You can also change folders midway.
- The path input box sits neatly inside the app instead of the browser dialog, and the item icon changed to fit the job (the previous version used a git branch icon).

## [0.63.0] - 2026-09-22
### Added
- **A new Coding item** in the Code group on the sidebar. Declare your repo once, then chat as usual: Jarvis 007 works RIGHT INSIDE that repo instead of in the brain, so it reads the right files, runs the right tests, and no longer reads the wrong folder tree.
- Right above the input box is a row of small buttons that show and change: which repo, which branch, whether it has its own worktree, and how far the permission level goes. The model picker button is still the old one, with no second one added.
- **A separate worktree per session**: two jobs running in parallel on the same repo no longer step on each other. If edits are unfinished, Jarvis 007 refuses to remove it and says where it is being kept.
- **Restore point**: set a marker before letting Jarvis 007 edit, and if it breaks, pull the repo back to that marker. Removing a repo from Jarvis 007 deletes nothing on disk.

## [0.62.6] - 2026-09-22
### Fixed
- **Jarvis 007 installed on a tablet's home screen can now rotate to landscape.** Before, the app declared to the operating system "portrait only", so rotating the tablet made Android squeeze the interface into a narrow column in the middle with the sides faded. The app now rotates with the device: portrait stays portrait, landscape uses the full width.
- On a device that already has the Jarvis 007 icon installed, remove the old icon and **Add to home screen** once more so the device reads the new declaration.

## [0.62.5] - 2026-09-21
### Fixed
- **Removed the "Chatbot" item that strayed to the end of the System group** on the sidebar, next to Account. It should have been hidden since 0.61.0 when Chatbot merged into a tab, but the filter missed exactly this branch so it kept showing.
### Improved
- **Renamed to call things by their right names.** The sidebar item: **Conversations** became **Chatbot**. The three tabs inside: **Bot inbox**, **Bot accounts**, **Create chatbot**.
- Saying "bot inbox", "bot accounts" or "create chatbot" also opens the right place.

## [0.62.4] - 2026-09-21
### Improved
- **The "Channels" tab was renamed "Bot accounts".** It names what is inside: the Telegram bot, Zalo Bot and personal Zalo accounts that customers message.
- **Each brain only sees its own bot accounts.** Before, this tab mixed the accounts of every brain so you could not tell which was yours. An account added in a brain belongs to that brain; the create bot form also only lets you choose accounts in the open brain.
- There is a **Show all brains** button to find an account you added in the wrong place, and the Edit account box has a new **Account's brain** item to move it to another brain without losing the conversation history.
- An old account whose owner cannot be guessed shows in **every** brain with a note, so no token exists that no screen can see.

## [0.62.3] - 2026-09-21
### Added
- **Chatbot now runs the model you chose for the assistant.** Before, the bot borrowed the assistant's instructions but always ran the main model, so after choosing a model for the assistant and turning the bot on, it talked to customers with a completely different model. The bot now uses exactly the model in that assistant's Model box, and the card on the Chatbot page shows that model so you can tell at a glance.
### Improved
- **The assistant's Model picker is now identical to the model picker under the chat frame**: it has a search box, and a provider with no API key yet still shows with a lock instead of being hidden, and clicking it goes straight to the Models page to unlock.
- The **Default** line is more truthful: with Default, the assistant runs the main model when chatting and when acting as a chatbot, and when inside a workflow it runs the background model.

## [0.62.2] - 2026-09-21
### Fixed
- **Deleting a channel account no longer goes around in circles.** Before, if an account had a bot on duty, Jarvis 007 sent you to the Chatbot tab, but that bot was often in another brain so you only got "switch brain and try again" without knowing which brain. Now there is just one question: remove it from that bot and delete it too? Agree and it is done.
- **The card in the Channels tab says which brain the on-duty bot is in**, for example `On duty: Closer · brain Shoe Shop`. This tab always shows the accounts of every brain because a token is a real account in the world, belonging to no brain; now you can see where its bot lives.
- When the last account of a bot is removed, Jarvis 007 says so first, and turns that bot off instead of letting it claim to be on with nowhere left to be on duty. The bot record remains, and attaching another account turns it back on.

## [0.62.1] - 2026-09-21
### Fixed
- **Shared HTML apps went blank.** A page opened through a `/s/` link runs in an isolated box, so every command that remembers the color theme or a filter threw an error and killed the whole page, even though the data next to it had loaded. Jarvis 007 now patches that spot itself when serving the page: the app runs smoothly, and the isolation layer stays intact with no loosening at all.
- **The Delete connection box was rebuilt** to match the dialog pattern of the Store page: read straight down in one pass, buttons stuck to the bottom, and on phones it slides up from the bottom edge. The tiny checkbox became a toggle row you can tap across the whole strip.
### Improved
- **Opening a code block in a note now shows a box in the middle of the screen**, no longer stuck to the right edge. Text wraps to fit the frame so you do not scroll sideways to read, tapping outside closes it, and there is a `Wrap` button to turn wrapping off when you need to see the whole line.

## [0.62.0] - 2026-09-21
### Added
- **Assistants have their own document cabinet.** Open `Assistant settings` on the Partners page, click `Open documents & links frame` to attach files in the brain or paste links just for that assistant. The assistant always sees this list, in every conversation with it and in every workflow step that calls it.
- **Pinning a file means the assistant reads it in advance.** Click pin and the file content is loaded straight into the start of each turn, with no waiting for it to open the file itself. This follows the pin rule of the project frame, and the documents travel with the assistant file, so exporting the assistant or copying the brain to another machine keeps them intact.
### Improved
- **Removed the Group box in Assistant settings.** Grouping now has just one place, the group bar in the left column. Before, two places set the same thing, so changing the group in the left column and then clicking Save in the form made the group jump back to the old value without a word.
### Fixed
- **The orange outline when clicking an input box is no longer clipped** in the right settings column of the Partners page.

## [0.61.5] - 2026-09-21
### Fixed
- **The Usage page shows numbers as soon as it opens.** Before, every visit made you wait for Jarvis 007 to reread all the session logs before drawing, and on a heavily used machine that was 602 MB and over 26 seconds staring at "Building token index...". The page now draws right away with the numbers it already has, and the scan runs quietly in the background and updates again only when there are truly new numbers.
- **Log scanning is much lighter.** Jarvis 007 now continues reading from where it stopped last time instead of rereading the whole file from the start, so a running session writing a few more lines no longer drags in tens of megabytes of rereading. Measured on the project server: 26.7 seconds down to under a tenth of a second.
- Token numbers still count exactly as before, without a single figure off: the index was rebuilt from scratch with both the old and new code on the same 651 files for comparison.

## [0.61.4] - 2026-09-21
### Fixed
- **The Updates page no longer makes you wait.** Before, every visit had to download nearly 2 MB of logs before it could draw any row, so it sat on "Loading update log..." long enough to look broken. The page now fetches only the 20 versions being viewed: it opens almost instantly, and so does clicking to an older page.
- **The "Check again" button gets the very latest version.** It forces the server to drop the log copy it holds and ask GitHub again, instead of rereading the old copy in memory.
- **Jarvis 007 no longer says "I don't know which brain I'm working on"** when you open a Codex session yourself and ask it to assign work or look at the schedule. It takes the open brain by itself, and states in the answer which brain it is running on so you never have to guess.

## [0.61.3] - 2026-09-21
### Fixed
- **Jarvis 007 no longer says "no data" right on your own brain.** Any sentence mentioning data, projects, workflows, skills or assistants now always takes the full path, with tools and the brain. Before, the Super saver level mistook them for small talk and answered bare, even telling you to paste the documents yourself.
- **Follow-up sentences no longer lose the thread.** Sending "ok, so write the article" after finishing discussing a topic makes Jarvis 007 continue writing, instead of asking again "what topic do you want to write about".
- **Calling one of your workflows by its exact name makes Jarvis 007 fall back to the path that can run that workflow**, instead of answering bare because the workflow was not in the tool list.
- Normal chat (explaining, translating, titling, brainstorming) still takes the saving shortcut as before.

## [0.61.2] - 2026-09-21
### Fixed
- **Cards in the Channels tab no longer overflow with text.** A long error line (especially MCP errors, one lump of text with no spaces) used to run outside the card and overlap the next card. It now wraps neatly inside the card, and hovering shows the full line.
- **The Delete channel account button is back.** Before, any account with a bot on duty had its Delete button vanish with no explanation. The button is now always there: clicking it makes Jarvis 007 say which bot is holding it and opens that bot's edit form directly so you can untick it.
- The personal Zalo card has an **Open Connections** button to go to the right place to disconnect, instead of having no way.
- The `Open Connections` button in the Add account panel is no longer squashed onto two lines.

## [0.61.1] - 2026-09-21
### Improved
- **Creating a bot is now two steps.** Step 1 only asks which account the bot replies on, and step 2 sets the name and settings. Editing a bot goes straight to step 2.
- **Less text where you choose a channel.** The token guide for each channel is no longer sitting in the create bot form, and only shows when you really pick that channel. To connect a new channel, click `Connect a new channel` right in the form.
- **The channel list is stacked vertically**, one channel per row instead of a cramped two column grid. Channels added later stay readable on phones.
- **Language, handing over to a human and groups** fold into the `More settings` item. The permission level stays outside, not hidden.

## [0.61.0] - 2026-09-21
### Added
- **Chatbot and Conversations merge into one page.** The Conversations item on the sidebar now has three tabs: Inbox (customer messages), Channels (every account customers message) and Chatbot (AI staff). Saying "open chatbot" still goes to the right tab.
- **Reply to customers right in the Inbox.** Open a chat, type your reply in the bottom box and press Enter. Sending from here means you take over that chat, and the bot stays silent until you click Return to AI. Personal Zalo sends under your own name, and the compose box says so clearly.
- **The Channels tab treats every channel the same.** Telegram bots, Zalo bots and personal Zalo are all the same kind of card: status, bot on duty, number of conversations, capabilities (join groups, send files, reply from Jarvis 007). Add accounts by token right here; a new channel later just appears as one more.
### Improved
- **One bot can be on duty for several accounts.** The token is split from the bot into a channel account; the create bot form ticks existing accounts or pastes a new token. Old bots migrate to the new model automatically, with conversations and tokens kept as they were.

## [0.60.1] - 2026-09-20
### Added
- **Customer Management (CRM) pack in the Store.** It sits on top of the Conversations inbox: ask Jarvis 007 which customers have been waiting a long time without a reply, what a customer has asked, tag VIPs, add notes, count new customers by week, export to Excel. It comes with a customer care assistant and a daily review workflow. You need this version to install it.

## [0.60.0] - 2026-09-20
### Added
- **Conversations page (Capabilities group): the customer inbox.** Every message a customer sends to your Telegram or Zalo Bot bot is saved as its own conversation, readable right in Jarvis 007: who wrote, which channel, what the bot answered, which chats are unread. On phones it is one column, and tapping opens the history.
- **Take over a chat.** Click Take over and the bot goes silent for that customer so you can reply yourself in the app, then click Return to AI. The bot card on the Chatbot page gains today's conversation count and a button that opens the inbox directly.
- **Personal Zalo becomes a channel of the inbox.** An account that scanned the QR on the Connections page has a Record conversations switch; turn it on and customer messages to your Zalo also come to the inbox, saved only from the moment you turn it on. It is off by default, and the bot does not yet reply by itself on this channel.
- Saying "open the customer inbox" or "see customer messages" makes Jarvis 007 open the right page. The full guide is in document number 28.

## [0.59.50] - 2026-09-20
### Improved
- **The English interface no longer leaks Vietnamese text:** the category filter chips on the Connections page (Office, Messaging, Ads...), the left group column of the Jarvis 007 Store and the "Other" group on the sidebar now follow the chosen language. Group names set by community packs are kept as they are.
- The reminder to download the .dmg in the Ollama install command on Mac also has an English version.

## [0.59.49] - 2026-09-20
### Improved
- **Share page: the search box shows as soon as there are 2 links,** without waiting for 9 links as before, and when you type there is a line "Matches x / y links" below. The list is still split into pages of 20 links. On phones the path, link and Copy/Revoke buttons are larger for easier reading and tapping.

## [0.59.48] - 2026-09-20
### Fixed
- **Long background jobs are no longer cut at minute 15 and rerun from the start.** The per-run ceiling now follows the engine's own ceiling (default 1 hour), and when time runs out Jarvis 007 kills the old process completely before retrying, so two copies no longer run together. Shutting down or updating the server midway no longer silently cancels a running job: the job goes back to the queue and reruns by itself after it comes up.
- **Chat with Claude Code or Codex when the plan runs out: the proper out-of-turns card shows, with the time it reruns,** instead of an English bubble that looked like an answer. Grok Build, if it loses its old thread after a CLI update, opens a new thread by itself instead of staying red.
- **Reminders and loops no longer block each other.** A loop running 25 minutes once made a 7 a.m. reminder arrive late; now long jobs run in the background, and a reminder fires at its time. A repeating reminder cancelled while running does not come back to life; a loop hitting an engine error does not repeat forever, it logs the error and pauses itself as designed.
- **Partners page:** opening an old conversation from the History tab and then going to Chat no longer sends into the assistant session by mistake; clicking Save in the Settings column no longer pulls a partner back to the old group right after moving groups. Assigning a job with the same name as a stuck job makes Jarvis 007 say so directly instead of reporting "assigned".
### Improved
- **On phones,** the pin/move/rename/delete buttons of a conversation row and the copy code button are always visible (before, only on hover). Text in the partner column and the group panel is raised to 16px. An engine error no longer comes with an extra "(no content)" bubble. The rerun time of background jobs shows in your time zone.

## [0.59.47] - 2026-09-20
### Improved
- **The group picker on the Partners page matches the project picker in Chat.** Clicking the group bar opens a panel: All groups, Ungrouped, then each group with its headcount and a three dot button to rename or delete the group (deleting only moves people to Ungrouped), and at the bottom "+ New group". The create group button also stands right next to the bar. A newly created group with nobody in it still shows in the panel and in the list so you can drag partners into it.

## [0.59.46] - 2026-09-20
### Fixed
- **The share link of an .html app now reads its accompanying data file.** Before, an app reading data.json or .csv beside it opened blank after sharing: the relative path pointed to the wrong place, and the page ran in an isolated box so the browser blocked reading. Both are now fixed; the app must sit in its own folder (for example apps/app-name/) so that only files in that folder are opened, and notes outside the folder stay closed.
### Added
- **The Partners page groups partners by group.** Choosing "All groups" splits the list into groups; click a title to collapse or open, with the headcount on the right. The "..." button on the title lets you rename the whole group or view only that group. What a group means is up to you (department, project, purpose); moving a partner to another group or creating a new group is still in each partner's "..." menu.

## [0.59.45] - 2026-09-20
### Improved
- **Long chat with Antigravity: the question copied onto the command line is 4 times longer and keeps both the start and the end.** When you paste a long article and state the request in the last sentence, the previous version copied only the first 1500 characters so the request at the end was lost. It now copies up to 6000 characters, and if longer it keeps the opening and the closing, dropping only the middle (still fully present in the context file).

## [0.59.44] - 2026-09-20
### Fixed
- **Background jobs run by Antigravity CLI at auto level can now use the shell and write real files.** Before, Jarvis 007 passed two flags together, which made agy cancel the tool after 5 seconds, so Kanban jobs, Loops and Workflow steps ran and then reported "could not start the tool layer" with no error in the log. Auto level now keeps only the auto-approve flag, and the guard against outside actions stays in the hub as before.
- **Long chat with Antigravity no longer answers off topic about an old question.** When a long conversation had to go through the context file, the prompt on the command line pasted the start of the history by mistake as the "latest message", so the model read the file halfway and answered a question from the afternoon. The prompt now copies only the question just asked, and the history sent back each turn is more compact.
- **A background job that hits "plan out of turns" now waits by itself until the plan reopens and then continues,** without counting toward the retry count, instead of retrying continuously for a few minutes and then blocking permanently. The job card says which plan ran out and what time it reruns; dragging the job back to Ready runs it immediately.
### Improved
- **Partners no longer refuse a job as "outside their role" or invent that they handed it to another agent.** Every partner's prompt now says plainly that they have all of Jarvis 007's tools (Drive, Composio, background assignment, reminders...), may say a job was assigned only right after a real tool call, and must not promise "I'll report back when there is a result".

## [0.59.43] - 2026-09-20
### Fixed
- **Images in .md files now show.** Before, Jarvis 007 looked for every image from the brain root, so a note in a subfolder with an image inserted beside it showed only a gray box. Jarvis 007 now looks beside the note file itself first, as Obsidian and VS Code do, and only then in the brain root and in attachments.
- Applies to images inserted as `![name](anh.jpg)` and as `![[anh.jpg]]`, in both file-open frames, and also on the public share page.

## [0.59.42] - 2026-09-18
### Added
- **Search and pagination on the Share page.** Type a file or folder name to filter at once, typing without diacritics still finds files with diacritics, and typing several words narrows it down. The list is split into pages of 20 links so even with hundreds of shared files the page opens fast. The search box only appears when the list is long enough.

## [0.59.41] - 2026-09-18
### Fixed
- **The Share button changed to its own share icon.** Before, it wore the chain link icon identical to the Insert link button in the formatting bar right below, so you could not tell which was which. The Share page on the sidebar also changed, because the Connections group already uses that chain link icon.

## [0.59.40] - 2026-09-18
### Fixed
- **The Share button is now in every file-open frame.** The previous version attached the button only to the editor frame that expands to the middle of the screen, so opening a file from the folder tree on the left, the most common path, showed no button. Now however you open a file, there is a Share button on the toolbar, sharing one link and one Revoke button.

## [0.59.39] - 2026-09-18
### Added
- **A Share button in the file-open frame.** One click gives a link that anyone can view, with no sign-in and no Jarvis 007 account. The link opens the **finished version**, not the source: an .html file runs with its own interface, a .md file shows bold, italics, lists, tables and images. Good for making a small app and sending it to someone to see right away.
- **The link points to the real file.** When you edit the file, the viewer sees the new version by reloading the page, with no need to share again. Clicking Share again on the same file gives the same old link, so a link already sent is never replaced.
- **Revoke at any time** with the button next to the link. After revoking, the old link is dead for everyone.
- **A new Share page in the System group,** listing every live link with file name, path and creation date. This is where you review everything and revoke any you forgot, because links have no expiry. Saying "open the share page" also goes to this page.
### Security
- The shared page runs in an isolated box, so the file content cannot read the Jarvis 007 sign-in session of whoever opens it, even when you click your own link. In exchange, a small app in an .html file cannot use the browser's storage.
- Images and accompanying resources can only be fetched from around the shared file itself, and only images, css, js, fonts, audio and video. Other notes in the brain cannot be read through the link.

## [0.59.38] - 2026-09-18
### Fixed
- **Reply text keeps up with the voice.** The bubble shows the whole phrase being played, even when the browser does not yet know the audio duration.
- **Improved speaker playback on iPhone.** Fixed the audio file used to unlock speaker playback, allowed retry when blocked, and initialize Live audio as soon as the mic is tapped.
- **Keep full sentences when the mic reopens the listening session by itself.** The finalized part is kept, and temporary text that duplicates an already received sentence is merged to avoid repetition in the bubble.

## [0.59.37] - 2026-09-18
### Fixed
- **The mascot Settings page is no longer blank.** The previous version had just added new colors and this page was left with only the title, nothing below, and no error. The bug was a line of code calling the wrong variable so the whole page stopped midway while drawing. It now draws all five choice rows again: shape, size, body color, eye color, eye size.
- **Changing the logo changes the browser tab icon right away.** Before, the image in the page changed immediately while the small icon on the tab kept the old picture until the app got a new version. Now uploading a logo or clicking restore changes it at once, including the icon used when you add Jarvis 007 to your phone's home screen.

## [0.59.36] - 2026-09-18
### Added
- **Added 8 mascot body colors:** Orange, Sunny, Lime, Mint, Sky blue, Indigo, Purple, Ruby. The palette now has 20 colors, spread across the color wheel instead of bunched into a few brown-yellow tones.
- **Added 5 eye colors:** Brown, Blue, Jade, Purple, Yellow, beside the existing Black and White. The mascot expresses emotion entirely through its eyes, so changing eye color completely changes its personality.
### Fixed
- **Dark mode no longer washes out the whole palette.** You chose Amber and the pet came out yellow, and every color looked about the same pastel shade. The reason: each color's dark tone was set by hand and had drifted away from the original color, with Amber drifting all the way from orange to yellow. The dark tone is now computed directly from the light tone so it keeps the right color, and is even a bit softer than before. Light mode is unchanged.

## [0.59.35] - 2026-09-18
### Fixed
- **The mic on phones no longer works only once.** After the first turn Jarvis 007 went deaf, reloading the page did not help, and you had to clear the mic permission and grant it again to get one more turn. It was not a permission bug: Jarvis 007 opened two mic capture paths at the same time, but phones allow only one. While listening there is now just one path, so you can speak any number of turns and reloading the page still listens normally.
- **In exchange, on phones the globe no longer lights up with your voice while you are speaking.** Interrupting while Jarvis 007 is reading still works as before. Nothing changes on computers.

## [0.59.34] - 2026-09-18
### Fixed
- **Signing in to ChatGPT in Jarvis 007 no longer kicks Codex out on the machine.** Each Jarvis 007 chat turn used to overwrite Codex's sign-in file, even when the token in hand was already broken, so the two sides fought over one token and the later user lost the session. Jarvis 007 now reads that file first: if Codex just refreshed the token Jarvis 007 follows it, and if Jarvis 007's token is broken it leaves things as they are and writes nothing.
- **If the machine already signed in to Codex with another account, Jarvis 007 leaves it alone.** Before, that session was silently deleted every time you talked to Jarvis 007.
- **The Disconnect button now truly disconnects.** Before, it only cleared the part inside Jarvis 007, and the sign-in file on the machine remained so Codex kept running on the account you thought was disconnected. A session you created yourself with the Codex sign-in command is still kept.

## [0.59.33] - 2026-09-18
### Fixed
- **Speaking by mic on phones no longer repeats sentences.** Saying "Can you hear what I'm saying" made the sent message become an endless paragraph, with the sentence copied again and gaining one word each time. Chrome on Android returns the whole sentence several times in one listening turn, and Jarvis 007 joined them all instead of replacing. It now keeps exactly one sentence, in both the live text bubble and the sent message.

## [0.59.32] - 2026-09-17
### Improved
- **Opening a long conversation no longer stutters.** Entering an old chat, Jarvis 007 builds only the last section and drops straight to the most recent answer. Scrolling up brings the older part back gradually, piece by piece, and the place you are reading stays put instead of jumping. The marker bar on the right grows longer too.
- **The Skills page has pagination.** 20 skills per page, with Previous/Next buttons at the bottom of the list. The search box and the group column still filter across everything as before.

## [0.59.31] - 2026-09-17
### Fixed
- **The mascot in the picker on the Settings page no longer loses an eye.** The previous version drew the right eye missing on every still face: the shape picker, the eye size picker, the small image replacing the logo on the sidebar and the assistant's avatar. The pet at the screen edge still had both eyes, so at a glance it looked deliberate.

## [0.59.30] - 2026-09-17
### Added
- **A star shaped mascot.** A five-pointed star, plump and chubby, standing in the same row as Round, Square, Triangle, Cloud, Pentagon on the Mascot page. Assistants can also choose this shape as their avatar.
- **Choose the mascot's eye size.** A new row of buttons right under Eye color: Normal, Large, Extra large. It applies to every shape, not just the star, and since this character expresses emotion entirely through its eyes, making them bigger completely changes its personality.

## [0.59.29] - 2026-09-17
### Fixed
- **Background jobs started while chatting stay in the chat frame you are talking in.** Before, each background assignment made Jarvis 007 open a separate conversation for it, so after a session of chatting the History bar was full of chats with only one or two messages. The result now comes straight back to the frame you are talking in, and the background job can read the conversation thread there so it answers more on point.
- **The wrongly pasted "TG" label is gone.** Conversations born from Zalo, from the terminal, from a dedicated bot and from background jobs were all marked as Telegram. Each now carries its own channel label, so filtering by channel finds the right thing.

## [0.59.28] - 2026-09-17
### Added
- **Jarvis 007 filters noise out of what you say.** The mic is always on, so the TV, other people in the room or your muttering also got transcribed and went straight into the chat frame. Jarvis 007 now cuts the parts not addressed to it out of the sentence before answering, and a turn with only noise is dropped entirely: no reading, no bubble left behind, just one notice line that disappears after a few seconds.
- **A "Noise filter" box in the Conversation mode card,** on by default. If Jarvis 007 drops your sentences by mistake too often, turn it off, and then every sentence is answered verbatim as before. It runs only in Fast lane mode.
### Fixed
- **Speaking continuously for more than 30 seconds makes Jarvis 007 commit anyway, without waiting.** Before, as long as there was sound the "silence then send" clock kept moving back, so in a room with a TV it never fired: text piled up into a turn a page long and all that time Jarvis 007 looked deaf.

## [0.59.27] - 2026-09-17
### Fixed
- **Start with Windows: when Windows is blocking the startup entry, the button on the card changes to "Turn on again to fix".** Before, the card said "on but not running" while the only button was Off, so you had to guess the two clicks Off then On; Jarvis 007's entry on the project server had been turned off by Task Manager since the end of July and nobody noticed.
### Improved
- **Opening a workflow returns the right column straight to Settings, where the Run workflow button is.** Assistants still open at History as before, and the two kinds remember their tab separately so they no longer overwrite each other.
- **The three microphone items (listening language, silence then send, interrupt) sit together in the Conversation mode card,** with the Save mode button at the bottom of the card. New defaults: Fast lane mode, silence then send 1.2 seconds.
- **Listening language gains "Multilingual - not fixed".** The Groq Whisper listener recognizes the language being spoken by itself; the browser's listener can only follow the browser's language, and the card says so clearly.

## [0.59.26] - 2026-09-17
### Fixed
- **Attached files in assistant and workflow conversations are no longer cut off.** The attachment strip right above the input box was squeezed when the middle area lacked space, so the file chip showed only its upper half and looked hidden behind the model strip. It is now always tall enough, and the conversation part gives up space instead of the reverse.
### Added
- **A copy path button on every row in the Files & links frame.** One click puts the exact file path (or link address) on the clipboard to paste elsewhere, with no need to select the small text that is often cut off with an ellipsis. It exists on both rows you attached yourself and rows Jarvis 007 picked up by itself.
- **The file editor bar also has a copy path button,** right next to the Save button.
### Improved
- **The Files & links button has the same paperclip icon on all three screens** (Graph, Chat, Partners), instead of a different style per page for the same thing.

## [0.59.25] - 2026-09-16
### Improved
- **The chat frame shows the sentence you MEANT to say, not the raw text the listener heard.** In the fast lane, the voice brain rewrites the sentence it just heard to match your meaning (fixing every misheard English word, not just "Jarvis 007") and only then answers. Your bubble changes to that sentence, with a small "Heard: ..." below for comparison to check that Jarvis 007 understood correctly. Reloading the page still shows the interpreted sentence.
- In standard mode (main brain), a sentence corrected by the list of commonly misheard words is also shown again in the bubble in the same way.

## [0.59.24] - 2026-09-16
### Improved
- **Mixing in English, Jarvis 007 still understands the name correctly.** When you say "Jarvis 007" and the listener transcribes it as "David", "Jarvis" or "Gia vit", Jarvis 007 corrects it by sound and context before understanding the sentence, so it no longer answers "who is David". Your friend's name ("message David") is left alone.
- **A "Commonly misheard words" box in the Voice card in Settings.** Type the names of tools, projects and people you use often, separated by commas. Jarvis 007 primes the Groq listener with these words to spell them right, and corrects by context for both the browser's listener and Telegram and Zalo voice messages.
- The fast lane voice brain is told that the sentence comes from a listener and must be understood by what the speaker meant, not the literal meaning of a misheard word.

## [0.59.23] - 2026-09-16
### Fixed
- **When the fast lane falls back to the main brain, Jarvis 007 says why, right in the chat frame.** Before, when the voice brain failed (not installed, not signed in, quota out, no network), Jarvis 007 silently moved your sentence to the main brain: you turned on the mic, spoke, then waited tens of seconds as if the fast lane had never existed, with no line saying what happened. A line now shows the voice brain's name and the real error, with where to fix it.
- **The Voice card on the Settings page records the fast lane's latest error** until a speaking turn runs through cleanly, so opening Settings tells you whether the voice brain is broken or the setting has drifted back to standard mode.
- The server log writes one line when a message from the mic goes to the main brain because the voice mode is not Fast lane, so debugging does not have to guess.

## [0.59.22] - 2026-09-16
### Fixed
- **Clicking the notification of an assistant or workflow now opens the right Partners page.** Before, it dumped that chat into the main brain's chat frame, and the next message you typed flew straight into the assistant's session with no notice. The notice now remembers the specific conversation so it opens exactly the one that reported the result, not the most recent one.
- **Push notification titles no longer carry asterisks.** An answer like "**Reminder:** meeting at 3pm" used to show the raw pair of `**` in the middle of the phone's lock screen.
- **The API budget exhausted warning wears the "System" label** in the inbox, instead of the "Reply" label as if you had just asked something.
### Improved
- **A recurring job that runs fine no longer rings the bell.** A job running every 15 minutes that pushed a notification to the phone every round would end up making you turn notifications off completely, and then the things worth reporting (a broken job, a job that paused itself) would be lost too. Results still reach the chat frame, Telegram and the inbox in full as before; only when a job **breaks** or **pauses itself** does it ring. It is the same rule the jobs on the Work board have followed before.

## [0.59.21] - 2026-09-16
### Improved
- **Pinned conversations are visible at a glance, the same as assistants and workflows.** A pinned row has a color bar on the left and the pin mark always shows, with no need to hover to know. The other three buttons still show only on hover as before.
### Fixed
- **A failed Telegram conversation no longer lingers with a single message.** Before, any turn that failed had its error line fly straight out to Telegram and vanish, leaving a conversation in History with only your question, no name, no answer, and opening it explained nothing. The error line is now saved as an assistant message so opening it shows right away why that turn failed.
- **The log says why Telegram opened a new conversation**: too long a pause, brain mismatch, or the old record was deleted. Before, you only saw a series of short conversations without knowing what cut them apart.

## [0.59.20] - 2026-09-16
### Improved
- **Pinned assistants and workflows are visible at a glance.** Pinned items sit under the **Pinned** label, with a color bar on the left and a pin mark on the right edge of the row. Before, the pin mark sat inside the truncated name part, so a slightly long name made it vanish, and a pinned item looked just like an unpinned one.
- **The History tab now has ONE list.** Each workflow run produces exactly one conversation, so the two old lists were the same thing told twice. Only the conversation list remains, and the best of the run comes along: the faces of the assistants that cooperated stand before the title, and the status **done** or **error** is a small label beside the time.
- **New conversation and the search box sit right at the top of the column**, no longer pushed to the middle by another list. Each row can still be pinned, renamed and deleted as before.
- **The assistant and workflow list shows 20 items, click "Show 20 more" to open more.** A brain with several dozen partners no longer needs scrolling a very long column; changing tab, changing folder or typing a search returns to the first page.

## [0.59.19] - 2026-09-16
### Security
- **Upgraded Jarvis 007's web base to the patched version.** The old version had a spot that let outsiders send a few heavy requests to eat all the RAM and then hang Jarvis 007, and on Windows a spot that exposed the machine password. Update by rerunning the install command and it downloads the new version by itself; for a manual install, also run `pip install -r requirements.txt`.

## [0.59.18] - 2026-09-16
### Improved
- **Jarvis 007 starts about 75ms faster.** A data validation library used to load right when the app opened even though it served only a rare feature; it now loads only when needed. On a VPS, a faster start means fewer health check errors right after an update deploy.

## [0.59.17] - 2026-09-16
### Improved
- **Opening a file in a conversation with an assistant fully closes the chat frame.** The editor takes the whole middle area, with no conversation column squeezed beside it making both sides narrow. Closing the file (the **X** button on the editor bar) brings the chat frame back intact: the half spoken part and the half typed text are both still there.

## [0.59.16] - 2026-09-16
### Security
- **Patched a hole that allowed entering Jarvis 007 without signing in.** Just adding one `/` to a hidden line in the request bypassed the sign-in gate, and the API could be read and written as if signed in. Anyone with Jarvis 007 open to the Internet (VPS, Docker, or a home machine with a port open) should update right away; a machine running only internally cannot be reached by anyone.
- **The entrance now has two layers of locks.** The sign-in barrier reads the request's true path, and requests with a malformed address line are blocked right from the start.

## [0.59.15] - 2026-09-16
### Fixed
- **Typing a `/` command no longer edits your sentence.** Before, Jarvis 007 stuffed your sentence into the middle of a machine sentence ("Use skill X with the request: ...") and then **saved that whole thing as your message**, so reopening the conversation showed a sentence you never typed, plus a last sentence that appeared by itself. The instruction for the skill now travels separately, and the bubble and history show exactly what you typed.
- **Mentioning a skill name mid-sentence no longer loses text.** "Skill `/viet-bai-x` will be the main skill" used to be cut into "Skill will be the main skill". Now only the `/` is removed and the sentence keeps its meaning; and Jarvis 007 understands you are **talking about** the skill, not necessarily ordering it to run.
- **The sentence "if no skill has this name..." now appears only when the skill name does not exist.**
- **Leaving the Partners page returns the chat frame to the main brain.** Before, the chat with the assistant stayed intact on the Chat page, and the next message typed there still flew into the assistant's session even though you thought you were talking to Jarvis 007.

## [0.59.14] - 2026-09-16
### Added
- **Each assistant and each workflow has its own management menu.** Pointing at a row in the list shows a three dot button: **Pin to top**, **Move to folder**, **Edit**, **Delete**. Pinned items always sit at the top with a small pin mark beside the name.
### Improved
- **The right column changes order: History first, then Folders, Settings last.** The daily job is reopening an old conversation or a file, while assistant settings are edited once and done.
- **Opening a file in the chat frame no longer squeezes the conversation into a thread.** Jarvis 007 shrinks the right column to make room, and if still narrow it stacks the file on top and the conversation below, instead of two columns that are both unreadable.
### Fixed
- **Editing an assistant no longer loses its pin.** The editor used to rewrite the whole file, so everything not in the form was erased.

## [0.59.13] - 2026-09-16
### Fixed
