- **Windows: one command installs all four brains.** The new `install.ps1` installs the full package of Python, libraries, then `claude`, `codex`, `agy`, `grok`, creates `.env`, frees the port and starts the server, and finally prints a table telling which brain is ready. `setup.bat` and `install.sh` also install `agy` + `grok` instead of just two.
- **No more "CLI not installed" for a CLI that is on the machine.** Jarvis 007 now remembers where it once saw each CLI, so when another installer breaks PATH (installing Antigravity makes Claude Code vanish) it still finds it. It also probes the npm, nvm, volta, scoop and bun folders on Windows.
- **A missing library is reported at install time, not left to the sign-in screen.** Before, `setup.bat` kept going even when `pip install` failed, and only then did Jarvis 007 die for lack of `claude-agent-sdk`.
- **The missing CLI message states everything to do**: the install command, and a reminder to restart Jarvis 007 (a running process keeps the PATH from when it started so it does not see a just-installed CLI).
### Security
- Upgraded `python-multipart` to 0.0.31 and `python-dotenv` to 1.2.2 to clear three published vulnerabilities (issue #267).

## [0.59.12] - 2026-09-16
### Fixed
- **Messaging "fix the workflow" no longer gets the workflow run.** In a workflow's chat frame, a sentence about the workflow ITSELF (update, re-evaluate, merge some steps, summarize) is now answered by Jarvis 007 and edited straight into the workflow file. Before, it became the brief for a run: it took 10 whole minutes, used up plan quota, and returned an unrelated article.
- **If you really want to run, it still runs.** Clicking the **Run** button in the right column runs at once, with no second guessing; or resend the message with `chạy:` (run:) at the start. Jarvis 007 always says one line telling you it answered instead of running.
- **Running out of subscription plan turns midway through a run no longer leaks out as a "result".** The provider's English message is now a Vietnamese error with the reset time and the name of that step's assistant, on both workflow run paths.

## [0.59.11] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **On phones, the Partners page now shows the name of the open assistant.** Before, the name was squeezed by a few buttons down to a single letter; the top bar now has two lines: the top line is the face with name and role, and the bottom line has **Files & links**, **New conversation** and the two column buttons.
### Improved
- **The mascot always looks into the screen.** When there is no pointer to follow, if it hugs the right edge it glances left, and if it hugs the left edge it glances right, instead of always looking out past the border. Drag it to the other edge and the eyes switch direction at once.

## [0.59.10] - 2026-09-15
### Improved
- **The Partners page when empty now invites you to create on the spot.** A brand new brain used to show just one line of text in the middle of the screen, and clicking anywhere did nothing. Where the chat frame is, there are now two buttons **Create assistant** and **Create workflow** (with a way to the Jarvis 007 Store), and one click opens the creator directly.
### Fixed
- **The Retry button now truly reloads.** When the Partners page could not fetch the list, the old button only reopened the conversation: the error message disappeared, the left column stayed empty, and nothing was reloaded. It now reloads the list and says clearly that the failure was in fetching the list.

## [0.59.9] - 2026-09-15
### Improved
- **While Jarvis 007 is thinking, the mascot's eyes alternate between two poses**: a diagonal glance up as if searching memory, then drooping into two horizontal lines, each pose held about a second and a half. Before, it stayed in one pose for the whole answer.

## [0.59.8] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **A failed update now says why in plain Vietnamese.** Before, it threw git's own words onto the screen ("Not possible to fast-forward, aborting"), which is correct but only programmers understand. Jarvis 007 now says directly whether the machine is on the wrong branch, has no network, or has local changes blocking the way, with the exact command to run.

## [0.59.7] - 2026-09-15
### Improved
- **The ring around the mascot is much thinner and tidier.** Instead of twenty small dots running around, there are now just a few long thin streaks, slightly apart from the body. While working it is still clearly visible because the streaks change to the main color and brighten, not because they are thick.

## [0.59.6] - 2026-09-15
### Added
- **You can choose the mascot's eye color: black or white**, default black. Before, the eye color changed automatically with the body color and no one could choose.
### Improved
- **The Mascot page is arranged in one column from top to bottom** instead of two side by side boxes: Shape at the top, then Size, Color palette, Eye color, and the Save button at the bottom. Much easier to view on phones.

## [0.59.5] - 2026-09-15
### Improved
- **The mascot's quick menu has a mic switch.** Click the mascot to turn the mic on or off right there, and the menu text says clearly what the click is about to do.
- Removed the "Hide pet" item from the menu. To turn the mascot off, go to "Pet settings" in the same menu and click "Turn off mascot".

## [0.59.4] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **Opening a file while chatting with a partner no longer leaves a big gap in the middle of the screen.** The file now sits on the left, the conversation shrinks into a narrow column on the right, and the input box spans the bottom, exactly as on the Chat page.
- **A working mascot is now recognizable at a glance.** The ring around its body gets much thicker and glows the main color when Jarvis 007 listens, thinks, answers or hits an error; only when idle is it thin and pale as before.
- **Assistants stop blinking in unison.** Each assistant has its own rhythm so the list looks like different characters, not copies of one machine.
### Improved
- **The conversation history of assistants and workflows is now exactly the history column you know on the Chat page**: a search box just for that partner's conversations, grouping by day, pin, rename, delete, and a show more button.

- The picker shapes on the Mascot page get an orange ring around them, exactly like the real pet at the screen edge.

## [0.59.3] - 2026-09-15
### Added
- **The history of assistants and workflows has its own tab in the right column.** Before, it sat at the very bottom of the Settings frame, and you had to scroll past the whole form to see it. Now click the History tab and it is right there: past runs and conversations, with times, and the open one highlighted.
- **The mascot's quick menu has all 5 paths:** Chat, Assistants, Workflows, Pet settings, Hide pet. "Pet settings" now opens the Mascot page directly instead of dumping you on the general Settings page.

### Fixed
- **Choosing the "Extra large" size for the mascot now saves.** Before, the screen changed at once after choosing, but reloading the page went back to the old size with no explanation.
- **Clicking Stop on a workflow now truly stops it on screen.** Before, the chat said it stopped while the left column kept spinning and the right column still said "Running - Step 1/3".
- **Calling a workflow or assistant from the Chat frame now returns the result to that same frame**, with a link that reopens the conversation that did the work. Before, you were moved to the Partners page and the old chat frame never knew how the run turned out.
### Improved
- The Mascot page icon is the mascot's own face, no longer a generic smiley.

## [0.59.2] - 2026-09-15
### Added
- **The Partners page has a folder tree right beside it.** The right column now has two tabs: Settings as before, and Folders, which is exactly the folder tree you use on the Chat page. Message an assistant and open files at the same time without jumping pages.
- **A running workflow has a spinner in the list**, so a glance at the left column tells which is still working.
### Fixed
- **Clicking an .md file or image while chatting with an assistant now opens it.** Before, clicking did nothing, or threw you to the Files page.
- **Assistants with Vietnamese diacritics in the name can open conversations.** Before, selecting one showed a confusing technical error and chat was impossible.
- **A workflow that runs into trouble no longer reports "completed".** A failed step shows clearly as failed, and when a partner's brain runs out of subscription plan turns, Jarvis 007 says directly which step, which assistant, and when it reopens, instead of leaving a confusing English sentence where the result should be.
### Improved
- The partner search box shrinks to a magnifier button, and the group filter becomes a picker to reduce visual clutter.

## [0.59.1] - 2026-09-15
### Added
- **Each assistant and workflow has its own avatar.** The image is generated from the name, and its shape and color can be changed right in the settings column, so one glance tells who you are talking to.
- **The Run workflow button is right in the right column.** No more typing a sentence into the chat frame just to start a run.
- **Typing `/` in the chat frame jumps straight to a partner.** The list that appears has both assistants and workflows, typing without diacritics finds them, and choosing one opens exactly that conversation and sends the sentence you just wrote.
- **Files and links you attach to a conversation now reach assistants and workflows**; before, only the main brain could read them.
### Fixed
- **The voice reader is always off when the app opens**, and only turning on the mic turns on sound. Before, it remembered the old state so it sometimes read aloud unintentionally.
- With no assistant or workflow created yet, the input box is locked with a reminder line, instead of silently swallowing messages.
- A failed workflow save now shows a clear error; before, the window closed as if saved.

## [0.59.0] - 2026-09-15
### Added
- **The Partners page replaces the two pages Assistants and Workflows.** Choose an assistant and you can chat right away in exactly that role, each assistant has its own conversations and settings sit in the right column.
- **Workflows run right in the chat frame.** Sending a message is one run, the progress of each step shows in the right column, the result returns to the chat and later messages still remember the earlier result so you can keep giving feedback.
- **Run history is saved.** The right column lists the most recent runs, click to reopen; ask Jarvis 007 "how did the latest workflow run go" in the main chat frame to look up a saved result. A workflow that just ran moves to the top of the list by itself.

## [0.58.8] - 2026-09-15
### Improved
- **The Voice, branding & access section in Settings feels much less empty.** Before, it was in two columns, and the voice card was nearly ten times as long as the avatar card beside it, so half the screen was white space. It is now one column, each card one job, label on the left and picker on the right. The whole block is nearly half as short.
- **Choose voice and speed with a dropdown.** The seven Edge voices used to be seven square boxes stacked vertically taking nearly the whole screen for a single choice; speed was a graduated slider. Each is now compact in one row, and speed has five clearly named levels from Slow to Very fast. The voice and speed you are using stay as they are, not reset.
- **The Save button is the same everywhere.** Before, there were four kinds of buttons, some stretched wide and some tiny, each card placing it somewhere different. Now each card has exactly one Save button, always in the bottom right corner. The three Microphone items in particular say plainly that they apply immediately, with nothing to click.
### Fixed
- Choosing a fast or slow "Silence then send" now takes effect from the moment the app opens; before, you had to click once more each session for it to remember.

## [0.58.7] - 2026-09-15
### Improved
- **The warning line "I just scheduled it without creating a background job" is now shortened to two sentences.** The old one was three paragraphs, even explaining how the answer turn closes, and read in the middle of the chat it confused more than it explained.
- It now says only the two things you need to know: no report will come back by itself, and you can just message "do it now" or "assign a background job" and it is done.

## [0.58.6] - 2026-09-15
### Added
- **Added 5 new reading voices in Quick settings:** Ava, Emma (female) and Andrew, Brian, William (male). These are Edge's new generation multilingual voices, which recognize Vietnamese by themselves and read more smoothly than the two old voices, at the cost of a slight accent on a few words. Click Listen to try, then pick the voice you like.
- Still free and fast as before because they go through Edge too; nothing extra to install.
### Fixed
- The default female voice now shows its real name **Hoài My** instead of "Ngọc Thu".

## [0.58.5] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **"Scroll down" now scrolls what you are looking at.** Before, this command always pulled the chat frame, so on the Self-learning or Scheduled page, telling it to scroll made the list stand still while the chat frame next to it jumped. Jarvis 007 now scrolls the open content page, and returns to the chat frame only when you are on the main screen.
- To be specific, say it directly: "scroll this page down" or "scroll the chat frame to the top". Jarvis 007 also says back exactly what it just scrolled, instead of always saying "scrolled the chat frame".
- The Terminal page and the file editor scroll in an inner frame, so before the scroll command did nothing at all; Jarvis 007 now finds that exact frame. If the page has nothing to scroll, Jarvis 007 says so honestly instead of staying silent.

## [0.58.4] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **iPhone: the sentence you speak no longer shows orange text and then vanishes.** Safari on iPhone often delivers heard text in a temporary form that is never finalized, especially after a long conversation; before, at the end of the sentence Jarvis 007 took only the finalized part, so the sentence was empty and did not enter the chat frame. The temporary text is now sent exactly as you see it on the screen.
- **Interrupting while Jarvis 007 is answering is smoother.** Before, the interrupting sentence was resent after exactly 1.5 seconds; if the old turn had not stopped in time the server refused it, or if it stopped late it wrongly cleared the new turn's state so the text did not show and the speaker went silent. Jarvis 007 now waits for the signal that the old turn has fully stopped, and the sentence you just spoke stays on the screen while waiting instead of vanishing for a few seconds.

## [0.58.3] - 2026-09-15
### Improved
- **The sidebar has the "JARVIS 007" text back beside the mascot.** Before, that spot had only the face. When the sidebar is collapsed the text hides by itself, leaving only the face as before.

## [0.58.2] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **The sentence you just spoke no longer evaporates when the network blips.** On iPhone, switching chat frames often makes Safari close the connection to the server for a beat; before, a message sent at that moment was silently dropped, the text was received correctly but nothing entered the chat frame and there was no explanation. That sentence is now kept, sent as soon as the connection is back, and if it never reconnects it returns to the input box so you can click send again.
- **A lost connection is now reported right in the chat frame.** Before, there was only a line of text on the brain globe, but the globe is hidden entirely when you are on the Chat page, so exactly where you were typing there was no sign.
### Improved
- **The mascot has selectable sizes** (Small, Medium, Large, Extra large) on the Mascot page, and the default size is larger than before. Phones no longer shrink it automatically: a finger is bigger than a mouse pointer, and on a small screen a small pet is both hard to see and hard to tap.

## [0.58.1] - 2026-09-15
### Added
- **The logo spot on the sidebar carries the mascot's face** when you turn it on, and changes with the exact shape and color you chose. Turn the mascot off, or upload your own logo, and that spot returns to the old logo: your logo is your decision.
### Improved
- **The mascot stops looking straight ahead.** When the mouse leaves for a while it glances diagonally up to the upper right, the same look as in the logo image, instead of standing there staring blankly. The pointer can still pull its eyes in any direction; when released it drifts back to that glancing pose.

## [0.58.0] - 2026-09-15
### Added
- **Jarvis 007 has its own mascot, tucked at the screen edge.** A small face peeks out half its body at the right, the two eyes shifting to the visible part, following the pointer and blinking. It changes expression to match what it is doing: eyes wide open when listening, glancing up when thinking, curved when answering.
- **One click and it steps fully out with a quick menu** (chat, tasks, settings, hide) and stays out there; clicking elsewhere only closes the menu and does not pull it in. Drag and drop it anywhere; throw it near the edge and only then does it tuck back half its body.
- **A new "Mascot" page** in the System group: choose 1 of 5 shapes and 12 color palettes, or turn it off entirely. Each palette changes tone by itself for day or night mode, and the choice is saved per account so any machine you open shows the one you chose.
### Improved
- **The logo and favicon changed to the mascot's face** (an orange round block, two black eyes). The logo now changes with the app version, so you no longer update and still see the old logo sitting in the browser cache.
- **The sidebar is one level shorter.** The "Assistants" group is removed, its two items move down into "Brain" and stand at the top of the group. The "Jarvis 007" page is now called by its right name, **Graph**, and is still the first page that opens.

## [0.57.23] - 2026-09-15
### Added
- **A browser for Jarvis 007 to test the interface itself is now an option, installed with a button.** The Plugins page has an "Optional tools" section with an install button, and the first-run wizard asks too. A machine that already has Chrome makes Jarvis 007 use it and offers no download; only a server missing a browser sees the button. The download sits on the data drive so it stays intact after every update.
- When connecting Playwright and the machine has no browser yet, a reminder line shows right in the form, with a direct way to the Plugins page, instead of finding out after connecting that it cannot run.

## [0.57.22] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **The knowledge graph no longer dies when a brain has notes containing code.** Bash uses `[[ ... ]]` as a test, the same syntax as note links, so a piece of code in a note was misread as a link to a nonexistent note and the graph kept blaming it until it stopped drawing. Code blocks are now skipped before scanning for links, and one broken link no longer collapses the whole graph.

## [0.57.21] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **Telling it to stop a background job makes it truly stop, instead of spawning another job to go stop it.** Before, saying "pause the background search job" made Jarvis 007 say yes and then assign a new background job with the content "stop the running background job", and saying it again spawned yet another. That sentence is now understood as a command: cancel right on the spot, answer instantly, and say how many jobs were stopped. If no job is running it says so honestly instead of pretending it stopped.

## [0.57.20] - 2026-09-15
### Added
- **A job assigned by voice now shows as a card on the Tasks page.** On receiving the job there is a "running" card at once, when done the card moves to done with the result, and if it breaks or takes too long it moves to blocked with the real reason. No more asking aloud to know whether a job is alive or dead, and after it finishes the mark remains for review.
### Fixed
- **The brain globe no longer jitters or shrinks by itself when you speak.** Before, it followed the raw audio level read 60 times per second so it shook hard, and when Jarvis 007 was thinking all the dots shrank by nearly half, looking like the screen was zooming out. The breathing rhythm is now smooth and light, still alive with the voice but without jitter.
- **A job card is no longer stuck on "running" after a restart.** If the server shuts down midway the background job no longer runs, so the card is marked blocked with a reason instead of sitting there forever.

## [0.57.19] - 2026-09-15
### Added
- **Jarvis 007 checks in by itself when a background job runs long.** After assigning a job, instead of staying silent for minutes, it occasionally says "I'm still looking, wait a moment", and spaces it out rather than nagging: after 25 seconds, then one minute, then two minutes. If the wait is too long it honestly says it is taking longer than expected. It speaks only when you are not speaking and the speaker is free, and only while hands-free mode is on.
### Fixed
- **A job assigned by voice now shows in the background jobs strip.** Before, this kind of job appeared nowhere so you had no way to know whether it was alive or dead, other than asking aloud. It is now counted like every other running job.

## [0.57.18] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **Background jobs no longer disappear midway.** Jarvis 007 accepted a job, said "running in the background", then the result never came and asking again still said running. The cause: the background job was swept away by the system right while it was running because nothing held it. Background jobs now live fully until they finish.
- **A background job always reports back with a sentence, whether done, failed, stopped or too long.** Before, those cases were total silence and you sat waiting for a result that never came. After 10 minutes Jarvis 007 says plainly that it stopped and invites you to assign it again.

## [0.57.17] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **You can interrupt even while Jarvis 007 is thinking.** Before, the mic was closed during the whole processing time, sometimes tens of seconds, so adding context or telling it to stop was like speaking into empty space. The mic now keeps listening while it thinks: when you speak it drops the half finished sentence and takes the new one, with the full context of the previous sentence.
- **An interrupting sentence no longer gets lost.** The old turn needs a beat to fully stop, so the sentence you just spoke is kept and sent as soon as that turn closes, instead of being refused by the server and vanishing.
- **One stuck audio chunk no longer silences the whole answer.** When the network is slow and one audio segment jams midway, the rest used to go silent with no notice. Jarvis 007 now detects the stuck segment, skips it and keeps reading the next part.

## [0.57.16] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **A finished background job no longer freezes the chat frame.** After a background job pushed its result in, the conversation was wrongly considered "still answering": the send button locked, the next message vanished without a trace, the mic did not reopen and the screen stayed forever on "thinking". A background job result now only inserts one more bubble, without touching the turn's state.
- **Cutting in midway fully stops that turn.** Before, interrupting only muted the sound while Jarvis 007 kept writing for a sentence no one heard, and the session stayed busy so the sentence you just cut in with was blocked. Now speaking over it makes it stop the work in progress as well and listen to you.

## [0.57.15] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **Interrupting now really works.** The previous version did the recognition part right but it was never called: while talking by voice, the mic closed as soon as you finished speaking, before Jarvis 007 could answer, yet the condition for watching for an interruption required the mic to be open. Jarvis 007 now keeps its ears open the whole time it reads, so speaking over it makes it stop after about half a second. With hands-free mode off it reads in silence as before, hearing nothing.

## [0.57.14] - 2026-09-15
### Fixed
- **Speaking over Jarvis 007 makes it truly stop.** Before, while listening to a long passage, saying "stop" or "halt" made it jolt once and keep reading, because it had to wait 2 seconds for recognition to return text while a short utterance ended before the ears could open. Jarvis 007 now recognizes it within about half a second and stops fully.
- **No more Jarvis 007 hearing its own speaker and going mute.** When it suspects someone is speaking, it lowers its volume a notch and listens again: the echo from the speaker drops with it, a human voice does not, so it can tell right away. A loud external speaker can still use interruption, and the room's echo level is remembered for next times.

## [0.57.13] - 2026-09-14
### Improved
- **Forms of address are left free.** Removed the hard rule "default to you/me" and the test blocking the words anh/em in the source code: forms of address are each user's own matter, and Jarvis 007 addresses you the way you address it, following memory if there is one. The "empty promise" detector is kept and checked against every form of address.

## [0.57.12] - 2026-09-14
### Improved
- **The voice brain addresses you in kind.** However you address Jarvis 007, it answers to match, no longer forced into one fixed form of address; the built-in waiting phrases also drop pronouns so they do not clash with how you speak.

## [0.57.11] - 2026-09-14
### Improved
- **Conversation is never locked while Jarvis 007 is working.** In Fast lane, when you ask for a job needing data or action, Jarvis 007 says "Okay, let me look" and then hands that job to run in the background and goes right back to listening, instead of staying silent for tens of seconds and reporting "session is answering". You can assign many jobs in a row, and as each finishes its result shows by itself in the chat frame and is read aloud when you are not speaking.
- While waiting, if you ask about progress Jarvis 007 knows which jobs are running, does not invent results and does not reassign a duplicate job. Under the confirmation sentence there is a small line saying the job was received.

## [0.57.10] - 2026-09-14
### Improved
- **Text being heard shows right in the chat frame.** When you speak, the sentence being recognized shows as a faint draft bubble at the end of the conversation column, exactly where the message will appear when sent, instead of overlaying the brain block in the middle of the screen. When you finish, the draft bubble turns into a real message.

## [0.57.9] - 2026-09-14
### Added
- **The voice brain can be ChatGPT, Claude Code or Grok Build**, running on the plan you already signed in to on the Models page, with no API key. In Settings → Voice → Fast lane there are now three more options beside Antigravity and the APIs. ChatGPT goes straight over the network so it is fastest; Claude Code keeps a live session the whole time you talk so later turns cost only the model's thinking time (choose haiku for speed); Grok returns the answer in one lump rather than streaming word by word.
- The settings card reports by itself which is not ready (ChatGPT not connected, claude or grok not installed) with where to go.

## [0.57.8] - 2026-09-14
### Improved
- **Text appears along with the reading, like ChatGPT Voice.** When you talk by voice, Jarvis 007's answer bubble appears gradually exactly where the voice has reached, instead of showing the whole sentence first and the speaker chasing after it. If you interrupt midway the text stops exactly where Jarvis 007 had spoken, with an ellipsis at the end. Only after reading finishes are images, links, tables and follow-up question buttons fully drawn.
- Applies to standard mode, Fast lane and Live. Reloading the page still shows the full answer in history.

## [0.57.7] - 2026-09-14
### Improved
- **The sidebar finishes speaking Vietnamese.** The Capabilities group is now **Agents**, **Skills**, **Workflows**, **Plugins** (Chatbot unchanged), the exact wording the Jarvis 007 Store uses. Page titles still carry the English name in parentheses so anyone used to the old words recognizes them right away.
- **Voice commands follow the words you see.** Saying "open the plugins page", "show the skills page", "open the agents page" makes Jarvis 007 open the right tab, with no need to say the English name anymore.
- **Fixed: saying a Vietnamese page name did not open it.** The speech lane sends exactly the words you just said to the browser, so anything other than the English name was returned as "page does not exist". The words are now looked up first, and if not found Jarvis 007 says plainly that there is no such page.
## [0.57.6] - 2026-09-14
### Improved
- **Talking to Jarvis 007 is much smoother, in every mode.** Before, with the main brain, every few-word fragment was read aloud the moment it was generated, making dozens of chained voice calls that sounded choppy. Now Jarvis 007 reads in natural chunks: at the end of a sentence, or at a comma or conjunction in the first chunk so speech starts fast, and long sentences are cut where they are easy to hear; if the model is slow and the speaker is silent, it pushes out the chunk it has instead of making you wait.
- **Talk and type in the same conversation.** If the mic is on and you type extra text, the message still goes through the fast lane and Jarvis 007 still answers by voice; in Live mode the typed text goes straight into the session that is speaking.
- **For long jobs, Jarvis 007 says a short line first**, like "let me take a look", then gives the result, instead of staying silent for several seconds. The main brain is also told to answer briefly, like a person speaking, when you are listening by ear.
- Understands "wait wait wait a moment" or "stop stop stop" even if you stutter; if you end a sentence with "um" or "like", Jarvis 007 waits for you to keep thinking instead of sending early.

## [0.57.5] - 2026-09-14
### Fixed
- **Cleaned out the channel-subscribe pitches already sitting in old conversations.** The filter in the previous version only blocked them from the moment of listening onward, while old messages stayed put and were still read back as context every turn. There is now a command that rescans the store, deletes messages made up entirely of invented lines, and trims the invented part from messages mixed with your words. The filter also catches the variants "subscribe to the channel to support my channel" and "thanks for watching and see you again".
- The filter no longer inserts spaces into file names or web addresses when there is nothing to cut, and it leaves the sentence alone when you yourself are repeating that invented line.

### Improved
- **Opening tabs by voice is much faster.** Before, a sentence like "open the Models page" still went through the main brain with the whole conversation context and took dozens of seconds. Now the voice brain handles it itself, taking only its own thinking time.
- **You can also say "open the Capabilities section" or "collapse the sidebar".** Before, only single pages could be opened, with no command to expand a group collapsed in the menu. Opening a page by voice now also expands the group containing it, instead of leaving the sidebar collapsed as before.

## [0.57.4] - 2026-09-14
### Fixed
- **No more Jarvis 007 suddenly "hearing" a YouTube channel subscribe pitch.** The Groq Whisper listener learned from YouTube subtitles, so on a silence or noise it invented the familiar line "Hãy subscribe cho kênh Ghiền Mì Gõ...", and that line went straight into the chat box as if you had just said it. Now Jarvis 007 cuts such invented lines and keeps what you really said before or after; if the whole turn is only invented lines, it falls back to the browser's text.
- The filter is deliberately narrow, so you can still talk normally about subscribing to channels, making videos or running ads without a sentence being cut.

## [0.57.3] - 2026-09-14
### Fixed
- **Voice settings now really save.** Choose Fast lane or Live mode, choose the voice brain, choose how to listen, press Save, and the button said saved but the server wrote nothing, so a reload lost everything. Now those seven fields save correctly, and unknown values are ignored instead of breaking a voice turn.
- Saving the voice-reading card (Edge, OpenAI, ElevenLabs) no longer touches the Fast lane settings; the two cards share one section so they were easy to mix up before.

## [0.57.2] - 2026-09-14
### Fixed
- **Fast lane no longer sounds jerky and choppy.** Before, every few-word fragment was sent to be read the moment it was generated, making dozens of chained voice calls, each with a network wait, so it sounded cut into pieces and often showed "SLOW NETWORK". Now Jarvis 007 only reads once a sentence is complete (a period, question mark or line break), and cuts overly long sentences at a comma.
- While this sentence is being read, the browser has already downloaded the next one, so speech is continuous with no gap between sentences.

## [0.57.1] - 2026-09-14
### Improved
- **Live mode no longer freezes while Jarvis 007 fetches data.** Before, asking a question that needed numbers stalled the whole conversation until the main brain finished. Now that runs in the background: Jarvis 007 says "let me take a look", keeps listening and answering, and recounts the result when it arrives (Gemini 3.1 still waits silently because Google does not support this yet; 2.5 and OpenAI can keep talking).
- **Added OpenAI GPT-Live** (the new full-duplex model, 09/2026) as the third Live provider, in the same settings field, using the OpenAI key you already have. Jarvis 007 is its "base brain": the model decides when to hand off work, Jarvis 007 does it and returns the result for it to retell. Not yet tested for real.
- More accurate interruption with OpenAI Realtime: Jarvis 007 remembers only the part you actually heard, not the part not yet read. Gemini reconnects by itself when Google closes the connection after about 10 minutes, so you see no break.
- The Live session knows which page you have open and which passage you highlighted, like standard mode, so "summarize this passage" spoken aloud is understood too.

## [0.57.0] - 2026-09-14
### Added
- **A separate brain for voice, running on the Antigravity plan you already have.** In Settings → Voice choose "Fast lane" mode: when you speak, a light brain answers in 1 to 2 seconds instead of 5 to 10; for anything needing numbers, files, tasks or opening an app, it says "let me take a look" and hands off to the main brain, in the same conversation. You can choose Antigravity (no key needed), Groq, Gemini, OpenAI or OpenRouter.
- **Listening with Groq Whisper** if you already have a Groq key: more accurate Vietnamese text, and the interim text still appears instantly as before.
- **Live mode: direct speech** through Gemini Live or OpenAI Realtime (needs the vendor's API key), with an expressive voice, natural interruption, and it can still ask the main brain when it needs data. The provider can be changed right in the same settings card.

### Improved
- The Settings page has a "Voice mode and brain" card that reports which one is not ready (agy not installed, key not pasted).

## [0.56.0] - 2026-09-14
### Added
- **More natural talking with Jarvis 007.** Say "hold on" or "wait a moment" and Jarvis 007 goes quiet and waits for you; say "enough" or "stop" and it stops reading. If a sentence ends with "and", "but" or a comma, Jarvis 007 waits longer instead of sending early. If you cut in while Jarvis 007 is reading, it pauses for 2 seconds to see whether you are really speaking; if so, it stops fully and answers, resuming from where it was reading, and if it was a cough it keeps reading.
- **Voice control.** "Open the Tasks page", "open file X", "scroll down" and the dashboard does it. "Open Chrome", "close Excel", "which apps are open" and Jarvis 007 opens or closes apps on the very machine running Jarvis 007 (on a VPS it says plainly that it cannot). Highlight a passage and say "summarize this passage" and Jarvis 007 knows which one.
- **A truthful status line in the middle of the speaking screen:** CALLING a tool name, WAITING FOR YOU, PAUSED, RECONNECTING, and the suffixes SLOW NETWORK or N BACKGROUND JOBS appear only when really measured.

### Improved
- Speech starts earlier: the server streams audio as soon as it is generated instead of waiting for the whole sentence. Added two buttons in quick Settings: the silence level before sending, and an on/off switch for interrupting by voice.

## [0.55.66] - 2026-09-13
### Fixed
- **You can now exit the image viewer on a phone.** Tapping a photo in chat got you stuck: the close button sat under the phone's clock and battery bar so you could not hit it, and swiping from the left edge to go back did nothing. Now the toolbar sits below the status bar, and **an edge swipe or pressing Back closes the image** instead of throwing you out of Jarvis 007.
- Closing with the X button, the Esc key or tapping the black background also clears the back step, so you do not have to press Back one more pointless time.

## [0.55.65] - 2026-09-13
### Added
- **Jarvis 007 can fix an old skill, instead of only knowing how to create new ones.** Before, when a skill showed a flaw, the self-learning loop either skipped it or spawned a near-duplicate beside it. Now it edits that exact file, keeping the name, group and all your customizations, and writes a one-line reason in the History section for you to read back.
- Six guards: a reason is mandatory, it never creates a new one when the file is not found, it never touches a skill you turned off, it never touches system skills (Jarvis 007 updates those itself with new versions), and pinning `learn_lock: true` on a skill forbids self-learning from editing it. With git it can still be undone in one tap.

### Improved
- **Long-term memory cleans up expired information on its own.** When you changed an old fact, the old record stayed in the memory index and was still read into every question. Now Jarvis 007 removes it from the index, along with lines pointing to files you deleted by hand. **The memory file is not deleted**, it only leaves the index.
- Jarvis 007 deliberately does **not** clean by age: something true last year is still true this year.
- Removed all long dashes in the files Jarvis 007 writes itself (memory index, wiki index, learning log). That character made read-aloud stumble.

## [0.55.64] - 2026-09-13
### Added
- **Jarvis 007 learns from the work it does itself, not only from what you say.** Before, only conversations entered the self-learning loop, so every background job on the Tasks page passed without leaving anything. Now when a background job finishes (or gets stuck) it is put into the same learning queue. A **blocked** job gets top priority, because it points exactly at what the system is missing.
- It still goes through all the old steps: batching several jobs and learning in one pass, running in a separate read-only session, with a re-check pass before writing. A job spawned by the learning loop itself does not come back as a lesson for itself.

### Fixed
- **Telegram briefings no longer carry an English status line at the start.** The gold price briefing of 13/09 morning opened with "The task has been started in the background. Waiting for results." - that is a line the Antigravity brain says to itself while waiting, wrongly joined in front of the real content. Now only the final answer is sent. The numbers and saved data were not affected.

## [0.55.63] - 2026-09-10
### Fixed
- **Attached images and files are no longer lost when you press Enter early.** Paste an image or a long passage, then type a question and press Enter right away, and before the message went out empty-handed: the bubble had no image and Jarvis 007 did not receive the file. Now Jarvis 007 waits for the file upload to finish before sending, with a line shown while waiting; if the upload fails, it says so plainly so you can remove or reattach.
- **Reopening an old conversation still shows which images and files you sent.** Before, tapping a conversation in History, or reopening the app after leaving it in the background a long time, made every image and file card in your bubbles disappear. Now they reappear in the right place, and images can be tapped to enlarge as when just sent.

## [0.55.62] - 2026-09-10
### Changed
- **Removed the old safety rule "background work must never spend money, place orders, post, or message customers by itself".** Jarvis 007 now acts by itself: repeating tasks and Kanban tasks created from chat default to **Full access**, and Jarvis 007 may set this level itself without a risk warning. A new repeating task is still off, and you press Turn on on the Tasks page.
- **A tidier Tasks page**: the Full access button is the default, with no red warning box and no two "Are you sure?" dialogs when saving or turning on. A reminder, once created, also no longer comes with a long warning.
- The two light levels **Auto (drafts)** and **Suggest (read only)** remain for you to hold back a specific task; the hub still blocks for real according to the level you chose. The permission level of each MCP connection and of the dedicated bot is unchanged.

## [0.55.61] - 2026-09-09
### Fixed
- **File links of the form `file:///brains/...` in chat now open when tapped.** Antigravity often writes links like this (with %20), and before, tapping one only gave a "File not found" box. Now Jarvis 007 strips them back to the path in the brain, in links, images and plain text; old links in history open too.
- **File names with parentheses are no longer wrongly reported as "file not found".** For example "30 Ngày Làm Chủ Antigravity (CES Global).md" used to be cut at the first closing parenthesis.
- Jarvis 007 tells every brain outright not to use `file://` when giving links, so Telegram and Zalo (which have no auto-fix step) open them too.

## [0.55.60] - 2026-09-09
### Improved
- The author label at the bottom of the navigation bar changed to **"by Jarvis 007 Foundation"** (the repo owner changed their mind right after version 0.55.59).

## [0.55.59] - 2026-09-09
### Improved
- The author label at the bottom of the navigation bar changed from "by Minh Quý" to **"by Jarvis 007 team"**.

## [0.55.58] - 2026-09-08
### Fixed
- **Files created from chat now sit in the brain, and links open when tapped.** Before, Claude Code in chat worked in the app install folder rather than the brain folder, so "written" files landed in the wrong place and vanished with the next update, links in chat pointed into nothing, and the post count was 3 one time and 5 the next. Now chat runs right inside the brain folder, as Codex, Antigravity and Grok already do.
- **File links in answers are fixed by Jarvis 007 into an openable form.** A link pointing to a file not in the brain gets a line saying so right below it, instead of a mute link.
- **Old conversations no longer get stuck when the Claude Code session is lost on the machine**: Jarvis 007 opens a new session and primes it from the saved history. The first turn after updating will show a line saying so, which is normal.
- The old-image cleaner no longer deletes `.txt` text files left in the image folder.

## [0.55.57] - 2026-09-08
### Fixed
- **A hiccup from Google no longer kills the whole chat turn.** When Antigravity hit a `503 UNAVAILABLE` error, Jarvis 007 only showed a six-line English message and gave up. Now Jarvis 007 waits and retries 2 times; if it still fails, it says plainly that this is an error on Google's side, not your configuration. A turn that has already sent a message or written a file is never rerun.
- **Background work that finishes returns the FULL result right in the chat box**, instead of a 240-character snippet with an invitation to read the rest on the Tasks page. Telegram and Zalo still get the short version for a glance on the phone.
- **Opening a .txt or .md file on a phone can now be exited.** Before, as soon as it opened the keyboard popped up and hid the Close button, a phone has no Esc, and the Back button left the app entirely. Now the file opens full screen, no longer opens the keyboard by itself, the Close button is bigger, and **pressing Back closes the file** rather than leaving Jarvis 007.

## [0.55.56] - 2026-09-08
### Added
- **A fresh install can be updated right away.** Watchtower, which makes the **⬆ Update now** button work, now ships in both the Hostinger compose and the VPS compose. Before, the Hostinger version did not have it and the VPS one hid it behind an option, so one machine had the button and the other did not, and Hostinger had to go into Docker Manager and press Redeploy every time.
- **To avoid pressing the button:** set `JAVIS_AUTO_UPDATE=true` (Hostinger: the Environment field) and Jarvis 007 looks for a new version every day by itself. Off by default, because auto-update means the app restarts itself whenever a new version appears, cutting off running work.

### Fixed
- **A machine still missing the update button is told exactly one thing to do**: get the new compose file and rebuild. The old line telling Hostinger machines "cannot be turned on" is no longer true.

> A running version needs to be **redeployed once** with the new compose to get Watchtower: on Hostinger press **Redeploy**, on a VPS download `docker-compose.yml` again then run `docker compose up -d --pull always`.

## [0.55.55] - 2026-09-08
### Fixed
- **Antigravity models like `gemini-3.8-flash-medium` can chat again.** That model name already includes the thinking level, but Jarvis 007 still sent the **Thinking depth** level you chose, so Antigravity refused to run: you only got two red lines and the message "no content returned". Now Jarvis 007 recognizes this kind of model and no longer sends the extra part; the depth you chose becomes a hint in the question.
- **When Antigravity refuses for another reason, Jarvis 007 reruns it right away**, instead of leaving you with an English error line.
- **One incident shows only one error line.** In a long conversation, the same error used to appear twice identically.

## [0.55.54] - 2026-09-08
### Improved
- **Switching to English is now real English.** Before, after changing language there were still many Vietnamese areas: Jarvis 007 Store, the Chatbot page, Token usage, the notification inbox, the terminal, conversation history, the file editor, the background-work strip and most of the Settings, Connections, Models and Updates pages. Over 1,200 more strings now have English versions.
- **Changing language takes effect at once** in the notification inbox, the model picker, the Usage page and the domain card. Before, these places drew their text once and stopped, so you had to reload the page to see the change.

### Fixed
- **Reminders set in English can now be created.** The input box invited you to type "in 30 minutes" but Jarvis 007 only understood "30 phút nữa", so following the hint exactly meant the reminder was silently not created. Now both languages are understood.
- **Clicking a task card shows content in the detail drawer**, instead of opening empty and frozen.
- **The slash menu in the editor filters correctly again.** Before, typing any letter showed all ten commands.

## [0.55.53] - 2026-09-07
### Fixed
- **The search box in Jarvis 007 Store takes whole sentences, no longer one letter at a time.** Before, typing one letter threw the cursor out of the box, and you had to click back in to type the next letter.
- Typing in the middle of existing text also lands in the right place, no longer jumping to the end.
- Typing accented Vietnamese in this box no longer drops the tone marks.

## [0.55.52] - 2026-09-07
### Fixed
- The new Docker build always checks and installs the current Codex at release, avoiding the case where Jarvis 007 updates but the ChatGPT list stays stuck on an old model because a cached installer was reused.
- Reinstalling with `install.sh` or updating with `update.sh native` also upgrades Codex to receive the new per-account model list.

## [0.55.51] - 2026-09-07
### Fixed
- **Two brains sharing one identical memory file no longer make the second brain lose its long-term memory.** Before, Jarvis 007 numbered each memory piece only by file name, line number and content, so two brains having a file like `facts/cach-lam-viec-chuan.md` were treated as one piece. The brain that built its index second was silently rejected, and in saving mode it answered remembering nothing, with not one error line.
- Now the memory ID also carries each brain's own mark, so sharing a memory file between brains is normal. On the first run after updating, Jarvis 007 rebuilds the memory index of every brain by itself; nothing for you to do and it does not touch files in the brain.
- If you renamed a file in one brain to dodge this bug, you can rename it back.

## [0.55.50] - 2026-09-06
### Fixed
- **Opening Jarvis 007 after each update is much faster.** Before, every update made the browser reload the whole interface, about **1.6 MB** uncompressed. Now the interface is compressed to **496 KB**, and only files that really changed need reloading; the rest uses the copy already saved on your machine.
- **The Models page no longer stays stuck on "Loading...".** It waited for Jarvis 007 to ask whether Claude Code was signed in, and that query had no time limit, so any Claude hiccup hung the whole page. Now there is a 2.5 second limit, after which the page shows up normally.
- **Jarvis 007 creates fewer duplicate wiki pages.** Once the wiki grew past about 60 pages, Jarvis 007 only "saw" part of the index, and the hidden part was exactly the newest pages, so it thought a page did not exist and made it again. Now it sees the whole wiki, including pages in subfolders, and recognizes other names for the same topic.
- **Memories Jarvis 007 just wrote no longer vanish.** On a Linux server, a brain could end up with two memory folders of the same name differing only in letter case, and every note landing in the second one was never read back by Jarvis 007: written then lost, with no error. Now Jarvis 007 merges the two folders into one on the next conversation, and if both sides have the same file name it keeps both rather than overwriting.

## [0.55.48] - 2026-09-05
### Added
- **The "In this conversation" panel can now add files and links itself**, just like the Project panel: find a file in the brain, upload a file from your machine (or drag and drop onto the panel), paste a link, remove it when no longer needed.
- The list is split into two clear parts: what **you add** on top, and what Jarvis 007 detects from messages below. A file Jarvis 007 quietly wrote between turns that did not make it into the list can now be attached by hand.
- **Pinning a file makes Jarvis 007 read its content in every turn of that conversation only** (up to 2000 characters per file). If not pinned, Jarvis 007 only sees the name and opens it when needed.

## [0.55.47] - 2026-09-05
### Fixed
- **Jarvis 007 no longer "forgets" the packs you installed.** When there are many sources, Jarvis 007 hides some tools to stay light and keeps only an index. But that index merged the tools of EVERY pack into one generic line, so Jarvis 007 did not know it had the TTS Dropship, Meta Ads or Zalo pack, and answered outright that it was not connected even though the pack ran fine.
- **The index now names each pack** with a line on what it does, for example "TTS Dropship, 20 tools: dropship selling on the thitruongsi.com marketplace". Once Jarvis 007 sees it is there, it knows how to use it.
- Still as light as before: this saves 93% of the space compared with laying out all the tools, almost the same as before the fix.

## [0.55.46] - 2026-09-05
### Fixed
- **Antigravity sign-in in the Code tab now has a place to paste the code.** Before, typing `agy` printed a Google link and then froze: you opened the link on your own machine, signed in, and there was still no box to enter the code, so signing in was impossible. Now Jarvis 007 tells `agy` correctly that you are sitting at another machine, so it asks for a paste spot as it does over SSH.
- **How to do it, in 3 short steps:** type `agy` in the Code tab, open the link it just printed in the browser on your machine, sign in to Google. The browser jumps to a `localhost` address that **says it cannot be opened - that is the right step**: copy that whole address from the URL bar, paste it back into the terminal and press Enter.
- The **Google Antigravity CLI** card on the Models page is rewritten to follow these three steps, with a rescue line using `curl` for older `agy` versions that do not ask for a paste spot.
- Applies to machines without a screen (VPS, Docker, including Docker on your Mac). A desktop machine running directly still opens the browser by itself as before.

## [0.55.45] - 2026-09-05
### Improved
- **Connection cards in the Store have real logos.** Before, every connection downloaded from the store showed only a letter tile, and at a glance you could not tell Gmail from Shopify. Now the store declares a logo for each pack and the card shows that exact logo, the same image as on the Connections page after install.
- Logos are only fetched from the exact place that hosts the store catalog, and images are never loaded from a foreign server, so opening the grid reveals nothing to third parties.

## [0.55.44] - 2026-09-05
### Added
- **When a subscription plan runs out of turns, Jarvis 007 asks again by itself when the quota reopens, with no need for you to watch the clock.** When Claude Code, ChatGPT (Codex), Grok Build or Antigravity says "out of turns, reopens at 13:01", a card appears under that message: "Auto-retry at 13:01 (42 minutes left)". At that time, Jarvis 007 asks the same question again and answers in the same conversation, even if you closed the tab or turned off your phone screen.
- The card has a "Auto-continue when the quota resets" box (it remembers your choice for next time) and a "Run again now" button if you do not want to wait. Sending a new message while waiting cancels the schedule.
- It only schedules when the provider states the reopening time clearly, and at most 3 times per question; if the time is not known, the card only has the run-again-now button, and no time is guessed.

## [0.55.43] - 2026-09-05
### Added
- **When an installed pack has a new version, the Store says so from the top of the page.** A banner "N installed packs have updates" sits at the top; tapping it jumps straight to the right group with a filter leaving only those packs. Before, you had to happen to click the right tab to see it, so you almost never knew when a Skills or Assistants pack had an update.
- **Each tab carries its own badge** showing how many packs need updating, visible even when you are on another tab. The left column gains a filter row "Has update".

### Fixed
- **Pack cards stop showing the wrong version number.** A pack running 1.0.0 while the store has 1.0.1 still showed "v1.0.1" right above the line "Installed on this machine", saying you were running the new version when you were running the old one. Now the card shows both: which version is running, which version the store has.
- **Opening the Store page no longer looks at this morning's catalog.** The catalog was cached for 6 hours, so a newly released version still did not appear, with no sign of it. Now when the catalog is too old the page refetches it by itself, and a line states what time it was fetched.

## [0.55.42] - 2026-09-05
### Fixed
- **The thinking level now really works on ChatGPT (Codex).** Jarvis 007 sets exactly the level that Codex itself declares that model accepts, so whichever notch you choose is the notch you get, instead of just a hint word in the question.
- **Grok and Antigravity no longer get odd words pasted at the end of the message.** Before, Jarvis 007 inserted Claude Code's own keyword into the question sent to these two brains, which did not understand it so nothing changed. Now it is a Vietnamese sentence stating the depth plainly, and if the CLI version has a real lever, Jarvis 007 uses that lever.
- Jarvis 007 only uses a lever when the CLI itself declares it has one, so an older version on your machine still runs normally.

## [0.55.41] - 2026-09-05
### Fixed
- **The two highest thinking levels are now really different.** "Very high" and "Max" used to give the same result on every brain, whichever level you pressed was the same with no warning. Now Jarvis 007 uses the proper levers of Claude Code and Anthropic so whichever level you choose is the level you get.
- **Changing the thinking level no longer adds words to your message.** Before, Jarvis 007 stuffed a hint sentence at the end of every question to signal the model; now it goes through a real setting, using fewer tokens and keeping messages cleaner.
- **New OpenAI and Google models also show up by themselves.** These two vendors were filtered by name, so a model line named differently from the old style vanished from the picker. This is the same bug as the missing Fable 5.1, just a different provider.

## [0.55.40] - 2026-09-05
### Added
- **All the guide documents now have an English version.** The 27 pages in `docs/`, plus the server install guide and the contributing guide, all have bilingual versions.
- **Each page starts with a language switch line** like "Tiếng Việt · English", and tapping it goes to the matching page, with no need to search for it.
- The English index at `docs/en/` follows the same order and groups as the Vietnamese version.

### Improved
- The bilingual docs test now guards all 32 page pairs: a dead link, a missing language switch line or an accidental long dash makes CI complain at once.

## [0.55.39] - 2026-09-05
### Fixed
- **Claude Fable 5.1 is now in the model picker.** The model list for the Claude Code plan is now read straight from the Claude Code installed on your machine, so when the provider releases a new version you see it right away, without waiting for Jarvis 007 to release a version.
- **The old model list no longer hides new models.** A long-running machine got stuck on the lineup from the day of install, and no matter how many times Jarvis 007 was upgraded the new model line never showed. Now the two lists are merged, and neither erases the other.
- **Choosing `fable` or `opus` gives the newest version.** Before, it could quietly run an older version of the same line.
- **Turning on thinking depth on Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 no longer errors**, and the Usage page prices each version correctly: Opus since 4.5 is cheaper than before, while Fable is more expensive than Opus.

## [0.55.38] - 2026-09-05
### Added
- **Agents and Workflows are arranged by group, like the Skills page.** These two pages now have a group column on the left with counts and a search box, so a brain with several dozen agents is no longer a flat list to scan by eye.
- **Set the group right in the form.** Editing an agent or workflow has a Group field, type in it or pick from existing groups. Left blank, it sits in "General" ("Chung").
- **Old files are not lost.** Agents and workflows created before that have no group and automatically sit in "General", still visible and still running as before.
- When Jarvis 007 creates an agent or workflow itself it also assigns a group, and the capability index in the brain lists by group too.

### Fixed
- **Editing a workflow no longer loses the text you are typing.** Before, typing a name or description and then pressing add step made those two fields go back to the old value, with no warning.

## [0.55.37] - 2026-09-05
### Improved
- **Jarvis 007 Store moves to the sidebar.** It sits right under Connections, no longer needing you to enter a capability page and then press a tab to reach it. Reason for the change: since 0.55.36 most connections are in the store, and a new installer has no page yet to press a tab on.

### Fixed
- **The "Back" button no longer points to the wrong place.** Enter the store from the Skills page tab, leave, then enter again from the sidebar and the old button was still there and led back to Skills - where you had never come from.

## [0.55.36] - 2026-09-05
### Added
- **16 connections moved out to the Jarvis 007 Store.** Pancake POS, Shopify, Meta Ads, Facebook Pages, TikTok Ads, Slack, Lark, n8n, Hostinger, Webcake and a few more are now installed from the store instead of shipping with the app. In return, their updates arrive straight through the store, without waiting for a new Jarvis 007 version.
- Staying in the app: **Composio**, **the Google suite** (Calendar, Gmail, Drive/Docs, Sheets, Tasks, Keep, Ads, Search Console, NotebookLM), **Zalo**, **Botcake**, **Substack**, and the **Add your own (advanced)** box.
- **Existing connections are not lost.** If you use one of the 16 above, the Connections page shows a reminder line with a button to reinstall exactly that one. Once installed it keeps running on the old sign-in, with no need to connect from scratch.

### Improved
- **The pack install screen is completely redone.** It has a .zip file drop zone, the pack's image, and a panel stating which file the pack comes from, what its fingerprint is, and what it adds to your machine. On a phone it slides up from the bottom of the screen, with the button within thumb reach.
- **Packs with only data are turned on right after install.** Before, every pack entered the machine switched off, so after installing a connection nothing seemed to happen. A pack that runs code is still off by default so you can review it first.

### Fixed
- **Removing a built-in connection now asks again before removing.** Before, if no one had connected any account, tapping the × in the card corner by mistake made the service disappear at once, with no question. Now there is always a question, and if connections are running it names each one about to stop.

## [0.55.35] - 2026-09-05
### Improved
- **Jarvis 007 Store on a phone is laid out anew.** The type row becomes a segmented strip with counts under the names, the domain groups wrap into several rows instead of a strip you must swipe sideways, and the search box takes the full width.
- **No group is hidden anymore.** The old horizontal scroll strip made you see only the first four groups when there were really ten; now you see them all at once.
- Buttons in the store are big enough to tap with a finger, and on a narrow screen cards stack in one column.
- One repeated heading line removed on phones, lifting the type selector almost a quarter of the screen higher.

## [0.55.34] - 2026-09-05
### Fixed
- **Some buttons in the store showed the wrong font.** Buttons did not automatically use the page's font, so the tab row and group column appeared in the machine's default font in the middle of a Montserrat page. Now the whole page has one font.

### Improved
- **The Install Store is renamed Jarvis 007 Store**, and the text in the store is larger for easier reading.
- **There is a back button.** Enter the store from the Skills page and one tap returns to the Skills page.
- **The "Install from .zip file" button moves to the top**, right next to the search box.
- **Removed the "Installed" block at the bottom of the page.** It repeated what is already in the grid; the temporary on/off switch moved straight onto each item's card.

## [0.55.33] - 2026-09-05
### Added
- **26 Jarvis 007 connections now have a version in the store.** From now on they no longer have to ship with the app: remove them to keep things tidy and get them back from the store at any time, and a connection's update arrives straight through the store rather than waiting for a new Jarvis 007 version.
- Three connections stay in the app because they cannot be packaged: **Zalo** (QR code sign-in has its own path), **Botcake** and **Substack** (they call straight into the Jarvis 007 core).

### Improved
- The store does not show two cards for the same service. While the app still has its own version, the store's card is hidden; remove the app's version and the store card appears and can be installed.

## [0.55.32] - 2026-09-05
### Added
- **The Connections page splits into two tabs**: "Connected" and "Available connections", plus a path to the Store. Before, the two lists sat in one scroll, so anyone with several dozen connected accounts had to scroll through all of them to reach where to connect a new one.
- With nothing connected yet, the first tab points straight to the next step, instead of leaving you looking at an empty box.

### Fixed
- **The connection health dot was stuck on gray.** A function removed long ago was still being called, killing the dot painting midway, so only the first connection got painted and the rest did not. Now every dot is painted, and hovering shows how long ago the last check was.

## [0.55.31] - 2026-09-05
### Added
- **The Store is rebuilt with a new design.** A row of tabs by type with counts on top, a domain group column on the left, cards with real logos and group labels, and pagination when the store gets long.
- **Every Jarvis 007 connection now lives in the store**, pre-marked "Installed on this machine". You have one single place to see what Jarvis 007 connects to, instead of two separate lists.
- **Remove and reinstall right on the card.** Remove an unused connection to tidy the screen; change your mind and press Reinstall. A connection already connected is not deleted, it just stops until you reinstall.
- You can filter community-submitted items separately, and that filter only shows when the store really has community items.

## [0.55.30] - 2026-09-05
### Added
- **The Store moves to its own repo: [javis-store](https://github.com/blogminhquy/javis-store).** From now on, adding an item to the store makes every machine running Jarvis 007 **see it right away**, with no waiting for any update.
- **Anyone can contribute items to the store.** The store repo is public, with a submission guide and a list of what gets inspected during review. Every item has its code read before entering the store.
- Each item's source code sits right next to the download file, so you can read it **before** installing rather than downloading first and looking after.

### Improved
- Older Jarvis 007 versions (0.55.24 to 0.55.29) can still view and install old items as usual, so no one is left stranded midway.

## [0.55.29] - 2026-09-04
### Fixed
- **The "You need to grant microphone permission" dialog kept appearing, pressing OK made it pop again, with no way out.** When the mic was blocked or the machine had no mic, Jarvis 007 kept reopening the mic twice a second, one dialog each time. Now on a mic error it **stops completely** and turns off always-listening mode by itself.
- **The mic error message states the true cause.** When Jarvis 007 is opened through a local network address or a domain without HTTPS, the browser blocks outright and never asks for permission, so "please grant permission" was advice that could not be followed. A machine with no mic used to be completely silent, now it says so plainly.
- **A failed update says at which step it failed.** Before, when rolling back to the old version failed, Jarvis 007 only said "see update.log" - useless if you do not know where the log is, and worse, it did not say whether the machine was running old code or the new broken version. Now it names the failing step with a fix command.
- **ChatGPT sign-in is less hit-or-miss.** It used to ask OpenAI only once and stop, and if the other side was a beat slow the whole sign-in failed. Now it retries a few times, and if it still fails it says plainly that the other side is slow, not your machine.

## [0.55.28] - 2026-09-04
### Fixed
- **Pressing the "Store" tab did not open the store.** The button threw an error on the very first press due to a coding bug in version 0.55.26. Now pressing it goes there.
- **Every item in the store showed English names** even when the interface was set to Vietnamese, including domain group names. The bug dated from version 0.55.22 and was hard to see because there was still text to read, so it looked like a pack missing a translation.

### Improved
- Added a new kind of interface test: instead of only scanning text in the source code, it **really runs** the page's code and then tries clicking. Exactly the kind of bug just seen that the old check missed.

## [0.55.27] - 2026-09-04
### Fixed
- **Pack installs were blocked outright with the message "needs Jarvis 007 >=0.55.25, this version is " (left blank).** Jarvis 007 read the wrong place for its own version number, so it thought it was version 0.0.0 and refused every pack. The bug hit the Docker build and every build that moved its data folder, which is nearly every real machine. Now installing works, both from the store and from a .zip file.
- If for some reason Jarvis 007 still cannot read its own version number, it **skips** the version comparison instead of blocking everything. A Jarvis 007 bug should not turn into a whole store being unusable.
- The Store page had borrowed the Home page's title by mistake. Now it has its own title.

### Improved
- **The Store leaves the sidebar.** It is not a function equal to Assistants or Skills, but a place you visit to get one more of them. The way in is now a tab right on the page you are on.
- **The Connections page also has a Store tab**, which opens already filtered to connections. That makes all five: Assistants, Skills, Workflows, Tools, Connections.

## [0.55.26] - 2026-09-04
### Added
- **Store**: ready-made assistants, skills, workflows and tools, arranged by domain, press Install and done. The old **Packs** page becomes this page, and the store sits at the very top because that is what you come in to find.
- **Enter the store from the very page you are on.** The Assistants, Skills, Workflows and Plugins pages each gain a **Store** tab, which opens already filtered to that page's type. It is still one single store, just with a different chip switched on.
- **The first item in the store to try**: "Calculate selling price". Enter the cost price, choose a profit margin or markup, add VAT then round up to a nice number. It returns the **actual margin after rounding**, not the number you just typed.

### Improved
- The domain filter chips show a readable name ("Sales") instead of the code ("ban-hang"), and when filtering leaves nothing it says so instead of leaving a blank space.

## [0.55.25] - 2026-09-04
### Added
- **A pack can carry assistants, workflows and skills too**, not only services and tools. Installing a pack gives the open brain these things, ready to use at once.
- **The store tells official packs from community packs**, with a separate filter tab. For a community pack the confirmation screen says more than one line before you press.
- **Access tokens can be saved for private stores**, one token per host name. From then on you can install packs from a private repo, not only the public store.

### Security
- **Jarvis 007 never overwrites what you wrote yourself.** If you install and the brain already has an item with the same name, Jarvis 007 keeps yours and skips the one in the pack. A pack update only overwrites when the item is still exactly as it was at install.
- **Removing a pack only deletes what you have not edited.** An item you have edited is kept, and the dialog states exactly what is kept. A pack can be reinstalled in three seconds, while what you wrote cannot.
- **Access tokens are encrypted when written to disk**, travel in a header rather than being stuffed into the address, and **are dropped when redirected to another host** - that is the most familiar way for access tokens to leak.

### Improved
- Changing a file's line-ending style is no longer mistaken for "you edited it". Before, merely opening a file in a Windows editor and saving was enough for Jarvis 007 to stop updating that item.

## [0.55.24] - 2026-09-04
### Added
- **A pack store right inside Jarvis 007.** The Capabilities > Packs page gains a catalog grid: search, filter by group, press Install and Jarvis 007 downloads it, opens it for you to look at, and only then asks. It is exactly the same confirmation screen as when you pick a file yourself, with no shorter shortcut.
- **Installed packs show "Installed"**, and when the store has a new version the button changes to "New version vX available". Tapping it goes through the proper preview flow before replacing.
- **You can install from an address**, including GitHub's shorthand form `owner/repo@branch`.

### Security
- **Jarvis 007 never downloads from an address pointing into an internal network.** Only https on port 443, and the check judges by the resolved address rather than the host name, so a public domain pointing back at the server is still blocked. It is checked again after every redirect, because that is the most familiar detour.
- **The store catalog is treated as untrusted data**: every field is length-capped and type-coerced, and unknown fields are dropped. The "runs code" tier the store declares is only for showing a label; the real tier is computed by Jarvis 007 itself from the downloaded file.
- **A downloaded file that does not match the fingerprint the store published stops at once**, before anything is asked.

### Improved
- If the store cannot be reached, only the catalog area reports it, and the installed packs part still works normally. With no network but an old catalog still available, you can still view it, with a line saying you are looking at old data.

## [0.55.23] - 2026-09-04
### Added
- **A pack can now carry tools, not only connection services.** Installing a pack gives Jarvis 007 new tools, usable at once on every brain. This is the other half of the "installable means removable" direction.
- **No environment variable needed for packs.** A pack goes through the installer, meaning you have already seen the screen listing each code file before pressing agree, so there is no extra switch to open. A plugin you drop into the folder yourself still needs it as before.
- **The plugin card shows a source label "From pack"**, with a button leading straight to the Packs page to turn it on or off or remove it.

### Security
- **Code in a pack is locked by content.** At install, Jarvis 007 records a fingerprint of all the code in the pack; each time it loads, it recomputes and compares. A single byte of difference and the plugin does not run, with a line saying why and what to do. It is checked at load time, not only at install, because anyone who can edit the code file can also edit the ledger.
- **A pack may not hijack the name of a built-in Jarvis 007 tool.** The installer refuses at once and names the clash.
- **Turning off or removing a plugin now truly STOPS it.** Before, it only vanished from the list, while what the plugin had opened, like a background process, stayed alive. Now a plugin can clean up after itself, and Jarvis 007 drops its code from memory entirely.
- **Plugins can no longer shadow Jarvis 007's source code.** Before, the plugin folder was inserted into the module search path, so a plugin holding a file with the same name as a core file could replace it.
- **A pack that no longer matches the Jarvis 007 version turns itself off at startup**, with a reason, instead of running on in an unclear state.

## [0.55.22] - 2026-09-04
### Added
- **A new Packs page: add services to Jarvis 007 from a .zip file.** Choose a file, Jarvis 007 opens it to see what is inside and only then asks if you want to install. Once installed, the service appears at once on the Connections page, usable on every brain, with no waiting for a Jarvis 007 update.
- **The preview screen tells the truth about the pack.** It lists the services about to be added, the file's fingerprint, and if the pack runs code it shows a red warning block with the name of each code file, making you retype the pack's code before it may install. The "turn on now" box is off by default.
- **Removing a pack is clean:** the pack's files, the services it added, and the connections you connected through it all go with it. The dialog names each connection before doing it, and they go to a trash kept for 30 days.
- **Plugins bundled with Jarvis 007 can now be removed**, not just turned off. The card leaves the main list and drops into the "Removed" section with a Reinstall button. The files stay in the install so a Jarvis 007 update does not make it grow back.

### Security
- **Unknown .zip files are inspected closely before opening:** blocking paths that climb outside, symbolic links pointing at secret files, inflated archives, and packs carrying a private key or a .env file. A pack may never overwrite a built-in service.
- **The Packs page demands a real sign-in**, even on installs with no password set, and does not accept API keys. Installing a pack means running foreign code on the server, so someone must be sitting in front of the screen.

## [0.55.21] - 2026-09-04
### Added
- **New services can be added to the Store without waiting for a Jarvis 007 update.** Drop a pack folder into the server's pack store and that service appears on the Connections page, usable on every brain. This is the other half of the "Jarvis 007 keeps the core, you choose the rest" direction: the previous version allowed REMOVING some, this one allows ADDING.
- **A service coming from a pack always shows clearly which pack it is from**, and always starts at Read only no matter what the pack declares. To allow writes, you raise permission yourself per account like any other connection.
- **A pack may not overwrite a built-in service.** A pack declaring the same name as an existing service has that part refused with a clear reason, while the original service stays unchanged. That way no one can quietly redirect a connection you are really signed in to.

### Fixed
- **Running the test suite no longer dirties your connection store.** Two tests thought they were using a temp folder but actually wrote straight into the real store, so each run added a few junk connections named "n8n thử" and "Shop thử" (n8n test, Shop test). If your store has those lines, just delete them; Jarvis 007 does not recreate them.

## [0.55.20] - 2026-09-03
### Added
- **Services can be removed from the Connection Store for tidiness.** The store has 29 services and normally you use only a few. Hover over a card and a × appears at the right corner: press it and the service leaves the Store and the tool list of every brain. This is the first step of the "Jarvis 007 keeps only the core, you choose what to add" direction.
- **Removed then reinstalled with one tap**, in the "Removed" area under the Store. The service's files stay in the install so updating Jarvis 007 to a new version does not make it grow back, and if you want to use it again it is there at once.
- **Your connections are not deleted when a service is removed.** Jarvis 007 asks again first, then those connections stop running but stay intact in the Connected area, with a reminder strip at the top of the page. Reinstall the service and they run again, with no need to reconnect from scratch.

### Security
- **A connection pointing at a service that no longer exists now stops completely, instead of running on while losing its gate.** Before, with the service missing Jarvis 007 still called that connection but skipped permissions, so a connection at Read only could call write tools too.

## [0.55.19] - 2026-09-03
### Security
