- **Deleting a connection now truly deletes everything.** Before this version, deleting a connection still left behind the folder holding its sign-in session on the server, and nothing cleaned it up. On the project's own server there were 5 folders like that left behind by Zalo connections deleted long ago, one of which still held sign-in credentials.
- **A connection's helper process is shut down at once, instead of living another 15 minutes.** It kept running in the background that whole time even though the connection had vanished from the screen.
- **The Guide link of some sources no longer dies**, and Jarvis 007 tightens exactly that spot so a guide page cannot sneakily run code in your dashboard.

### Improved
- **The confirmation box when deleting a connection says exactly what will be lost**, counting each item, instead of a curt question. A QR-scan connection like Zalo is warned separately that losing the session means scanning again with the phone, and by default goes to the trash kept for 30 days so a mistaken tap can be undone.
- **The tool-call log is kept when a connection is deleted**, only the display name is dropped. To delete it fully you tick it yourself, because a log that a delete action can sweep clean is no longer a log.

## [0.55.18] - 2026-09-03
### Added
- **Jarvis 007 detects by itself when your browser is running an old version.** Until now this was completely silent: you updated, opened it and saw the same as before, with no way to know it was because the browser kept old files. Now Jarvis 007 shows a reminder strip at the top of the screen, naming the exact file that is old, with a Reload button.
- **If it is still old after reloading, Jarvis 007 says plainly what to do** (press Ctrl+Shift+R), instead of leaving you pressing Reload forever without understanding why nothing changes.
- **When the server updates while you have Jarvis 007 open**, the reminder strip also appears, inviting you to reload to use the new version. Jarvis 007 does not reload by itself, because you may be in the middle of typing.

## [0.55.17] - 2026-09-03
### Improved
- **A new brain no longer has a `Task Inbox.md` file sitting in Dashboard.** It only grows out when you press "+ Task" for the first time, so anyone who does not use that feature has a Dashboard folder one file tidier. If an old brain already has it and you do not use it, just delete it; Jarvis 007 does not recreate it.

## [0.55.16] - 2026-09-03
### Improved
- **Automated tests raise fewer false alarms.** Some checks used to be hard-pinned to milliseconds so a machine running slower than usual made them fail wrongly, even though the software was fine. Now they measure the very thing being checked, regardless of whether the machine is fast or slow.
- When there is a real failure, the test log names the failing test right on the last line, instead of making you hunt through thousands of lines.

## [0.55.15] - 2026-09-03
### Fixed
- **Attaching many files to chat now scrolls to show all of them.** Before, the file strip under the input box was cut at the second row, and the last few files were still there but there was no way to press **X** to remove them.
- **Dragging and dropping files onto the project document panel now lands in the right place**, no longer jumping to the chat panel. Drop anywhere on the panel, and the whole panel lights up to say it was received.
- **You can pick several files at once** when pressing "Upload from machine", instead of one at a time. Jarvis 007 uploads them one after another and counts for you which file it is on.
### Improved
- **Search in the brain: the "Added" button becomes "Remove".** If you added by mistake, press remove right there, without closing the search box and searching back through the list.

## [0.55.14] - 2026-09-03
### Fixed
- **MCP connections reconnect by themselves when the service server drops the session.** This is the root of Pancake POS being "sometimes working, sometimes not": the server may cancel a session at any time (they redeploy, the session expires), and Jarvis 007 should shake hands again at once. Before, Jarvis 007 did not recognize that signal so it treated the source as having no tools, and stayed that way until you left for 15 minutes.
- **The Connections page no longer shows a false green.** A source that connects but exposes no tools now shows a red dot with the reason, instead of a green dot saying "Working normally (0 tools)" while Jarvis 007 cannot call anything.
- **Jarvis 007 names the illness better when asked.** If a source is having trouble, it answers plainly that the source is broken, no longer guessing about missing permission or the source not being attached to the brain.
- A wrong API key is now reported as a wrong key with a Reconnect button, not mixed up with a lost-session error.

## [0.55.13] - 2026-09-02
### Fixed
- **Chat with an Ollama model running on a home machine now works.** Before, whatever you typed got back "There's an issue with the selected model", because Jarvis 007 quietly handed the chat turn to Claude Code along with Ollama's model name. Now the chat turn goes to Ollama properly, with the full tools and MCP like every other brain.
- **The model bar stops complaining "pin broken"** when you are using a home-machine model that runs normally.
- When Ollama sits behind a password-protected reverse proxy, the key you enter on the Models page is now really used in chat.

## [0.55.12] - 2026-09-02
### Improved
- **The mic is the only voice switch.** The speaker button on the input bar is gone entirely: press the mic and Jarvis 007 answers by voice, turn the mic off and it is silent. To mute by hand there is still a switch in quick Settings.
- **The CONVERSATION label row is tidier** on both phone and computer: two buttons sit on the same row as the label, and the project chip only drops to a new row when there really is one, with no empty strip above the chat panel.
- **Phone: the "≡ 1/3" button (jump back to an old question) moves up to the label row**, beside the enlarge button. Before it stuck to the chat panel corner and covered your message bubbles when scrolling.
### Fixed
- **iPhone: pressing the mic no longer falls into long recording mode**, and a sentence is sent once you finish speaking. **Voice reading on iPhone no longer hesitates or cuts out midway**: Jarvis 007 plays through one audio channel opened from the moment you press the mic instead of creating a new channel for each segment (something iPhone blocks).

## [0.55.11] - 2026-09-02
### Fixed
- **Reading by mic on a phone no longer pastes sentences on top of each other** like "Ok Ok Ok có Ok có vẻ...". Chrome on Android hands back the whole sentence at every listening beat, and Jarvis 007 accumulated it so it copied that sentence once more each beat. Now Jarvis 007 rebuilds the text from the start each beat, and a half-spoken sentence is not lost when the browser reopens the listening session by itself.
- **The speaker follows the mic.** Press the mic to listen and Jarvis 007 answers by voice by itself; turn the mic off and Jarvis 007 is silent. Phones before had nowhere to switch voice on or off, now the speaker button is back on the input bar to see the state and press the other way when needed.
- Jarvis 007 does not read the same passage twice when a flaky connection delivers a message twice.

## [0.55.10] - 2026-09-02
### Added
- **A separate model can be pinned for Telegram.** By default Telegram still follows the main model as before; once pinned, changing the model on the web does not drag the phone along, and typing `/model` on Telegram only changes it for Telegram. Pin right on Telegram with `/model ghim`, unpin with `/model theo`; `/status` always says whether it is pinned or following.
### Fixed
- **Jarvis 007 no longer makes up the story "the source is not attached to this brain".** Connections are shared across all brains. When a source is off or broken, Jarvis 007 now says that exact reason and points you to the Check button on the Connections page, instead of telling you to go find an attach-source section that does not exist.

## [0.55.9] - 2026-09-02
### Fixed
- **The first-time account creation screen now points straight at the empty field.** The Setup code field sits in the middle of the page while the button is at the bottom, so if you left it blank and pressed, you only saw a red line at the bottom without knowing which field was missing. Now the screen scrolls to that field by itself and puts the cursor in it.
- **Pasting the whole log line by mistake still gets you in.** The code printed to the log sits on the same line as the words `SETUP TOKEN:`, highlighting one line takes the label too, and before, Jarvis 007 reported the code wrong. Now Jarvis 007 trims the label, quotes and extra spaces itself.

## [0.55.8] - 2026-09-02
### Fixed
- **A model that cannot be used to chat now says why.** An embedding model (like `embeddinggemma`) only produces vectors for search and cannot answer, so it has no button to set it as the main model. Before, Jarvis 007 only quietly dropped the button with no explanation, so you only saw "installed 2 models but only 1 usable".
- **And Jarvis 007 asks Ollama directly which models can chat**, instead of guessing from names. Three common embedding models, `all-minilm`, `bge-m3` and `paraphrase-multilingual`, have no "embed" in their names, so before, Jarvis 007 still invited you to set them as the main model and then every new chat turn died.

## [0.55.7] - 2026-09-02
### Fixed
- **Ollama was connected but the model picker still said "not connected or no models".** The Local tab listed all models but the main model picker never asked Ollama, so it was always empty. Now it takes the list actually installed (dropping embedding models since they cannot chat), and the Ollama vendor only shows "connected" once you have set a real address.
### Improved
- **The tab is renamed Local Model, and the provider is renamed Ollama (Local)**, with the confusing words "home machine" and "runs on the machine" gone.
- **Once a model is downloaded, press "Use as main model" right in the Local tab**, with no need to go hunting through the long list in the Cloud tab. The model that is currently the main one has its own label.
- **The port-opening command for the Docker build now binds Ollama to the correct bridge address that Jarvis 007 detects**, so only containers on that machine call in, which removes the firewall step that could lock out your SSH. If the connection fails there is a ready diagnostic command with how to read its result.
- **Machines without a GPU are first suggested the Qwen3 instruct build**, while the long-thinking builds (plain qwen3, deepseek-r1) are marked as very slow on CPU. On a 2-core VPS, the plain build produced nearly 2,800 words of thinking for one greeting and then timed out; the instruct build answered in 23 seconds.

## [0.55.6] - 2026-09-02
### Fixed
- **Documents you upload in the Project panel are now saved to Sources, no longer to Attachments.** Attachments is a temporary area cleaned by age (30 days by default) and by size, so project documents left there would be lost. Sources is kept long term.
- **And a file attached to a project is never cleaned again**, including old files still sitting in Attachments. Before, after cleaning the project was left with a line pointing at a file that no longer exists.
- Jarvis 007 finds the brain's real Sources folder by itself (even when you named it `01 - Sources`) instead of guessing, so files no longer wander into a second folder of the same name.

## [0.55.5] - 2026-09-02
### Fixed
- **If you fill in the Ollama address and forget the port, Jarvis 007 adds `11434` itself.** Before, typing only the host address made Jarvis 007 read it as port 80, hit that machine's own web page and report "Server returned error 301" - a number that says nothing and gives no way to trace it.
- **Ollama connection errors now point straight at the wrong spot.** If you point at a web server by mistake, Jarvis 007 says plainly that it is a web server and not Ollama and repeats the port to use, instead of reading out a bare error code.
- **A warning when you connect Ollama through a public address.** Ollama has no password, so an Internet address means anyone who knows it can call your models. Jarvis 007 says so at connection time, with what to do.

## [0.55.4] - 2026-09-02
### Fixed
- **Two people sharing one Jarvis 007 no longer knock each other's Claude connection out.** When both chatted just as the Claude sign-in session expired, both turns went to refresh, and the slower person was told the sign-in was lost while the other kept running normally. Now Jarvis 007 queues exactly that moment so only one turn goes to refresh, and the other waits a few seconds then uses the new session.
- **And if it still happens to hit, Jarvis 007 names the illness correctly.** Before, it reported the sign-in lost and told you to go to the Models page and reconnect - wrong advice, because the session was never lost, and pressing Disconnect even deleted the sign-in session backup. Now it says plainly that you can resend the message right away, and no longer lights the red alarm.

## [0.55.3] - 2026-09-02
### Fixed
- **Jarvis 007 now finds the address for connecting to Ollama and fills it in for you**, so you just press Connect. The previous version said "fill in this address" but left the address as faint text inside the input box, and truncated so it could not be read in full.
- **And that address used to be wrong.** Jarvis 007 hard-coded `172.17.0.1`, which is only right for a different style of Docker install; the install following Jarvis 007's guide sits on another network so filling it in exactly as instructed still could not connect. Now Jarvis 007 reads the server's real address. If it cannot find it, it says so plainly and gives a command for you to get it yourself.

## [0.55.2] - 2026-09-02
### Fixed
- **The learning log now puts newest first.** Before, within the same day it put oldest first, so for a brain learning 100-200 items a day the item just learned sat somewhere among twenty pages - exactly what you open the log to find.
- **The Grok Build card on the Models page no longer shows the red error** `unsupported tool prefix: NotebookEdit`. Jarvis 007 was sending Grok a Claude Code tool name that Grok does not have; chat still ran normally so this error only worried you without breaking anything.

## [0.55.1] - 2026-09-02
### Fixed
- **The Ollama install guide for the Docker build now covers all three steps.** The previous version only said "install on the real machine then fill in the address", missing two spots without which connecting is sure to fail: Ollama by default only listens inside the machine so Jarvis 007's container cannot reach it, and no one could guess which address to fill in. Now there is a ready command for each step and the address box suggests the right one.
- **Windows machines can now read RAM.** Before it could only read on Linux and Mac, while Windows returned 0 but still reported success - the result was that a 64GB machine was only suggested models under 8GB with no sign that anything was wrong. When reading fails, it now says plainly that it does not know and invites you to enter it yourself.
- Said outright in the guide: **do not paste the install command into Jarvis 007's terminal** (it sits in a container, has no root, and everything installed there is lost at the next update), plus a firewall warning because Ollama has no password, and an up-front line saying a VPS without a GPU will run models very slowly.

## [0.55.0] - 2026-09-02
### Added
- **Run AI models right on your machine.** The Models page splits into two tabs: **Cloud Model** as before, and the new **Local Model**. Install Ollama, fill in the address, then download models to use for free and offline.
- **The machine running Ollama does not have to be the machine running Jarvis 007.** Jarvis 007 on a VPS with Ollama on your home desktop still works - just fill in that machine's address.
- **Jarvis 007 suggests up to 6 models that fit your machine**, with a reason for each ("runs fully in the GPU, fastest" or "has to spill into RAM so slower"). A strong machine is offered large models, a light machine only sees models that can run.
- Downloading a model has a progress bar, can be cancelled midway, and pressing download again continues from where it stopped rather than from the start.

## [0.54.1] - 2026-09-01
### Fixed
- **The button to view a chat's files and links now really appears.** Version 0.54.0 drew the button and then overwrote it right when the conversation belonged to a project, which is exactly when it is used most.
- **The word "CONVERSATION" in the right column no longer breaks into two lines** when the project name is long. The project chip now drops fully to the line below so the whole name shows.

### Improved
- **Each project in the list has a three-dot button** that opens a box of functions written in words (pin, change icon, rename, delete, open the document panel), replacing four icons that only showed on hover. The project name thus gains room, and on a tablet those functions can finally be pressed - hover does not exist on a touchscreen.

## [0.54.0] - 2026-09-01
### Added
- **Review every file and link of a chat.** Press the document-stack icon at the top of the chat panel: it lists the documents Jarvis 007 created in that conversation and the links mentioned, newest first. No more scrolling back through the whole conversation to find that plan written last week. It works with **old chats too**, with no waiting for new ones.
- A file that was renamed or moved still shows in the list, just faded and struck through, so you know where it used to be.

### Improved
- **Tapping a document name in the project panel opens it for reading right away** (md, txt, pdf, images...), instead of only seeing the name.
- Added a button to **delete the file from the brain outright** beside the remove-from-project button. They are two different things so they ask again with two different questions.
- **After adding a file the search screen no longer disappears**, and you can add several files in a row. Adding links works the same.
- The three tabs Guide / Files / Links have icons, so a glance tells you where you are.

## [0.53.1] - 2026-09-01
### Improved
- **Pin a project to arrange the order yourself.** Hover over a project in the list and press the pin icon, and it goes to the top and stays there. Before, the list was only sorted by most recent touch, so an important project opened only now and then drifted to the bottom.
- **Phone: the project chip shows the full name** instead of shrinking to a small folder icon. A glance tells you which project you are chatting in, with no need to tap to find out.
- **Removed the line "Chat with Jarvis 007"** at the top of the Chat page. It repeated exactly what the left sidebar was already highlighting, and took up a row.

## [0.53.0] - 2026-09-01
### Added
- **Projects now have their own memory.** Press the project name chip at the top of the chat panel to open the **Guide - Files - Links** panel. Every conversation in that project carries along whatever you put here.
- **Guide** is an instruction specific to the project, for example "always answer in English" or "forest green tone, avoid blue". It saves as you type, with no Save button.
- **For pinned files Jarvis 007 reads the content in advance**, rather than only knowing the name and opening it later. Pin a price list to the project and Jarvis 007 knows the price list from the very first question. A file that is not pinned stays in the list for Jarvis 007 to open when needed.
- Add files by **searching the brain or dragging and dropping from your machine**; add links by pasting a URL. Removing from the project does not delete the file in the brain.

## [0.52.13] - 2026-09-01
### Fixed
- **The large word "System" no longer floats at the bottom of the sidebar** when there is nothing below it. It is the part for narrow screens, and when shrunk back to a wide screen the label was left behind.

### Improved
- **The brain and model name move down to the small line under each answer**, beside the token level. The top of the conversation panel gets its space back, and the information is more accurate: each answer names the model that actually produced it, instead of one shared line only about the last turn.
- **Removed the rerun button under Jarvis 007's answers.** It sat right next to the copy button so it was very easy to miss-tap, and a miss-tap made Jarvis 007 rerun the whole turn. To ask again, press **Resend this question** right under your question.

## [0.52.12] - 2026-09-01
### Fixed
- **Phone: opening a file to edit no longer leaves the Conversations/Folders column stuck.** That column covered the whole screen with no way to close it, because all three old ways of closing were switched off at exactly that moment. Now there is a dim backdrop, tapping outside closes it, and opening a file makes it collapse by itself.

### Improved
- **Many stuck jobs at once report only ONE message**, like "3 jobs waiting for you to handle" with the name of each, instead of ringing the bell one by one. A lone stuck job is still reported as before.

## [0.52.11] - 2026-09-01
### Fixed
- **A background job stuck on "needs an outside action" now has a way out.** Before, this kind of job was blocked permanently, pressing Retry blocked it again identically and rang one more bell. Now there is a **Allow real run** button right on the job card, and the message says clearly what you need to press.
- **Jobs run at exactly the permission level promised.** A job handed off from chat said "read only and suggest" but quietly ran at a level allowed to write files, and the automatic permission-level picker could even grant itself full access. Now only you can raise the permission level.

### Improved
- **The Tasks page becomes one column**, with the **Needs your attention** area on top. Before, this area was squeezed into a narrow right column so reading the reason meant scrolling, while the two left areas were often empty.
- Added a **Delete all** button for the Needs your attention area and the History area, so you do not have to delete job by job.

## [0.52.10] - 2026-09-01
### Fixed
- **Images sent into chat now stay in the chat.** Before, once sent the image vanished, and reloading the page left only a bare file name.
- **Tapping an image enlarges it**, both sent images and images just pasted and still in the attachment bar.
- Images are only kept temporarily for a few days. Past that, the spot shows **a box saying plainly it can no longer be viewed**, instead of a broken image tile that makes you think the app is broken.

## [0.52.9] - 2026-09-01
### Fixed
- **The note search box in the VAULT column is no longer sluggish.** It was finding file names by **crawling the whole vault from the browser**, one server query per folder. On a home machine no one noticed, but over the network to a VPS a vault of a few dozen folders meant waiting dozens of seconds. Now it asks the server exactly once, just like the search box on the Files page that was always fast.

## [0.52.8] - 2026-09-01
### Fixed
- **POS no longer drops in the middle of placing an order.** Every Jarvis 007 chat turn re-asked each source for its tool list, and that query had to queue behind the order in progress. Waiting more than 20 seconds made the old version **kill the whole connection session**, meaning it killed the half-placed order, and the next turn reported "POS not connected". Now a source that is running work is left alone and keeps its tool list, so the second order is no longer cut off.
- The Connections page also stops lighting a false red for a source busy running work.
- **The Files page opens fast again.** Each time you entered the page, Jarvis 007 re-read all the brain's `.md` files to look for an old bug from version 0.33.3; a brain with several thousand notes made both the page and the search box noticeably slow. Now Jarvis 007 remembers which brains are clean and stops re-scanning them.

## [0.52.7] - 2026-09-01
### Fixed
- **Jarvis 007 no longer spawns tasks by itself while discussing a plan.** In ordinary conversation it assigned itself jobs like "apply the plan just presented" or "update the timeline", and then each job, when done or stuck, fired a notification to the bell and to the very chat panel being talked in. No one asked for the job, yet the noise was real.
- Now the job queue is only for **work you tell it to do**. A plan or next step Jarvis 007 thinks up itself it writes out for you to read, and does not assign itself. When unsure whether you want to assign it, it **asks one question** before creating.
- **The bell only rings for work needing your hand.** A blocked job or one waiting for your approval shows a red dot as before. A job that finished successfully no longer rings: the result still lands in the chat panel that assigned the job and stays in the bell's list to open and review. In return, when you are away a finished job leaves nothing to remind you, and you must open the bell yourself to look.

## [0.52.6] - 2026-09-01
### Fixed
- **The chat panel no longer grows a sentence you never typed.** The culprit was the mic: pressing and releasing the Space key very fast made the stop command land before the mic had finished opening, so the mic stayed quietly listening. Hearing music or TV in the room, it transcribed it and sent it as your message.
- **Jarvis 007 reading aloud also stops turning the mic on by itself.** Before, once you had spoken once in a session, every time Jarvis 007 read aloud, a loud enough noise would reopen the mic. Now you can only interrupt when the mic is truly open.
- A reminder for peace of mind: background work, reminders and loops always answer in the left-hand bubble. There is no path for Jarvis 007 to type into the chat box in your place.

## [0.52.5] - 2026-08-31
### Fixed
- **After an update you no longer lose the MCP connection.** Most often seen with Pancake POS: just after an update you go into chat and ask, and Jarvis 007 says there is no POS, then a moment later there is. The connection is not broken - it just had not finished reopening its session while Jarvis 007 had already gone to ask for tools, and each source is only allowed to wait 20 seconds.
- Now, right at startup, Jarvis 007 **opens a session in advance for every connected source** and lets them wait generously, because no one is sitting waiting at that time. A source still slow is called again two more times and shows up again in the toolbox by itself.
- If one source still misses its beat, that missing tool list is **kept for only a few seconds instead of a minute**, so the next question sees it all.

## [0.52.4] - 2026-08-31
### Fixed
- **Copying text in the chat panel is no longer blocked by the conversation marker strip.** The strip of bars on the right sat on top of the text edge, so every time you highlighted an old sentence the history list popped open and covered it. Now the strip sits fully in its own margin, and while you are sweeping the mouse it no longer reacts.

## [0.52.3] - 2026-08-30
### Fixed
- **Long Vietnamese chats through the Antigravity CLI no longer report "Argument list too long".** Jarvis 007 measured question length by character count, while the operating system counts bytes - and Vietnamese costs more bytes than English, so long Vietnamese conversations were blocked while English ones were not. Now it measures correctly.
- If it still hits the ceiling for another reason, Jarvis 007 **switches to another sending path by itself and answers normally**, instead of throwing a technical error line and losing the chat turn.
- An older Grok CLI hitting the same situation is also reported with an easy-to-understand message and how to handle it.

## [0.52.2] - 2026-08-30
### Fixed
- **No more on-screen text turning into key codes** like `models.st_connected` after an update. Cause: the browser kept the old version of the language dictionary file across the new version. Now the dictionary is always checked for a new version each time the page opens.
- If for some reason a translation is still missing, Jarvis 007 keeps the existing text instead of printing the key code on screen.
- If you are hitting this: after updating, reload the page once (Ctrl+Shift+R) and it is fully clean.

## [0.52.1] - 2026-08-30
### Fixed
- **A broken or hung Antigravity CLI no longer freezes the whole app.** Before, every time a page opened, Jarvis 007 asked `agy` directly on the main thread - and an `agy` not signed in sat waiting for a keyboard for up to 80 seconds, so every button turned gray, the model could not be changed, and the Updates page died too. Now Jarvis 007 asks in the background and the interface answers at once.
- Any CLI that falls into an interactive prompt (a sign-in menu, a first-run dialog) now exits at once instead of hanging while waiting for a keyboard that does not exist.
- A broken CLI binary is only retried after a few minutes, not on every press.

## [0.52.0] - 2026-08-30
### Improved
- **Three big pages speak English: Models, Tasks and Studio.** Choose English and the provider cards, the Tasks board, the workflow/agent/skill lists, and every button and message on these three pages change accordingly.
- The whole provider sign-in flow (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Antigravity) and the model picker box also have translations, including the error lines.
- The interface dictionary reaches nearly 600 entries per language.

## [0.51.0] - 2026-08-30
### Added
- **A language switch right under the left sidebar**, beside the version number. Choose English and the text on buttons, labels and menus changes at once, with no need to go into Settings and no page reload.
- **The whole main screen now has an English version**: the top bar, the Notifications box, the Vault tree, quick Settings, the chat panel, the sign-in screen and the first-time setup. The Settings page (group titles, cards, buttons) changes too.
- Change the language in one place and the picker in the other place jumps along, so the two always point at the same language.

## [0.50.6] - 2026-08-29
### Fixed
- **Chat with Grok now gets an answer.** Grok sent the answer back under a different name from the one Jarvis 007 was waiting for, so Jarvis 007 received all the text but collected it as empty - the turn ran right, the model answered right, and you saw an empty box. Now it reads correctly.
- **The Usage table counts Grok's tokens correctly.** Before, every Grok turn went into the table with 0 tokens because the numbers sat one level deeper than where Jarvis 007 read.
- **Grok remembers the thread of conversation between turns** - the session ID is now received correctly, so asking a follow-up about "that" still gets understood.

## [0.50.5] - 2026-08-29
### Fixed
- **Chat with Grok still gave an empty box - this time fixed at the right spot.** Grok answers in a data format completely different from what Jarvis 007 was expecting, and the answer sits at the **end** of the stream, after a flood of thinking lines. Jarvis 007 now reads that end part, and if it still comes out empty it asks Grok again another way.
- **The error report in the previous version looked in the wrong place.** It only kept the first 40 lines, and the first line is always the tool listing - so it described the opening correctly and was blind exactly where it needed to look. Now it keeps both the start and the end, and lists all the data formats seen.

## [0.50.4] - 2026-08-29
### Fixed
- **Updating to a new version signed Grok out.** The xAI sign-in session sat in a folder that only exists inside the container, so each switch to a new version made it vanish - while the Grok CLI itself remained so the card still said "CLI installed", making it look like a sign-in error rather than a storage error. Now the session is kept in the same place as the Claude and ChatGPT sign-ins.
- You **do not need to change anything in `docker-compose`**, just update as normal. For this one update only, you still have to sign in to Grok again one last time - from the next time on it is kept.

## [0.50.3] - 2026-08-28
### Fixed
- **Chat with Grok only got an empty box back.** After signing in, you typed a sentence and Jarvis 007 answered "Grok CLI finished running but returned no content". Jarvis 007 handed the question to Grok through a route this CLI version does not accept, so it ran and exited without saying anything. Now Jarvis 007 retries by the second route itself and the chat turn gets an answer.
- **Grok answers in a form Jarvis 007 does not know are still readable.** Before, Jarvis 007 only understood a few data shapes; meeting another shape it skipped everything and you saw an empty box. Now it salvages the text part in any shape.
- **And if it still comes out empty, the error line says exactly why**: how many lines Grok printed, what shape, what exit code, with a command for you to try yourself on the server. The content of your question is never put in there.

## [0.50.2] - 2026-08-28
### Fixed
- **Grok sign-in finished but the card still said not signed in.** Press **Sign in**, open the link, the xAI page says "Device Authorized" - but the card on the **Models** page kept spinning "waiting for your confirmation" forever. Jarvis 007 read Grok's session file by a pre-guessed pattern, so when the real file was written a little differently it saw no token. Now it reads every way of writing it.
- **The card now shows what Grok is saying.** Before, there was only one spinning "waiting" line with no news; now the last line Grok printed shows right under the link, and when it fails the **Check again** button tells you which folder Jarvis 007 looked in and what files it saw. The token is never shown.
- **The sign-in code shows in full** even when it already sits inside the link, and Jarvis 007 catches the link even when Grok prints over a line instead of starting a new line.

## [0.50.1] - 2026-08-28
### Fixed
- **Telegram no longer forgets everything at each update.** Before, pressing the update button (or restarting the server) meant the Telegram conversation was treated as totally lost: you had to teach it again from how to address you to file naming conventions, while opening `localhost:7777` was still normal. Reason: the browser remembers for you which conversation you are in, while on Telegram nobody remembers for you. Now Jarvis 007 records it itself, and after startup continues the exact conversation in progress.
- **And it remembers the content already said, not just the right conversation.** After a restart, Jarvis 007 reads back the most recent saved chat before answering, so if you message "do that for me" it still understands. True for every brain: Claude Code, ChatGPT, Grok, Antigravity and the models using an API key.
- **The `/reset` command now truly resets.** With the Grok and Antigravity brains, typing `/reset` left Jarvis 007 remembering the old conversation exactly. Now all four brains cut it clean, and this command also works right after the server has just restarted.

## [0.50.0] - 2026-08-28
### Added
- **A new brain: xAI's Grok Build.** It uses the **SuperGrok** or **X Premium+** plan you already pay for, with no API key to buy. Go to **Models**, the **xAI Grok Build CLI** card, press **Sign in** and done. It shows a link and a code to open on your phone or computer, so you can **sign in even when Jarvis 007 runs on a VPS** - the first CLI card able to do this.
- Grok **remembers the thread of conversation** between turns, runs in chat, Telegram, agents and background jobs, and can call the full set of Jarvis 007 tools (MCP, skills, Kanban jobs). Press **Check again** on the card to know for sure whether the tools are connected.

### Improved
- **The Google Gemini CLI card is removed entirely.** Google cut it off for every personal account from 18/06/2026, so it was only a choice you press and then hit a wall. For Gemini models use the **Antigravity CLI** (the Google plan you already have), **OpenRouter** or the **Google Gemini (API)** card - all three remain intact.
- **Anyone who had set Gemini CLI as the main model is switched back to the default by Jarvis 007 at update**, with a line written to the server log stating that it switched. Without this step no card on the Models page would light the MAIN label and answers would come out strange with no error. Open the **Models** page and choose the brain you want again and done.
- **Jarvis 007's internal guide is now written in English.** Nothing changes for you: Jarvis 007 still answers in the language you message in, and still addresses you as "bạn/mình" (the Vietnamese you/me pair) as before. The change is so the model understands the rules better and misreads them less.

## [0.49.3] - 2026-08-27
### Improved
- **The strip beside the model picker now tells you what tool Jarvis 007 just called.** The two lights "Claude Code CLI" and "Voice" are gone - they were almost always green so they told nothing more. Instead there are **the three tools just called, newest first**, and the one that just ran flashes for a beat.

## [0.49.2] - 2026-08-27
### Fixed
- **The phone was not receiving push notifications while the computer still was.** Jarvis 007 introduced itself to the push service with a contact address written as "localhost" - Google ignored it, while **Apple flat-out rejected it**, so the iPhone was absolutely silent. Now it uses a valid address; anyone wanting a separate address sets the `JAVIS_PUSH_CONTACT` variable.
- **The Send test button says clearly which device received it and which did not.** Before, one device receiving was enough to report "sent", so a broken device sat silent and no one knew. The switch box also shows the number of devices receiving and names the failing device outright.

## [0.49.1] - 2026-08-27
### Added
- **A reminder to add Jarvis 007 to the Home Screen on your phone, once a day.** Not to advertise installing an app: on iPhone, Jarvis 007 **can only send push notifications once added to the Home Screen**, so opening it in ordinary Safari means you never receive background job results. The popup shows each step to match the browser you are using, and has a **Don't remind me again** button if you have decided not to install.

## [0.49.0] - 2026-08-27
### Added
- **An inbox on the Notifications bell.** After handing work to Jarvis 007 you no longer have to sit and watch: every background result, periodic report and reminder leaves a piece of mail. Tapping it **returns to the exact conversation you asked in**, without opening a new thread. The panel has two tabs: Mine and News.
- **Push notifications in the browser.** Turn it on once in the inbox, after that when there is a result your device alerts you even if you closed Jarvis 007. Tapping the notification opens that piece of mail directly. Needs https (or localhost); on iPhone you must add Jarvis 007 to the Home Screen first.
- **Reminders no longer require Telegram.** Before, if no bot was connected Jarvis 007 blocked creation, because the result would fall into nothing. Now the inbox always receives so create freely; connecting Telegram is now only to also receive on the phone.

## [0.48.3] - 2026-08-27
### Improved
- **Removed the speaker button on the title bar.** The same voice switch had three places to press; now it keeps exactly the speaker button on the chat input bar - where your hand already is. The switch in quick Settings remains and stays in sync.

## [0.48.2] - 2026-08-27
### Fixed
- **Opening a .md file on the Chat page no longer breaks the right-hand conversation panel.** The editor swelled wider than its column and sat on top of the chat panel, so the text on the right had its left edge cut off, unreadable as sentences. Now the editor shrinks to exactly the left column, and the conversation shows in full as designed.
- The editor's button bar (Edit, Source, Save, Download...) now **wraps when the panel is narrow** instead of clinging to one row and pushing the whole editor wider. A long file name is cut with an ellipsis.

## [0.48.1] - 2026-08-27
### Added
- **Hostinger can be connected to Jarvis 007.** The Connections page gains Hostinger's official connector: ask right in chat and get the list of domains, expiry dates, DNS records, WordPress websites, VPS, mailboxes and invoices. Paste the API token from hPanel and done.
- This connection defaults to **Read only** because it is a key into website infrastructure. To let Jarvis 007 edit DNS or create websites by itself, raise it to Draft; deleting, stopping a VPS, buying or renewing a domain only run at Full access.
- **Agents can now choose Ollama**, all 10 providers just like the Models page.

## [0.48.0] - 2026-08-27
### Added
- **Send images straight to ChatGPT to look at when creating images.** Before, Jarvis 007 only described your image in words and then let the AI draw from that, so products, labels or faces never matched the original. Now give the image and say "build it like this image" and ChatGPT sees that very image (up to 4 images per turn).
- **Agents can now choose Antigravity CLI**, all 9 providers.
## [0.47.9] - 2026-08-27
### Added
- **Agents can pick a model from every provider you have connected**, no longer stuck with Claude and ChatGPT: Gemini CLI, OpenRouter, Anthropic API, OpenAI, Google Gemini and Groq are added. The list comes straight from the Models page, so connecting one more provider gives you one more choice right away.
- Agents now run on **the provider you actually chose** - before, picking a provider other than Claude/ChatGPT still silently ran on Claude. If the chosen provider fails midway, Jarvis 007 falls back to another brain instead of leaving the agent dead.

## [0.47.8] - 2026-08-27
### Fixed
- **Expanding a .md file now truly fills the screen.** Before, the left navigation bar still sat on top and ate the left edge of the text (the title "AGENTS.md" showed as "ENTS.md"). Expand and the whole screen goes to the content; shrink it back and the sidebar returns as before.

## [0.47.7] - 2026-08-27
### Fixed
- **No more dead card for a code block in the middle of a .md file.** Before, opening a file with a long code block in it collapsed the block into a "TEXT code · 30 lines" card that would not open and whose content could not be seen. Now in the editor the code shows in full right in place and is editable like the rest of the file.
- Diagram cards, SVG images and HTML pages stay as preview cards, but are now **clickable right in the editor** to open the viewer.

## [0.47.6] - 2026-08-27
### Fixed
- **The chat input spans the full width while editing a file on the Chat page.** The previous version squeezed the whole input area into the 340px conversation column. Now it matches the Jarvis 007 screen: the conversation sits in the right column, while the open file + model bar + input run across the bottom. Collapse the conversation column and the input keeps its place.

## [0.47.5] - 2026-08-27
### Fixed
- **Opening a .md file on the Chat page: the layout now matches the Jarvis 007 screen.** The previous version put the chat box ABOVE the editor, which looked upside down. Now the editor is on the left, the conversation is a column on the right and the input is at the bottom of that column - just like viewing a file on the brain screen.
### Added
- **The right-hand conversation panel can be collapsed** on both the Jarvis 007 screen and the Chat page (while editing a file): press the collapse button and the column shrinks to a narrow strip on the right with a button to reopen it, and the state is remembered across F5.

## [0.47.4] - 2026-08-27
### Fixed
- **Finally fixed the red "AI Model not connected" banner that appeared wrongly.** The banner now only speaks about the main model you are chatting with: a background-work model that is not signed in no longer turns the banner red (background work has run on the chat brain when needed since 0.43.3). In return, if you use a ChatGPT plan and the connection is really lost, the banner can now report it - before, this case was silent.
### Improved
- **Opening a .md file on the Chat page still keeps the chat box below**: the editor on top, the conversation condensed and the input unchanged - edit the file and message Jarvis 007 about that same file at once. Phones keep the old layout because the screen has too little room.

## [0.47.3] - 2026-08-27
### Improved
- **The chat box grows with your text like claude.ai.** Type long text or add line breaks and the input grows taller to show all the text (up to 40% of the screen on the Chat page), then shrinks back to one line after sending. Before, it was hard-capped at about 3 lines.
- **The Conversations / Files columns on the Chat page collapse more nicely**: there is a collapse button in the panel corner, and after collapsing a narrow strip with a reopen button remains (like the Vault panel), instead of disappearing entirely.

## [0.47.2] - 2026-08-27
### Added
- **Two panels can be collapsed like a sidebar.** The Vault panel on the main screen has a collapse button next to the refresh button - after collapsing only a narrow strip with a reopen button remains. The conversation history column on the Chat page can also be collapsed on desktop, using the same history button on the title bar.
- Both remember your choice: F5 or reopening the app keeps the collapsed/open state as you left it.

## [0.47.1] - 2026-08-27
### Improved
- **No more answers stopping midway with "ran out of 8 tool-call rounds".** The tool-call round cap for API brains is raised from 8 to 30 (adjustable up to 120), enough for multi-step work without splitting your question or editing environment variables.
- Token-burn protection now targets the real problem: if the model calls the same tool with the same parameters 3 rounds in a row it is told to stop, and at round 5 Jarvis 007 cuts the turn. Normal work never hits this brake.

## [0.47.0] - 2026-08-27
### Added
- **Install Jarvis 007 as a desktop app, not just on phones.** On Chrome/Edge, the status bar has an "Open as app" button (plus an install icon in the address bar): press once and Jarvis 007 runs in its own window, opened from the Desktop/Dock like a real application, not mixed in with tabs.

### Fixed
- **No more wrong "AI Model not connected" warning when you have connected everything.** Before, the red banner stayed if you ran Claude with an API key, if the background-work model was left on "Back to default" on a machine using another brain, or in the first 10 minutes after signing in again. Now the banner is red only when the brain you actually chose is unusable, and goes away as soon as you finish connecting.

## [0.46.0] - 2026-08-26
### Added
- **"Sync images too" switch in the GitHub sync block** (Self-learning page, off by default). Turn it on and jpg/png/gif/webp images in the brain (up to 10MB each) also go to the repo and follow you to another machine; videos and heavy files still never go up.
- With image sync on, Jarvis 007 stops auto-cleaning old images in attachments, so backed-up images do not vanish with the cleanup deadline and spread the delete to other machines.
- Safe when machines are configured differently: a machine without it turned on does not push, does not receive, and does not delete images another machine uploaded. The UI states the trade-off before you turn it on: git remembers forever, and turning it off later does not give the space back.

## [0.45.0] - 2026-08-26
### Added
- **Jarvis 007 edits existing agents and workflows directly instead of spawning copies.** Before, self-learning could only create new ones, so each time a workflow needed improving another near-identical copy appeared next to it. Now it edits that very file: add a missing step, remove a redundant one, reorder a wrong one.
- After editing, your parts stay intact: the name you set, the on/off state, the model you chose for the agent. Every edit records the date and reason at the end of the file for you to read back, and can still be undone with one tap.
- **Lock individual files.** Add the line `learn_lock: true` to the top of an agent or workflow file and self-learning no longer touches it.

## [0.44.0] - 2026-08-26
### Added
- **Self-learning can now add Agents and Workflows.** The Self-learning page has 2 more switches: turn them on and when you ask in chat for a role or a repeated chain of work, Jarvis 007 packages it into a new agent/workflow in Studio.
- As safe as learning skills: off by default, with a second check before writing, create-only without overwriting what exists, and workflows are always created switched off so you can preview and turn them on yourself.

## [0.43.3] - 2026-08-26
### Fixed
- **Self-learning works even when the machine is not signed in to Claude.** Before, anyone using the Gemini, OpenAI or Groq brain with the background-work model left blank had every self-learning round die silently, with the log only saying "cannot parse manifest" and "Not logged in". Now background work switches to the brain you are chatting with when Claude is not ready.
- **The "Not logged in / Please run /login" message is no longer mistaken for a result.** Background work (self-learning, loops, Kanban jobs) treats it as a dead brain and tries the next fallback brain; only when out of options does it report an error, and it correctly says login was lost rather than an obscure error.

## [0.43.2] - 2026-08-24
### Fixed
- **The "background work running" strip is no longer cut in half.** Before, when the chat box was full of messages, this strip was squashed to show only half of its first line, and you had to scroll inside it to read.
- **The wait-for-reply timer shows minutes and hours.** Long jobs now count like "1m 56s" or "1h 30m 40s" instead of piling everything into seconds, so you see at a glance how long you have waited.

## [0.43.1] - 2026-08-23
### Fixed
- **Telegram conversations show again in the sidebar.** They were always fully saved, but were filtered out of the list and the search box once you had ever typed `/brain` on Telegram. Now they show when you open the dashboard, including old ones.
- **Files you paste or drag into the chat box are read directly by Jarvis 007, no need to copy them into the Brain folder.** Before, with brains running on an API key, pasting a long text into chat made Jarvis 007 tell you to move the file into the Brain first before it could read it. The Claude Code brain does not have this bug.
- The old boundary still holds: Jarvis 007 only reads extra files you just put in the chat box, does not read randomly around the machine, does not write outside the brain, and a chatbot talking to customers does not see those files.

## [0.43.0] - 2026-08-22
### Fixed
- **The Antigravity brain now truly uses Jarvis 007 tools.** All along it chatted fluently but could not call MCP, assign Kanban work or run skills - with no error, so it was very hard to notice. Jarvis 007 wrote the config in the wrong place with the wrong field name, so `agy` never saw the connection hub even once.
- **The Re-check button on the Models page says two things clearly.** Before it only said "Works", meaning chat works. Now it also says whether Jarvis 007 tools are wired in - exactly the spot that had silently broken for several versions.
- **Docker build: the Antigravity MCP connection survives updates.** Before, every update lost it and you had to declare it again from scratch.

### Security
- **The internal connection key no longer leaks into the brain's Git backup.** The config files Jarvis 007 writes for the two Google brains sit right inside the brain folder and contain a key. From this version they are excluded from the backup, and the leftover files from older versions are deleted automatically.

## [0.42.1] - 2026-08-22
### Fixed
- **Switching models midway no longer makes Jarvis 007 forget the current conversation.** Before, switching to another model and then back to Claude Code or Gemini CLI made it answer as if the turns in between never happened, sometimes going completely off topic. Now you can switch back and forth any number of times and it stays seamless.
- In return, the first turn right after switching models costs a bit more, because Jarvis 007 must resend the conversation history to the new brain.

## [0.42.0] - 2026-08-22
### Fixed
- **Reading YouTube videos: fixed three bugs that made the previous version almost always fail on servers.** The player list was a year old and still contained one YouTube had dropped; the yt-dlp fallback had a config error so it never ran even once; and YouTube's refusal message was misread so Jarvis 007 reported "private video" for a video that was public.
- **Reports the right problem.** Jarvis 007 now clearly distinguishes "the server is suspected to be a robot" from "private video", "age restricted", "video removed", and also the case of the **server being offline** (before, this was also blamed on YouTube). When unsure it says so plainly, with a one-minute way to check yourself, instead of guessing.

### Added
- **Self-check command for when a video cannot be read**: run `python server/youtube_read.py <link>` right on the server and it prints a table of each attempt: which path works, which is dead, what reason YouTube gave, how many milliseconds it took. It also tries a control video to separate "this video alone has a problem" from "the whole server is blocked", then concludes in one short line and saves the report to a file for you to send.
- **Separate network route for YouTube**: if your server is flagged by YouTube, set `JAVIS_YOUTUBE_PROXY` and you are done, and only YouTube traffic goes through it, not all of Jarvis 007.

## [0.41.0] - 2026-08-20
### Fixed
- **Many more YouTube videos can be read.** The previous version often said "video requires sign-in" and gave up, even for ordinary public videos. The culprit is YouTube suspecting the server address is a robot, common when Jarvis 007 runs on a VPS. Now it switches through six player types in turn before turning to yt-dlp, so most such cases get through on their own.
- **Reports the right problem.** "Server suspected to be a robot" is no longer wrongly described as "private video", so you do not waste effort opening permissions on a video that was already public.

## [0.40.0] - 2026-08-20
### Added
- **Paste a YouTube link and Jarvis 007 summarizes the video.** Before, sending a link in chat always made Jarvis 007 say it could not read it; now it reads the video's captions and summarizes from the real speech, with a timestamp for each point so you can jump back to the exact spot. It accepts youtu.be links, Shorts, live links and links pasted inside a sentence.
- Works on **every brain** (including brains with only an API key), needs no YouTube API key and no sign-in.
- For videos with no captions, private or blocked videos, Jarvis 007 states the reason plainly instead of guessing the content from the title. If the video is too long it says how many minutes it has read, and if you say "keep reading" it reads the next part.

## [0.39.0] - 2026-08-19
### Added
- **Connect a Shopify store.** The **Shopify** card in the Connection store only asks for the store address - no API key, no app install, and you do not need to be the shop owner. Once connected you can ask about products, prices, stock, and ask Jarvis 007 to build a cart and hand you the link to click to pay.
- Defaults to Read-only so Jarvis 007 only looks things up. To have it build a real cart on the shop, raise it to Draft writes; Jarvis 007 can never pay by itself.
- **Technical input fields are now prefilled for you.** Some connections ask for a value an ordinary person cannot know; now Jarvis 007 prefills it, you just press Connect, and you can still edit it if you want.

## [0.38.0] - 2026-08-18
### Added
- **The Terminal opens in multiple tabs.** Right above the terminal there is a tab strip like a browser: press **+** to open another separate shell (up to 4), press a tab name to switch, press **x** to close that session for good. Hidden tabs keep running commands normally, and after F5 the whole set of tabs is still there.
- The "New session" button is renamed **Restart** to be clearer: it refreshes the shell of the tab you are viewing, and to add a shell press **+** on the tab strip.

## [0.37.2] - 2026-08-18
### Fixed
- **Long background jobs are no longer cut off at 5 minutes.** Schedules, Kanban jobs and workflow steps used to be limited to 5-10 minutes each, so real jobs (like scanning many ad groups and then writing to Google Sheets) died midway with the error "Fork exceeded 300s cap". Now the shared cap is **1 hour**, and anyone needing more can set the environment variable `JAVIS_BG_MAX_WALL_S` (seconds) and restart - no code edit needed.

## [0.37.1] - 2026-08-18
### Fixed
- **No more Jarvis 007 (Claude Code brain) suddenly forgetting the conversation in progress.** Mid-discussion Jarvis 007 would suddenly ask "what do you want to talk about?" like a stranger - after a turn took the Instant shortcut, after a turn failed midway, or after the server updated. Cause: these three cases broke the engine's conversation thread, and only the "thread too long" case had its history restored; now a broken thread, for whatever reason, is reconnected from the saved conversation.

## [0.37.0] - 2026-08-18
### Added
- **Windows opens Jarvis 007 as an app.** Double-click `JAVIS OS.bat` and the server runs in the background and the dashboard opens as its own window - no address bar, its own taskbar slot, no black window. If it is already running, clicking again just opens the window without restarting.
- **Auto-start when you sign in to Windows**: `javis-autostart.bat install` (remove with `uninstall`). No admin rights needed.

## [0.36.1] - 2026-08-18
### Fixed
- **Chat on phones can now add line breaks.** Pressing Enter on a phone keyboard makes a new line like any messaging app, and to send you press the Send button. On desktop the old behavior stays: Enter sends, Shift+Enter makes a new line.
- **The "Add to Home Screen" app no longer reopens showing a frozen old conversation.** iPhone freezes the app in the background so messages arriving meanwhile were missed, and this kind of app has no reload button to rescue itself. Now when you open the app Jarvis 007 reconnects on its own and pulls in the missed part of the conversation, with nothing for you to do.

## [0.36.0] - 2026-08-18
This version merges 6 community contributions - thanks to @japanvip115 and @mrcong2909-web.
### Added
- **macOS opens Jarvis 007 as an app.** Double-click `JAVIS OS.app` in Finder and the server runs and the dashboard opens by itself, with an option to start when you sign in to the machine. No Docker, no typing commands.
- **Watchdog for Mac** (`./watchdog.sh install`): if the server is alive but frozen and unresponsive for 3 minutes in a row, it is restarted automatically, without waiting for anyone to notice.
### Fixed
- **The Terminal no longer hangs the whole server on Mac.** Closing a terminal session, or pasting a large block of text while a command was busy, could freeze the whole page until a manual restart - both paths fixed at the root, with a guard test so it does not come back. Updating on Mac also no longer has two processes fighting over the port.
- **Typing Vietnamese no longer drops the last letter when you press Enter to send.** When the input method was still composing and you pressed Enter, the last character used to get lost or slip into the next message.
- **The Google NotebookLM connection no longer dies right after connecting** (the old "Profile name" field overwrote the sign-in session you just pasted - that field is removed entirely, and old connections stop erroring on their own).
- **Connecting Google Workspace from a VPS now says plainly why sign-in fails** instead of dying silently with the error "localhost refused to connect" - along with directions to the separate Calendar and Gmail cards that work fine on a VPS. Installing on Mac also no longer picks an old Python and shows a confusing error.

## [0.35.12] - 2026-08-17
### Fixed
- **The "Add to Home Screen" app on iPhone no longer logs you in again every time it closes.** Each time you open the app from the icon it is a cold start (unlike a Safari tab kept warm), so the "am I signed in" question was sent before the network was up or hit an error - and before, any error made Jarvis 007 treat you as not signed in and make you retype the password even though the session was still valid. Now it asks again a few times before concluding, and on a real network error it leaves the screen as is instead of forcing the login screen wrongly.

## [0.35.11] - 2026-08-17
### Fixed
- **Add to Home Screen on iPhone now always hides the address bar.** Before, depending on the device and iOS version some hid it and some did not, because Jarvis 007 lacked the full "run as its own app" declaration. Note: an icon added to the home screen BEFORE this version keeps the old behavior - delete that icon and press "Add to Home Screen" again once and it is fixed.
### Improved
- **Pinch zoom with two fingers is turned off on phones.** The Jarvis 007 interface no longer shifts when you accidentally touch with two fingers or double-tap.

## [0.35.10] - 2026-08-16
### Fixed
- **Claude Code no longer "randomly signs itself out".** The culprit: when Jarvis 007 stopped a turn that ran too long, the claude process could be killed exactly while writing the login file - a half-written file means next time you count as not signed in (ChatGPT is unaffected because Jarvis 007 keeps the token itself). Two layers of fix: stopping a process now has a few seconds of grace so it can close the file, and Jarvis 007 backs up a healthy login file every 5 minutes - a corrupted or missing file is restored right away, with a clear log entry. Pressing Interrupt on purpose still interrupts for real and is not "revived".

## [0.35.9] - 2026-08-16
### Added
- **Select many and download as one bundle in Studio.** The Skills, Workflows and Agents pages each have a tick box on every card and a Select all button; press "Download selected" and everything ticked comes down as ONE .zip file, including the agents and skills it depends on. No more pressing Export 10 times to get 10 files when you want to share 10 skills. This bundle is imported back in one go with the Import button like a normal bundle.

## [0.35.8] - 2026-08-16
### Improved
- **The Terminal in the Code tab is now the machine's native cmd.** The shell opens in the HOME folder like any ordinary terminal, no longer stuck in the brain folder - installing and signing in to CLIs (like Antigravity's `agy`) is no longer blocked. If you need the brain, type `cd "$JAVIS_BRAIN"` to go there. For the old behavior set `JAVIS_TERMINAL_CWD`.
- **Typing `agy` in the Jarvis 007 terminal now finds the command right away.** Before, the server's PATH was missing the place holding freshly installed commands so typing `agy` said not found, easily mistaken for a broken install. Also: the Antigravity sign-in guide now plainly states the most common reason for "installed but Jarvis 007 does not see it" - signing in over SSH as a different user (like root) is invisible to Jarvis 007; signing in on Jarvis 007's own Code page is the sure way.

## [0.35.7] - 2026-08-16
### Fixed
- **Antigravity sign-in survives updates.** Before, every update lost both the `agy` command and the Google sign-in, so you had to install and sign in again from scratch. Now they are kept on the machine's durable storage: after reaching this version, reinstall one last time and from then on update freely. No Docker config change needed.
- **No more "ChatGPT connection green but chat breaks".** If the machine lacks the `codex` command (some earlier installs were missing it), the ChatGPT card on the Models page now warns plainly with how to fix it, instead of saying connected and letting you hit the error in chat. The packaged build now guarantees codex is always included.

## [0.35.6] - 2026-08-16
### Security
- **2FA no longer silently "turns itself off" after an update.** If the server's encryption key (the .secret_key file) was lost or changed, 2FA used to quietly stop asking for a code and the UI said "Not enabled" - anyone with the password got straight in. Now Jarvis 007 plainly says "enabled but the key is broken", the login gate still blocks and accepts recovery codes, and there is a button to re-enable with a new key right on the Account page.
- **No more losing the 2FA key outright because of one settings save.** Before, when the key was broken, saving any setting overwrote the 2FA key's encrypted copy with empty forever. Now it is kept intact - find the old key file again and 2FA comes back to life, with nothing to do.

## [0.35.5] - 2026-08-16
### Improved
- **Old chats absolutely never change model by themselves.** Each conversation is stamped with the running model from its very first message, even if you never changed it by hand there. Changing the shared default on the Models page only applies to conversations opened afterwards, and does not flip one in progress; to make an old conversation run the new model, change it right in its chat box.

## [0.35.4] - 2026-08-16
### Improved
- **An agent's self-learning memory now gets denser instead of longer.** The agent only proposes lessons, and Jarvis 007 holds the pen and writes them into a separate section: it removes duplicates, keeps exactly the 15 newest lines, and the part you wrote by hand is never touched. No more lessons piling up and making the agent slow and diluted over time.
- **The model bar stops lying when a pin is broken.** A session pinned to a model whose provider has had its key removed used to still show "pinned" while actually running the shared default. Now it plainly says "pin broken", and sending a message removes the broken pin automatically.

## [0.35.3] - 2026-08-16
### Added
- **Each conversation remembers its own model.** Changing the model right in the chat box chooses it for that conversation only (the model bar shows a pin), and switching to another tab and changing model does not drag the old conversation along. A conversation never changed by hand still follows the shared default on the Models page.
- **Agents get smarter with each use.** After finishing a job and drawing a lesson worth keeping, the agent writes it to its own memory by itself, without touching the part you wrote by hand. This matches the improve-at-use-time principle: no background job scans and edits in bulk.

### Fixed
- **No more VPS running out of RAM because of connections.** Connection card servers (like Google Sheets) were abandoned as hundreds of orphan processes, eating almost all RAM after a day. Now closing cleans the whole process tree, and connections are kept warm instead of torn down and rebuilt every 10 minutes.
- **Agents created via chat no longer "vanish".** The internal instructions still pointed to the old folder so agents wrote where the app does not read - this happened twice, now fixed at the root. The agent run log is also fully written on every workflow run path, including the verification step.

## [0.35.2] - 2026-08-16
### Fixed
- **The Google Sheets and TikTok Ads cards are alive again.** These two cards died right at connection for everyone - not because your key was wrong, but because a third-party package was broken by a new library. The exact version is now pinned, and connecting again works. Anyone who connected Google Sheets with a self-declared source as a stopgap should, after updating, go back to the official card and remove the self-declared source to avoid duplicates.
- **MCP connection error messages no longer hide the cause.** Before, the most important part of the error was always cut off and Jarvis 007 blamed the key, making you check the key for hours for nothing. Now it shows the actual cause line, and when the fault is in the package rather than with you it says so plainly.

## [0.35.1] - 2026-08-15
### Improved
- **Jarvis 007 is silent by default.** On first open it only shows text and no longer reads aloud on its own - fewer startles in a crowded place or when you forgot to turn the speaker down. To listen, press the speaker button in the chat box or turn on **Read replies aloud** in Quick settings; once on, Jarvis 007 remembers and F5 keeps it. Anyone who already had it on is not switched off.

## [0.35.0] - 2026-08-14
### Added
- **Jarvis 007 replies in the exact language you type.** Not just Vietnamese and English - type Japanese, Thai, French or any language and Jarvis 007 answers in that same language, with nothing to install. To pin one language firmly, go to **Settings**, the language section.
- **The interface has an English version.** Choose it in **Settings**; translated parts show in English and untranslated parts stay in Vietnamese rather than leaving any box blank. The on-screen text and the language Jarvis 007 replies in are two separate choices.
- **Time zone and currency are separate from language.** Before, Jarvis 007 always counted Vietnam time wherever you sat, so a "7am" reminder rang a few hours off for people in other time zones. Now it follows the time zone you set.

### Improved
- **Jarvis 007 calls you "you" and refers to itself as "I".** Before, it defaulted to the anh/em forms for everyone, which means guessing gender from the first sentence. When you address yourself as anh or chị, Jarvis 007 follows that and remembers it for next time. The bot that replies to your customers keeps the familiar "anh chị" register.
- **English version of the README and the first guide page.** The other pages remain Vietnamese; `docs/en/` states clearly which pages are translated so you need not guess.

## [0.34.1] - 2026-08-14
### Fixed
- **Text in the Terminal on Windows no longer drifts into a staircase.** Running `git help` made the whole screen slant to the right, each line starting where the previous one ended. Windows has no layer that handles "return to line start" for you so Jarvis 007 must do it itself, and now it does.

### Improved
- **Code is its own group on the sidebar, no longer inside Brain.** Open the **Code** group to see the **Terminal** item; programming tools added later will sit in the same place. The redundant tab strip inside the page is also removed - navigation is gathered into one level.

## [0.34.0] - 2026-08-13
### Added
- **There is a Code tab, and opening it gives a real terminal.** It sits next to Files in the Brain group, opened at the brain folder. Type commands directly on the machine running Jarvis 007 - `git pull`, view logs, install a CLI, sign in to `agy` - with no need to open SSH in another window. It can run `vim` and `htop`, has color and Tab completion, and Ctrl+C kills the running command rather than ejecting the whole session.
- **Switching to another page does not kill a running command.** Run `npm install`, go look at chat and come back and the screen is intact, showing whatever has run so far. F5 or a dropped network is the same. Only after 30 minutes of neglect does Jarvis 007 close the session.
- Only a browser that is **signed in** can open the terminal, and API tokens cannot. To lock it completely set `JAVIS_TERMINAL=0` and restart.
- Windows runs a reduced version: type a line and press Enter, no Tab completion, `vim` does not run. That is an operating system limit and the interface says so right on the panel, so you do not sit guessing.

## [0.33.7] - 2026-08-13
### Improved
- **Switch the Antigravity model right on Telegram.** The button panel of `/model` now shows all providers like the Models page on the dashboard, instead of being stuck on the old five - so the Antigravity brain can be switched from a phone. A provider that cannot list any model yet (common: installed but not signed in) is hidden for tidiness.
- **Typing `/model <model name>` directly no longer picks the wrong provider.** Jarvis 007 looks that name up in the real list and switches to the right place; if the name exists at several providers it asks back instead of guessing.

## [0.33.6] - 2026-08-13
### Fixed
- **Chat through Antigravity no longer breaks Vietnamese accents.** Words like "gồm", "hạn" showed as question-mark boxes. Measured, Jarvis 007 reads the text back correctly - the break is at the moment `agy` receives the content, so Jarvis 007 now sends it in pieces cut at the right spots so that however the other side reads it, nothing breaks.
- If text still breaks, Jarvis 007 switches the sending method by itself and asks once more; if it still breaks it says plainly the fault is inside `agy` rather than silently returning wrong text.

## [0.33.5] - 2026-08-13
### Fixed
- **Jarvis 007 repairs .md notes already broken by older versions.** On the Files page, if any file has the bug from versions before 0.33.4 (the property block at the top of the note turned into `* * *`, text piled with backslashes) Jarvis 007 shows a list and one button fixes them all. If no file is broken nothing is shown.
- Jarvis 007 only touches the exact traces of that bug, so horizontal rules in the middle of a post or healthy notes are all kept.

## [0.33.4] - 2026-08-13
### Fixed
- **Opening a file on the Files page now uses the same editor as the chat box.** No more bare edit box popping up in the middle of the screen: .md, .txt and .html files open **right in the page**, with a visual editor, format bar, Undo/Redo, rename, delete, expand. Press **✕** or `Esc` to go back to the list.
- **Saving a .md note no longer corrupts the file.** The `---` block at the top of a note (status, type, created...) used to be turned into `* * *` on the first save, and each time you reopened to edit another layer of backslashes was added to the title. Now that block shows as a locked **Properties** section, keeping every character. A file already broken needs one manual fix.
- **Clicking a file link in chat no longer lands on a blank "Not a folder" page.** A link pointing at a file opens it straight to edit; a link that misses (common: chat wrote the name with accents while the file is saved without) makes Jarvis 007 search the whole brain by name and show files with similar names, one click to open.

## [0.33.3] - 2026-08-13
### Fixed
- **No more black window flashes on Windows.** Occasionally while in use a black terminal window flashed in the middle of the screen and vanished - because Jarvis 007 runs in the background with no window, so every helper command it called was given a new window by Windows. All of it is plugged, and an automatic test guards so it does not slip back in.
- Updating on Windows also stops flashing constantly for the same cause.

## [0.33.2] - 2026-08-13
### Fixed
- **Antigravity on Windows: finished the fix.** Version 0.33.1 sent content to `agy` with a syntax inferred from documentation, and the real `agy` returned `Error: empty prompt` and stopped. Now Jarvis 007 tries a few ways on the first run, uses whichever works and remembers it; if none works it switches to the fallback path instead of throwing an English error at you.

## [0.33.1] - 2026-08-13
### Fixed
- **The Antigravity CLI brain can chat on Windows.** Before, every turn returned "this conversation is too long", even when you had just opened a new chat and typed only "hi" - so no number of new conversations got you out. The part over the limit was Jarvis 007's fixed part, not what you typed, and the old error message simply pointed the wrong way.
- Now Jarvis 007 sends content to `agy` another way, no longer hitting Windows' command length limit. Any `agy` build that cannot accept it makes Jarvis 007 switch to the fallback path within that same turn, and if that path is also incomplete it says so plainly instead of quietly answering with missing content.
- **Antigravity can now use Jarvis 007 tools.** The old config path guessed the wrong place so this brain ran without Kanban, MCP or skills, and said nothing.
- Background work through Antigravity is no longer cut off at minute 5.

## [0.33.0] - 2026-08-13
### Added
- **Give it an HTML file and get an editable Webcake file that matches the original.** Jarvis 007 reads the HTML page itself and builds a `.pke` file that opens directly in the Webcake page builder: colors, font sizes, images, buttons, forms and block order are taken straight from the original, not looked at and retyped. Tell Jarvis 007 "convert this html file to webcake" and it runs.
- **Jarvis 007 checks before handing over.** The built page is checked automatically for: text overlapping, blocks overflowing, and **text sinking into the background** - the most common bug when carrying colors from HTML, hard to see by eye.

### Fixed
- **Skills that come with tools now truly work.** Before, Jarvis 007 only copied the instruction part of a skill down to the brain and left behind the entire accompanying tool folder - so any skill that needed to run a tool broke on every brain. This was exactly why "HTML to Webcake" was removed entirely in version 0.9.291; now the root is fixed and it is back.

## [0.32.2] - 2026-08-13
### Improved
- **Antigravity CLI: sign-in is now done in the terminal, and the card on the Models page no longer has a sign-in button.** The old button opened a small terminal box right on the page that did not respond to clicks, so you still had to open a real terminal; on Windows it never worked.
- The card now gives the exact command to type (`agy`) with one explanatory sentence: over SSH it prints a link by itself for you to open on your own machine. After typing, press **Check again** and the card switches to signed in.

## [0.32.1] - 2026-08-13
### Improved
- **The Usage page shows only US dollars, with the conversion to dong removed entirely.** Provider prices are all listed in USD, while exchange rates drift but the number in the machine stands still - converting once more only creates one more place to be wrong.
- Amounts smaller than one cent are now written as `<$0.01` instead of being rounded to `$0.00`, which looked like zero.

### Fixed
- **The conversion unit price uses the model that is actually running.** Before, with the default config it picked up a model name from an old field, so it priced one Opus turn at $0.15 instead of $15 - off by 100 times, in the direction of under-reporting the savings.

## [0.32.0] - 2026-08-13
### Added
- **The Usage page is rebuilt from scratch.** Opening it gives one plain-language sentence saying who pays what for what this month, then three tappable tiles: cash against budget, how much of the 5-hour window is left, and how many tokens have been saved.
- **Set a monthly API money budget right on the page.** At 80% Jarvis 007 messages you, and at the cap (if you turn it on) it automatically pushes background work onto a path that costs no money - your chat is not touched. There is also a box to enter your plan price so you can see whether the plan is ahead or behind API pricing.
- **A token report is sent to chat automatically on Monday morning**, turned on with one tick box. The hourly-by-day chart has marker lines for the day you changed mode or brain, so you see at a glance why a bar dropped.

### Fixed
- **Saved tokens show again, and in every period.** Before, this block vanished exactly when saving mode was working best, because it needed both an old turn and a new turn within 24 hours to have a number - turn it on and leave it alone for a day and it was gone.
- **OpenRouter models are no longer costed at 0.** This is the only branch where you pay real cash, so the old money tile always showed $0.00 even while the wallet drained.

## [0.31.0] - 2026-08-13
### Fixed
